meaning: not to be alert on opportunity
meaning_uz: imkoniyatdan ogoh bo'lmaslik
usage: The security guard fell asleep at the switch and a robber broke in.

meaning: to recognize or determine one's orientation, position, or abilities relative to one's surroundings or situation
meaning_uz: atrof yoki vaziyatga nisbatan birovning yo'nalishini, mavqeini yoki qobiliyatlarini tan olish yoki aniqlash uchun
usage: It took me a little while to find my bearings in the new office, but after a week, I felt as if I'd been working there for years.

meaning: someone or something used as the subject of an experiment
meaning_uz: biror kishi yoki biror narsa tajriba mavzusi sifatida ishlatiladigan
usage: Jane used her husband as a guinea pig to try her new baked chicken recipe.

meaning: with irregular bursts of activity
meaning_uz: faoliyatning tartibsiz yorilishlari bilan
usage: The economy was recovering in fits and starts.

meaning: something that is said to mean that people will be punished for something bad that has happened
meaning_uz: sodir bo'lgan yomon narsa uchun odamlar jazolanishini anglatadigan narsa
usage: Heads will roll if there are any errors in the pamphlets we printed for this networking event.

meaning: to present arguments to or attempt to persuade or advise those who have no inclination to change their opinion or belief
meaning_uz: o'z fikrini yoki e'tiqodini o'zgartirishga moyilligi bo'lmaganlarni ishontirish yoki maslahat berishga dalillarni taqdim etish yoki
usage: You're preaching to deaf ears if you think you can convince these kids to stay away from alcohol before they turn 21.

meaning: to terrify someone
meaning_uz: kimnidir qo'rqitish uchun
usage: That horror movie curdled my blood so badly that I spent the next week sleeping in my parents' bedroom!

meaning: saying something very clearly in very few words, without trying to be polite or pleasant
meaning_uz: muloyim yoki xushmuomala bo'lishga urinmasdan, juda kam so'z bilan bir narsani juda aniq aytish
usage: He asked me to work at the weekend, but I refused point-blank.

idiom: be afraid of one's own shadow
meaning: to be easily or constantly spooked, nervous, timid, afraid, or fearfully suspicious
meaning_uz: oson yoki doimiy ravishda qo'rqib turish, asabiylashish, qo'rqoq, qo'rqoq yoki qo'rqinchli shubhali bo'lish
usage: You can't live life being afraid of your shadow - you need to get out into the world and taste adventure!

meaning: something is the most extreme example
meaning_uz: biror narsa eng ekstremal misol
usage: I've had some pretty bad injuries, but this one takes the cake.

meaning: discover and reveal damaging information about someone
meaning_uz: kim haqida zararli ma'lumotlarni kashf etish va oshkor
usage: Once I contact my usual sources at the tabloids, I should be able to dig up dirt on that actress.

meaning: start to act or behave in a better or more responsible way
meaning_uz: harakat qilishni boshlash yoki o'zini yaxshiroq yoki mas'uliyatli tarzda
usage: Apparently he's turned over a new leaf and he's not smoking any more.

meaning: thirteen, one more than a usual dozen
meaning_uz: on ba, yak nafar ziyodi odatan on
usage: When Jacob went to the bakery to buy doughnuts for the office, he made sure to get a baker's dozen so he could sneak one to eat on the way to work.

idiom: be like a red rag to a bull
meaning: to be certain to produce an angry or violent reaction
meaning_uz: g'azablangan yoki zo'ravon reaktsiya keltirib chiqarishiga ishonch hosil qilish
usage: You do realize that bringing your new girlfriend to your ex-wife's house is like a red rag to a bull, right?

meaning: to remain patient and calm, especially when beginning to become angry or upset with impatience
meaning_uz: sabr-toqatli va sokin bo'lib qolishga, ayniqsa, sabrsizlik bilan g'azablanishni yoki g'amgin bo'lishni boshlaganda
usage: Yeah, yeah, keep your socks on! I'll have the report finished by the end of the day!

idiom: by the seat of one's pants
meaning: without a clear plan or direction
meaning_uz: aniq reja va yo'nalishsiz
usage: I know my parents think that I'm just flying by the seat of my pants ever since I dropped out of college, but I just signed with a record label and am launching my singing career!

meaning: you can't rescind information that has been shared publicly, especially when it is damaging to a person or organization's reputation
meaning_uz: ommaviy ravishda bo'lib o'tgan ma'lumotlarni bekor qila olmaysiz, ayniqsa, u inson yoki tashkilot obro'siga zarar etkazayotganda
usage: You can't unring a bell, even with the best lawyers. So I doubt this scandal is going away anytime soon.

meaning: something that you say by accident when you intended to say something else
meaning_uz: boshqa gapni aytish niyatida bo'lganingizda tasodifiy aytgan biror
usage: I called her new boyfriend by her previous boyfriend's name - it was just a slip of the tongue.

meaning: to spare the effort of saying something, doing something, or making an appeal that will be futile
meaning_uz: biror narsa aytish, biror ish qilish yoki behuda bo'ladigan murojaat qilish harakatidan saqlab qolish uchun
usage: I was going to complain to the phone company about the extra charges, but I decided to save my breath.

meaning: to have something to complain about, to have a selfish reason for saying or doing something, to have a strong opinion about something that influences your actions
meaning_uz: shikoyat qiladigan narsaga ega bo'lish, biror narsani aytish yoki bajarish uchun xudbin sababga ega bo'lish, xatti-harakatlaringizga ta'sir qiladigan narsa haqida kuchli fikrga ega bo'lish
usage: Environmentalists have no political axe to grind - they just want to save the planet.

meaning: a person's closest living relative or relatives
meaning_uz: insonning eng yaqin tirik qarindoshi yoki qarindosh-urug'lari
usage: The police notified the next of kin about his accident.

meaning: something you do not want to experience because it is so unpleasant
meaning_uz: siz boshdan kechirishni istamagan narsa, chunki u juda yoqimsiz
usage: I appreciate Gina inviting me to go with her to the theater, but having to listen to those opera singers would be a fate worse than death.

meaning: the press; the profession of journalism
meaning_uz: baspasy; jurnalistikaning kasbi
usage: One must never forget the sway held by members of the Fourth Estate - if we want public support, then we need the press on our side.

meaning: to act in order to avoid blame or responsibility for something or prevent oneself from experiencing negative consequences
meaning_uz: biror narsaga ayb yoki mas'uliyatdan qochish yoki o'zini nojo'ya oqibatlarga olib kelishining oldini olish maqsadida harakat qilish
usage: I immediately covered my back by saying that I wasn't home when the puppy got out.

meaning: to stay well-informed about the status of someone or something
meaning_uz: birov yoki biror narsaning holati haqida yaxshi ma'lumotga ega bo'lish uchun
usage: News is easy to get these days, and I do what I can to keep on top.

meaning: to do something without anyone else telling you or asking you to do it
meaning_uz: biror ishni boshqa hech kim aytmasdan yoki bajarishingizni so'ramasdan
usage: I didn't ask her to buy them a present - she did it off her own bat.

meaning: to watch something very closely or carefully, to be particularly attentive to or vigilant about something
meaning_uz: biror narsani juda diqqat bilan yoki diqqat bilan kuzatib borish, ayniqsa, e'tiborli bo'lish yoki biror narsaga hushyor bo'lish
usage: The toddler had a beady eye on his toys throughout the party, screaming at any child who dared to play with his things.

meaning: to create a situation that will cause trouble or be unpleasant
meaning_uz: qiyinchilik tug'diradigan yoki yoqimsiz bo'ladigan vaziyatni vujudga keltirish
usage: The investigation into how those expensive trips were paid for certainly opened a can of worms.

meaning: to exert excessive and coercive pressure, force, or threats of violence on someone
meaning_uz: birovga ortiqcha va majburlovchi bosim, kuch yoki zo'ravonlik tahdidlarini amalga oshirishga
usage: The bank has really started turning the screws on me ever since I began missing my mortgage payments.

idiom: err on the side of caution
meaning: to be especially careful rather than taking a risk or making a mistake
meaning_uz: xavfni qo'lga kiritish yoki xatoga yo'l qo'ymaslikdan ko'ra, ayniqsa ehtiyot bo'lish
usage: I like to err on the side of caution and always keep some money in my savings account.

meaning: the most affluent, powerful, or influential class in a society; the social elites or aristocrats
meaning_uz: jamiyatdagi eng boy, qudratli yoki ta'sirli sinf; ijtimoiy elitalar yoki aristokratlarning
usage: The awards ceremony was a chance for me to mingle with the upper crust.

meaning: to change a situation so that you now have an advantage over someone who previously had an advantage over you
meaning_uz: vaziyatni o'zgartirish uchun, endi sizdan oldin ustunlikka ega bo'lgan odamdan ustunlikka ega bo'lishingiz uchun
usage: She turned the tables on her rival with allegations of corruption.

meaning: a sufficient buffer of time, space, or money that allows for freedom of movement or relief from a given source of pressure or stress
meaning_uz: bosim yoki stress manbaidan harakat yoki yengillik erkinligiga imkon beradigan vaqt, joy yoki pulning etarli buferi
usage: My yearly bonus always affords us a little bit of breathing room for the Christmas expenses.

meaning: to follow the direction, lead, or guidance of someone or something; to act in accordance with someone or something; to follow suit
meaning_uz: biror kimsaning yoki narsaning yo'nalishi, yetakchiligi yoki yo'l-yo'riqlariga rioya qilish; birovga yoki biror narsaga muvofiq harakat qilish; shunga ergashish uchun
usage: If you can develop a really strong social presence for your company, then your sales will follow in stride.

meaning: to wait until you know all the facts before forming an opinion or making a judgment, be willing to change your opinion
meaning_uz: fikr tuzishdan yoki hukm chiqarishdan oldin barcha faktlarni bilguncha kutish, fikringizni o'zgartirishga rozi bo'ling
usage: I don't usually like musicals, but I'm keeping an open mind.

meaning: to force someone out of or away from some place or thing
meaning_uz: birovni biror joydan yoki narsadan majburlash yoki undan
usage: Our soldiers have finally managed to rout the enemy out the occupied city.

meaning: say or do something to disturb an existing situation and upset people
meaning_uz: mavjud vaziyatni bezovta qilish va odamlarni g'amgin qilish uchun biror narsa aytish yoki
usage: After the recent riots, the government decided not to rock the boat by introducing new policies.

meaning: something that is pleasing to hear, such as good news
meaning_uz: eshitishga ma'qul bo'lgan narsa, masalan, xushxabar
usage: When Michelle heard that her son and daughter-in-law were going to have a baby, it was music to her ears.

meaning: something that makes a good situation even better
meaning_uz: yaxshi vaziyatni yanada yaxshilaydigan narsa
usage: George was happy to have his first book published. All those congratulatory messages and fan mail that came in were the icing on the cake.

meaning: to cause or signal the impending end or ruin of something, especially a business, organization, or activity
meaning_uz: biror narsaning, ayniqsa, biznes, tashkilot yoki faoliyatning yaqinlashib kelayotgan tugashi yoki buzilishiga sabab bo'lishi yoki signal berishi
usage: The expansion of the Internet and digital media has sounded the death knell for countless print-based businesses around the world.

meaning: to be updated, to not be behind, to have all the current information
meaning_uz: yangilanishi, orqada qolmasligi, hozirgi barcha ma'lumotlarga ega bo'lishi
usage: Before we start the meeting I'm going to bring you up to speed with the latest developments.

meaning: stay out of trouble
meaning_uz: qiyinchiliklardan chetda qoling
usage: He tried to keep his nose clean with socially useful work.

meaning: to give someone help
meaning_uz: kimgadir yordam berish uchun
usage: Could you give me a hand with these suitcases?

idiom: tar somebody with the same brush
meaning: to think that someone has the same bad qualities as another person
meaning_uz: birovning boshqa shaxs bilan bir xil yomon fazilatlarga ega deb o'ylashi
usage: Since they worked so closely in the same department, John was tarred with the same brush as Tim.

meaning: to be made available or be known about, appear for the first time
meaning_uz: taqdim etilishi yoki to'g'risida ma'lum bo'lishi, birinchi marta paydo
usage: The company agreed the ad was an embarrassment and promised it would never again see the light of day.

meaning: something valuable presented to one who does not or will not recognize its worth
meaning_uz: bo'lmagan yoki uning qiymatini tan olmaydigan shaxsga taqdim etilgan qimmatli
usage: Most of the time, playing classical music for high schoolers is like casting your pearls before swine. But every so often a few kids appreciate it.

meaning: to have a difficult or frustrating time
meaning_uz: qiyin yoki zerikarli vaqtga ega bo'lish
usage: I'm having the devil's own job getting this window open - I think it's been painted shut.

meaning: to offer someone no mercy, concession, indulgence, or leeway
meaning_uz: Birovga rahm-shafqat, imtiyoz, rozilik va imkoniyatni taklif qilmasligi
usage: Our boss grants no quarter when it comes to the standards of our projects.

meaning: to pay for something
meaning_uz: biror narsa uchun to'lash uchun
usage: I hope the production company is footing the bill for all of this air travel.

meaning: everyone available to help with a problem, or a call for those people to help
meaning_uz: muammoga yordam berish uchun mavjud bo'lgan har bir kishi yoki o'sha odamlarga yordam berishga chaqiriq
usage: Your grandmother arrives tomorrow and the house is still a mess - I need all hands on deck to help me clean!

meaning: strictly or rigidly adhered to, not to be changed
meaning_uz: qat'iy yoki qattiq rioya qilingan, o'zgartirilmaydigan
usage: A hard and fast rule to maintain silence in the library.

meaning: to behave in an uncontrolled, wild way
meaning_uz: nazoratsiz, yovvoyi tarzda o'zini tutishi
usage: Don't be too hard on them - they're just kids and they need to cut loose sometimes.

meaning: to cause a strong reaction or emotion in someone
meaning_uz: birovda kuchli reaktsiya yoki hissiyotni keltirib chiqarishi
usage: My brother knows exactly how to push my buttons. He annoys me so much.

meaning: spending a lot of time and energy doing a lot of things but actually achieving too little
meaning_uz: ko'p ishlarni bajarishga ko'p vaqt va kuch sarflash, lekin aslida juda kam yutuqlarga erishish
usage: He's been chasing his tail all week collecting data but the report is still not ready.

meaning: at risk of failing or being harmed
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashi yoki zarar ko'rilishi xavfi ostida
usage: Firefighters regularly put their lives on the line.

meaning: crazy, mentally unsound, extremely foolish
meaning_uz: jinni, aqli nodon, nihoyatda ahmoqona
usage: You must be off your rocker if you think that's a good idea!

meaning: angry and ready to argue or fight
meaning_uz: g'azablangan va bahslashishga yoki jang qilishga tayyor
usage: I told my friends to watch out because my mother was on the warpath.

meaning: to do something very well and very naturally as if it is usual and easy for you
meaning_uz: biror ishni o'zingiz uchun odatdagidek va oson bo'lgandek juda yaxshi va juda tabiiy
usage: He handled his sudden rise to fame as if in the manner born.

meaning: to promise one something that cannot be done
meaning_uz: qilib bo'lmaydigan bir narsani va'da qilish
usage: Your clients will come to distrust you if you keep promising them the moon.

meaning: used to describe something that is not important, usually because it does not involve much money
meaning_uz: muhim bo'lmagan narsani tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi, odatda ko'p pul bilan bog'liq bo'lmagani uchun
usage: A nickel and dime dispute.

meaning: to make or focus on trivial or petty details, differences, or distinctions
meaning_uz: arzimas yoki arzimas detallar, farqlar yoki farqlarga e'tibor berish yoki
usage: I actually think it was your responsibility, not Dave's, but let's not split hairs about it.

meaning: to indicate that one is guilty of doing something; to blame or accuse one of doing something
meaning_uz: biror ish qilishda aybdor ekanligini ko'rsatish; birini biror ish qilishda ayblash yoki ayblash uchun
usage: Now, I'm not pointing the finger at anyone in particular, but someone here has been stealing food from the communal refrigerator.

meaning: an expression of encouragement to persist or stay calm in a challenging situation
meaning_uz: qiyin vaziyatda davom etish yoki sokin bo'lishga undash ifodasi
usage: I know you're worried, but hang in there - the doctor will call soon.

idiom: be brought in from the cold
meaning: to be allowed to join or participate in a group from which one was previously excluded; to be accepted in a certain social setting
meaning_uz: ilgari chetlatilgan guruhga qo'shilish yoki ishtirok etishga ruxsat berilishi; ma'lum bir ijtimoiy sharoitda qabul qilinishi
usage: The striking workers were finally brought in from the cold after the union and corporate leaders settled the wage dispute.

meaning: to know important or influential people in business or government
meaning_uz: tadbirkorlik yoki davlat boshqaruvida muhim yoki ta'sirli kishilarni bilishi
usage: He wouldn't have succeeded without help from friends in high places.

meaning: to not be noticed or dealt with by a system
meaning_uz: tizim tomonidan e'tiborga olmaslik va hal etilmasligi
usage: Too many young people slip through the cracks in the healthcare system.

meaning: a sign or signal indicating potential, incipient, or imminent danger or trouble
meaning_uz: potentsial, qo'zg'atuvchi yoki yaqinlashib kelayotgan xavf yoki muammolarni ko'rsatuvchi belgi yoki signal
usage: Didn't the fact that your accountant used to be a drug dealer raise a red flag or two when you started doing business with him?

meaning: to have successfully completed something, as a project or activity
meaning_uz: biror ishni muvaffaqiyatli yakunlagan bo'lishi, loyiha yoki faoliyat sifatida
usage: I'm pretty sure I did well on that last exam, so it looks like I'm home and hosed for the semester.

meaning: to say something that is quickly shown not to be true
meaning_uz: bo'lmasligi tezda ko'rsatilgan bir gapni aytishga
usage: He won't be home for hours yet. Oh, I spoke too soon - here he is now!

meaning: said to convey that you agree completely with someone
meaning_uz: birov bilan butunlay rozi ekanligingizni bildirishni aytdi
usage: He said that it  was such a difficult job to be completed in a week and Sam just laughed and replied you can say that again!

meaning: to be the perfect size and shape for someone
meaning_uz: uchun mukammal o'lcham va shakl bo'lishi uchun
usage: I love these pants because they fit like a glove and they're so comfortable.

meaning: spending more money than you earn
meaning_uz: topganingizdan ko'ra ko'proq pul sarflash
usage: The company has been in the red for the last three quarters.

meaning: to spend as little money as possible, to be very frugal or tight, especially with the aim of saving up for something bigger
meaning_uz: iloji boricha kamroq pul sarflash, juda arzon yoki qattiq bo'lish, ayniqsa kattaroq narsa uchun pul yig'ish maqsadida
usage: Ever since we had our second child, we've had to pinch and scrape to make sure they both get what they want for Christmas.

meaning: to con, swindle, or deceive one
meaning_uz: birini kondirish, aldash yoki aldash uchun
usage: That get-rich-quick guru took tens of thousands of people for a ride, lining his own pockets with their investments.

meaning: with great success
meaning_uz: katta muvaffaqiyatlar bilan
usage: She took a driving test and passed with flying colors.

meaning: to not interfere in someone else's affairs
meaning_uz: o'zganing ishiga aralashmaslik
usage: I really wish she would mind her own beeswax and stop asking me about my finances.

meaning: to be in a state of severe deterioration such that one is approaching inevitable ruin, failure, or death
meaning_uz: og'ir yomonlashuv holatida bo'lishi shunday bo'lishi kerakki, bir kishi muqarrar vayronagarchilik, muvaffaqiyatsizlik yoki o'limga yaqinlashib
usage: Her political career began to circle the drain after news of her affair came to public light.

meaning: become extremely angry or distraught
meaning_uz: nihoyatda g'azablangan yoki g'azablangan bo'lib qoling
usage: He'd go spare if he lost the money again.

meaning: to carefully look through an area or an item in an attempt to find someone or something
meaning_uz: biror kimsani yoki biror narsani topish maqsadida biror hudud yoki buyumni diqqat bilan ko'rib
usage: We combed through the wreckage but still haven't found any survivors.

meaning: paid for by or courtesy of the merchant or the establishment
meaning_uz: tomonidan to'lanadi yoki savdogar yoki muassasaning
usage: Don't worry, this round is on the house for the trouble they have caused.

meaning: to share one's thoughts or feelings
meaning_uz: o'z fikrini yoki his-tuyg'ularini baham ko'rish uchun
usage: When we left the office, Sally gave voice to her fear that promotions are unfairly awarded out in our department.

meaning: full of bruises
meaning_uz: ko'karishlarga to'la
usage: He was beaten black and blue at boarding school.

meaning: don't get angry at or punish someone who is simply delivering bad or undesirable news as they are not responsible for it
meaning_uz: uchun javobgar bo'lmagani uchun oddiygina yomon yoki yoqimsiz yangiliklarni yetkazayotgan odamdan g'azablanmang yoki jazolamang
usage: A: "What do you mean I'm being sued by my ex-wife? I'll knock your lights out!" B: "Hey man, I'm just doing my job. Don't shoot the messenger!"

meaning: to realize your good luck
meaning_uz: omadingizni anglash uchun
usage: Seven climbers are counting their blessings after surviving a sudden snowstorm yesterday on Mt. Rainier.

meaning: to hope that something will happen, to hope for good luck
meaning_uz: biror narsa bo'lishiga umid qilish, omadga umid qilish
usage: At this point, they can only stand back, cross their fingers and wait to see if the fireworks go off perfectly.

meaning: issue instructions to other people in an authoritative or dogmatic way
meaning_uz: boshqa kishilarga ko'rsatmalarni izchil yoki dogmatik tarzda rasmiylashtirish
usage: I am not attempting to lay down the law, but simply wish to voice my opinion.

meaning: convey a great deal without using words (through a gesture, circumstance, etc. )
meaning_uz: so'zlarni ishlatmasdan (ishora, vaziyat va boshqalar orqali) juda ko'p narsalarni bildiradi.
usage: She did not say anything but her face spoke volumes about what she was going through.

meaning: something that is very easy to do
meaning_uz: qilish juda oson bo'lgan narsa
usage: The exam was a piece of cake.

meaning: to try something, often for the first time as a means of forming an opinion about it
meaning_uz: biror narsani sinab ko'rish, ko'pincha bu haqda fikr shakllantirish vositasi sifatida birinchi marta
usage: I don't usually like hot tea, but it's so cold out that I gave it a shot today.

meaning: to discover and pursue one's true and inherent passion, skill, or vocation
meaning_uz: insonning haqiqiy va o'ziga xos ehtirosi, mahorati yoki kasb-hunarini kashf etish va izlanish
usage: Many students leave college and realize that they still have yet to find their calling.

meaning: to work for very little money
meaning_uz: juda kam pulga ishlashga
usage: I need a raise - I'm sick of still working for peanuts after three years!

idiom: born with a silver spoon in mouth
meaning: to be born to parents who are rich and have a good social rank, someone who is born into privilege and wealth
meaning_uz: boy va yaxshi ijtimoiy darajaga ega bo'lgan ota-onalardan tug'ilishi, imtiyoz va boylikka tug'ilgan kishi
usage: He does not need this job as much as I do, he is born with a silver spoon in his mouth.

meaning: ready to obey someone
meaning_uz: kimgadir itoat etishga tayyor
usage: Just imagine what it's like to have a cook and a maid at your beck and call.

meaning: be confident or unashamed
meaning_uz: ishonchli yoki uyalmagan bo'ling
usage: Under the circumstances I would find it impossible to hold my head up in the town.

meaning: used to tell someone that you cannot accept an invitation now, but would like to do so at a later time
meaning_uz: birovga hozir taklifni qabul qila olmasligingizni aytish uchun ishlatilgan, ammo keyinchalik buni
usage: Mind if I take a rain check on that drink? I have to work late tonight.

meaning: to dance, especially to popular music
meaning_uz: raqsga tushishga, ayniqsa, ommabop musiqaga
usage: The flash mob started throwing shapes in the train station to classic 1970s disco tunes.

meaning: exactly even or level especially in a race or a contest
meaning_uz: ayniqsa musobaqa yoki musobaqada aniq bir xil yoki daraja
usage: Opinion polls showed the two major parties neck and neck.

meaning: to speak very highly of or enthusiastically endorse someone or something, as a means of marketing, advertising, or professionally recommending them or it
meaning_uz: marketing, reklama yoki ularni professional ravishda tavsiya qilish vositasi sifatida birovni yoki biror narsani juda yuqori baholab yoki g'ayrat bilan qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun
usage: We're willing to pay you a generous fee if you put a plug in for our new product on your radio show tonight.

meaning: to contrast with someone else and thus highlight their unique qualities
meaning_uz: o'zgalardan qarama-qarshi bo'lish va shu tariqa ularning o'ziga xos sifatlarini yoritib
usage: The simple stone floor is the perfect foil for the brightly coloured furnishings.

meaning: to have one's relationship with someone completely diminished, typically due to an argument or unpleasant incident
meaning_uz: birovning munosabatlari butunlay pasayishiga olib kelishi, odatda, tortishuv yoki yoqimsiz hodisa tufayli
usage: He left home after falling out with his parents.

meaning: to experience nervousness or anxiety before one attempts to do something
meaning_uz: bir ishni qilishga urinishdan oldin asabiylashish yoki tashvishlanishni boshdan kechirish
usage: Good luck getting her out on stage, she always gets cold feet before a performance.

meaning: in control, in charge of things
meaning_uz: boshqarishda, ishlarga mas'ul bo'lgan
usage: Joan can't wait to get into the driver's seat and do what she can to turn things around.

meaning: be lavish in one's spending or celebrations
meaning_uz: birovning xarajatlari yoki bayramlarida hashamatli bo'ling
usage: From fine wines to the delights of the theatre, this is your chance to push the boat out.

meaning: come up to expectations, reach the required standard
meaning_uz: kutilmalarga kelish, kerakli standartga erishish
usage: I didn't cut the mustard as a hockey player.

meaning: ahead of (or lagging behind) current thinking or trends
meaning_uz: oldinda (yoki orqada qolgan) hozirgi fikrlash yoki tendentsiyalar
usage: He was ahead of the curve in the early 1960s when he started promoting running for health.

meaning: to turn upside down, to flip over, often used to describe overturned boats or ships
meaning_uz: yuqoriga ko'tarilish, orqaga burilish, ko'pincha ag'darilgan qayiq yoki kemalarni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladigan
usage: You need to wear a life jacket because there's always a chance that the boat could turn turtle.

meaning: to behave or do something in a way contrary to that which is generally accepted or expected
meaning_uz: o'zini tutish yoki biror ishni umuman qabul qilingan yoki kutilayotgan narsaga zid tarzda qilish
usage: It can be risky, but challenging the status quo can be a great way to get ahead in business.

meaning: something that suddenly makes you remember an earlier time in your life
meaning_uz: to'satdan hayotingizda avvalgi vaqtni eslab qolishga undaydigan narsa
usage: Hearing that record again was a real blast from the past.

meaning: to pursue or look for one's objectives, results, or goals in the place where one is most likely to find them
meaning_uz: topish ehtimoli katta bo'lgan joyda o'z oldiga maqsad, natija yoki maqsadlarni izlash yoki izlashga
usage: If you're looking to expand your customer base, you need to identify who would benefit from your business the most and then hunt where the ducks are.

meaning: to cling stubbornly to one's beliefs, position, or wishes
meaning_uz: o'z e'tiqodiga, mavqeiga yoki xohish-istaklariga o'jarlik bilan yopishib olish
usage: Please let me tell my side of the story before you dig your heels in on this issue.

meaning: extricate oneself from a difficult situation by choosing the simplest rather than the most honourable course of action
meaning_uz: eng sharafli harakat yo'lini emas, balki eng oddiy yo'lni tanlab, qiyin vaziyatdan o'zini chiqarib
usage: As soon as things got difficult on the job, he took the easy way out and quit.

meaning: the same outcome can be reached by many methods or ideas
meaning_uz: aynan shu natijaga ko'plab usullar yoki g'oyalar yetishishi mumkin
usage: All roads lead to Rome, so you can approach the puzzle any way you like, as long as you solve it.

meaning: to become very famous or successful
meaning_uz: juda mashhur yoki muvaffaqiyatli bo'lish uchun
usage: Though she'd been acting for years, it was after her role in last summer's blockbuster that she finally hit the big time.

meaning: under someone's strict control, not allowed by someone to have very much independence or autonomy
meaning_uz: birovning qat'iy nazorati ostida, birov tomonidan juda ko'p mustaqillikka yoki avtonomiyaga ega bo'lishga yo'l qo'yilmagan
usage: Everyone feels like they're on a tight leash at the office ever since that new manager took over.

meaning: when someone finds it difficult to choose between two alternatives
meaning_uz: kimdir ikkita alternativa o'rtasida tanlov o'tkazish qiyin bo'lganda
usage: If you try to organize an event that will appeal to both young and old, you can end up caught between two stools.

idiom: be of no use to man or beast
meaning: to be completely useless, to serve no purpose, to be unsuitable to anyone or anything
meaning_uz: butunlay foydasiz bo'lishi, hech qanday maqsadga xizmat qilishi, hech kimga yoki biror narsaga yaroqsiz bo'lishi
usage: After 20 years, my faithful old truck finally broke down for good. It's no use to man or beast anymore.

idiom: there's more than one way to skin a cat
meaning: there are many methods one may employ in achieving one's ends
meaning_uz: birining maqsadlariga erishishda qo'llashi mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab usullar mavjud
usage: Don't worry, we'll get this start-up off the ground. Our talks with the investment group may have fallen through, but there's more than one way to skin a cat.

meaning: to strongly disapprove
meaning_uz: qattiq ma'qullamaslik uchun
usage: Your father would turn over in his grave if he could hear the way you are talking to me now.

meaning: to do something that makes you look stupid and attracts other people's attention
meaning_uz: ahmoqona ko'rinishga ega bo'lgan va boshqa odamlarning diqqatini o'ziga tortadigan biror ish qilish
usage: I wasn't going to make a spectacle of myself just to give you a laugh!

meaning: to be nice to someone, by flattery or other means, before delivering bad news or asking for a favor
meaning_uz: kimgadir xushomad yoki boshqa yo'llar bilan xushmuomala bo'lish, yomon xabar yetkazishdan yoki yaxshilik so'rashdan oldin
usage: I tried to butter up my father by mowing the lawn before I asked to borrow the car.

meaning: a good example of something
meaning_uz: biror narsaga yaxshi misol
usage: Supermarkets often charge too much for goods. Bananas are a case in point.

meaning: to make a bad situation less serious
meaning_uz: yomon vaziyatni kamroq jiddiy qilish uchun
usage: He lost his job, but he has enough money in the bank to soften the blow.

meaning: to start behaving in a different, usually preferable, way
meaning_uz: o'zini boshqacha, odatda afzal, yo'l bilan boshlash uchun
usage: After I got in yet another fight at school, the headmaster told me that I had to mend my ways or else I'd be expelled.

meaning: by a large amount, by a lot
meaning_uz: katta miqdorda, ko'p miqdorda
usage: We won that game by a wide margin! I think the final score was 10-1.

meaning: believing or imagining things that appear to be attractive or exciting, but are not real
meaning_uz: jozibali yoki hayajonli bo'lib ko'rinadigan, ammo haqiqiy bo'lmagan narsalarga ishonish yoki tasavvur qilish
usage: The ideal of a perfectly fair society is just make-believe.

idiom: Wear Your Heart on Your Sleeve
meaning: to make your feelings and emotions obvious rather than hiding them
meaning_uz: his-tuyg'ularingizni, his-tuyg'ularingizni yashirishdan ko'ra, ochiq-oydin ko'rsatish uchun
usage: You always know where John stands because he wears his heart on his sleeve.

meaning: to be having a successful or lucky period
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatli yoki omadli davrga ega bo'lish
usage: Pippa won five games in a row and it was obvious she was on a roll.

meaning: the cheapest, worst, or lowest in quality
meaning_uz: sifat jihatidan eng arzon, eng yomon yoki eng past
usage: Our washing machine broke down after just two months of use, but that's what we get for buying the bottom of the barrel.

meaning: to show that you can deal with a difficult situation successfully
meaning_uz: qiyin vaziyatni muvaffaqiyatli bartaraf etish mumkinligini ko'rsatish uchun
usage: John was able to rise to the occasion and make the conference a success.

meaning: if something is not your cup of tea, it is not the type of thing of that you like
meaning_uz: biror narsa sizning piyolangiz bo'lmasa, bu sizga yoqadigan narsa turi emas
usage: Thanks for inviting me, but ballet isn't really my cup of tea.

meaning: to increase something, often in strength
meaning_uz: biror narsani ko'paytirishga, ko'pincha kuch-quvvatda
usage: With all these protesters here, we definitely need to beef up security.

meaning: a way of dealing with or avoiding a problem
meaning_uz: muammo bilan shug'ullanish yoki undan qochish yo'li
usage: The only way around this is that we get married without their blessings. They are our parents and will forgive us one day.

idiom: have a foot in both camps
meaning: to be connected to two groups with opposing interests
meaning_uz: qarama-qarshi manfaatlarga ega bo'lgan ikki guruhga aloqador bo'lishi
usage: When my friends split up, I felt like I had a foot in both camps.

meaning: to lose the skills, conviction, or energy that helped make one a success before
meaning_uz: oldin muvaffaqiyatga erishishga yordam bergan ko'nikma, ishonch yoki kuchni yo'qotish uchun
usage: At one point I was considered one of the best tennis players in North America, but I lost my edge during college.

meaning: to avoid utilizing or emphasizing one's talents, to conceal one's good ideas or talents
meaning_uz: o'z iste'dodidan foydalanmaslik yoki ta'kidlamaslik, o'z ezgu g'oyalari yoki iste'dodlarini yashirish uchun
usage: Jane has some good ideas, but she doesn't speak very often. She hides her light under a bushel.

meaning: firmly or permanently established, not subject to change, unalterable
meaning_uz: o'zgarishiga bo'ysunmaydigan, o'zgarmas qat'iy yoki doimiy joriy
usage: The healthcare law looks promising, but we'll have to wait until it's cast in concrete before we know exactly what it will do.

meaning: to think something unpleasant might have happened
meaning_uz: yoqimsiz narsa sodir bo'lishi mumkin deb o'ylash
usage: We hoped that they would be found safe and uninjured, but secretly we feared the worst.

meaning: with love and care
meaning_uz: muhabbat va g'amxo'rlik bilan
usage: His presents may be small and humble, but I cherish them because all of them are sealed with a kiss.

meaning: a situation, circumstance, or experience that is fraught with disorder, difficulty, confusion, stress, etc
meaning_uz: tartibsizlik, qiyinchilik, chalkashlik, stress va boshqalar bilan to'lib-toshgan vaziyat, vaziyat yoki tajriba
usage: Dan's and David's marriage has been in troubled waters for a few years, so their divorce seemed inevitable to a lot of us.

meaning: to win by a very small amount
meaning_uz: juda oz miqdorda g'alaba qozonish uchun
usage: I ran the fastest race I could, but I only won by a nose.

meaning: to annoy someone
meaning_uz: birovni g'azablantirish uchun
usage: He was known as an arrogant player who rubbed his teammates the wrong way.

meaning: to do something so that one no longer has the desire to do it anymore
meaning_uz: endi bir kishi buni amalga oshirish istagi bo'lmasligi uchun biror ish qilish
usage: He's been talking about skydiving for so long, I'm just glad he's finally going to get it out of his system.

meaning: used to convey that you cannot understand what is being said or written
meaning_uz: aytilayotgan yoki yozilayotgan gaplarni tushuna olmasligingizni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi
usage: I tried reading that science journal, but it was all Greek to me.

meaning: a mild reprimand or punishment
meaning_uz: engil tanbeh yoki jazo
usage: The few perpetrators that were prosecuted only got a slap on the wrist.

meaning: a person who takes little or no exercise and watches a lot of television
meaning_uz: kam yoki hech qanday mashg'ulot olib, ko'p televizor ko'radigan odam
usage: I spoiled my body being a couch potato I am going to join the gym right now.

meaning: a situation where the outcome is not decided until the very end
meaning_uz: natijasi oxirigacha hal qilinmagan vaziyat
usage: With both teams being equally matched, the match was very exiting and went down to the wire.

idiom: be in the lap of the gods
meaning: to be out of one's control or power
meaning_uz: o'z nazoratidan yoki kuchidan chetda bo'lishi
usage: The doctors have done everything possible for him, so his recovery now is in the lap of the gods.

meaning: to begin doing something more carefully or cautiously; to regain or tighten control of someone or something
meaning_uz: biror ishni ehtiyotkorlik bilan yoki ehtiyotkorlik bilan bajarishni boshlash; qayta tiklash yoki birov yoki biror narsa ustidan nazoratni kuchaytirish uchun
usage: I wish those parents would tighten the rein on their kids, the little devils are tearing the place apart!

meaning: used to describe or refer to something that is pleasant to contemplate but is very unlikely to be realized
meaning_uz: o'ylab ko'rish yoqimli bo'lgan, ammo amalga oshirilishi ehtimoldan xoli bo'lmagan narsani tasvirlash yoki nazarda tutish uchun ishlatiladi
usage: Don't throw away a decent offer in pursuit of pie in the sky.

meaning: a place or a social circle that is characterized by effete academic intelligence and thus is out of touch with or aloof from the realities of life
meaning_uz: effete akademik aql-idrok bilan xarakterlanadigan va shu tariqa hayot realliklari bilan aloqadan chetda bo'lgan yoki undan befarq bo'lgan joy yoki ijtimoiy doira
usage: Academics sitting in ivory towers have no understanding of what is important for ordinary people.

meaning: in or into a position where one is not joined or supported by anyone else
meaning_uz: boshqa birov tomonidan qo'shilmagan yoki qo'llab-quvvatlanmaydigan lavozimda yoki lavozimga
usage: I wouldn't go out on a limb like this if I didn't have the data to justify it.

meaning: anything that is common, inexpensive, and easy to get or available any where
meaning_uz: keng tarqalgan, arzon va har qanday joyda olish yoki mavjud bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday narsa
usage: People with your skills are a dime a dozen these days.

meaning: unpolished, imperfect, or unkempt; somewhat lacking in refinement, sophistication, manners
meaning_uz: qo'yilmagan, nomukammal yoki undirilgan; biroz poklanish, zo'rlash, odob-axloqda yetishmaslik
usage: This old truck's a little rough around the edges, but it's still the most reliable vehicle I've owned.

meaning: to be able to correct or hide an action that could have caused embarrassment
meaning_uz: uyalishga sabab bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan harakatni to'g'rilay olish yoki yashirish
usage: The lawyer was not able to save face after his client made such an error at the hearing.

meaning: to make a problem worse
meaning_uz: muammoni yanada og'irlashtirish uchun
usage: Shouting at a crying child just adds fuel to the fire.

meaning: very briefly, giving only the main points
meaning_uz: juda qisqa, faqat asosiy nuqtalarni berish
usage: To put it in a nutshell, the servers are crashing because of an issue with our power supply.

meaning: if something is done under the table, it is a secret, hidden action
meaning_uz: jadval ostida biror ish qilinsa, u maxfiy, yashirin amal
usage: They offered him money under the table to change his mind.

meaning: performing very enthusiastically, adeptly, or successfully
meaning_uz: juda jo'shqin, mohirona yoki muvaffaqiyatli bajarish
usage: The team has been on fire lately, winning 11 of its last 12 games.

meaning: unrealistic beliefs about the amount of power and influence one has
meaning_uz: ega bo'lgan kuch va ta'sir miqdori to'g'risidagi real bo'lmagan e'tiqodlar
usage: You're just an intern, so you definitely have delusions of grandeur if you think the boss is going to listen to you!

meaning: to annoy someone very much
meaning_uz: birovni juda g'azablantirish uchun
usage: That sort of attitude really gets my goat.

meaning: to travel a long distance,  to review a large amount of information or discuss many topics
meaning_uz: uzoq masofani bosib o'tish, ko'p miqdordagi ma'lumotlarni ko'rib chiqish yoki ko'plab mavzularni muhokama qilish
usage: We need to cover a lot of ground in American History before the exam date.

meaning: something that oppresses people, a burden
meaning_uz: odamlarga zulm qiladigan narsa, yuk
usage: The Smiths have a huge mortgage that has become a yoke around their necks.

meaning: wait a moment or be patient because you are moving too quickly or thoughtlessly
meaning_uz: bir lahza kuting yoki sabr qiling, chunki siz juda tez yoki o'ylamasdan harakat qilyapsiz
usage: Whoa, hold your horses, kids. We're going to sing before we start eating cake.

meaning: to worsen an unfavorable situation
meaning_uz: noqulay vaziyatni yanada og'irlashtirishga
usage: As if the hostile takeover weren't enough, to add insult to injury they scrapped ninety percent of our products and replaced them with their own.

idiom: the apple doesn't fall far from the tree
meaning: a child usually has a similar character or similar qualities to his or her parents
meaning_uz: bola odatda ota-onasiga o'xshash xarakterga yoki o'xshash sifatlarga ega
usage: Her daughter soon showed her own musical talent, proving that the apple doesn't fall far from the tree.

meaning: suddenly
meaning_uz: birdaniga
usage: On the hike, I felt really tired all of a sudden and had to sit down and rest.

meaning: negatively, under unfavorable circumstances
meaning_uz: salbiy, noqulay vaziyatlarda
usage: The once-beloved mayor has been seen in a bad light ever since news of his tax-evasion scandal came to public attention.

meaning: the most basic, important aspects or practical details of a subject or situation
meaning_uz: mavzu yoki vaziyatning eng asosiy, muhim tomonlari yoki amaliy tafsilotlarini
usage: Instead of starting with the nitty-gritty, the teacher introduced the topic with a live demonstration.

idiom: take your eye off the ball
meaning: to not give your attention to what you are doing at the time
meaning_uz: vaqtida qilayotgan ishlaringizga e'tibor bermaslik
usage: If you're a manager, you can't afford to take your eye off the ball for one minute.

meaning: something that is promising in the beginning but fizzles out later
meaning_uz: boshida va'da berayotgan, ammo keyinchalik g'oyib bo'lgan narsa
usage: His initial good performances were a mere flash in the pan. Nowadays, he delivers only mediocre work.

meaning: a talk intended to make someone feel more courageous or enthusiastic
meaning_uz: birovni yanada mard yoki jo'shqin his qilishga qaratilgan nutq
usage: I was to meet my editor for a pep talk.

meaning: to veer off in very unexpected directions, to lose or change focus in surprising or bizarre ways
meaning_uz: juda kutilmagan yo'nalishlarda burilib ketish, hayratlanarli yoki g'alati yo'llar bilan diqqatni yo'qotish yoki o'zgartirish
usage: The manager's speech really jumped the tracks about halfway through, shifting into a weird commentary on the nature of corporate America.

meaning: to be calm or patient or to stop making pressing demands, requests, or solicitations
meaning_uz: sokin yoki sabr-toqatli bo'lish yoki muhim talablar, so'rovlar yoki so'rovlar berishni to'xtatish uchun
usage: Janet needs to hold her water and just let the committee do its job.

meaning: vintage, from an earlier time, retro
meaning_uz: vint, avvalgi davrdan boshlab, retro
usage: Her parents are pretty old school when it comes to living together before marriage.

meaning: a person who gets up, arrives, or acts before the usual or expected time
meaning_uz: o'rnidan turib, kelgan yoki odatdagi yoki kutilgan vaqtdan oldin harakat qiladigan shaxs
usage: There were some early birds who arrived before the party was set to start.

meaning: very nervous, distressed, or upset
meaning_uz: juda asabiy, g'amgin yoki g'amgin
usage: Sam is in a lather because she doesn't think her job interview went well.

meaning: an event that triggers a sense of urgency or the motivation to make a change
meaning_uz: shoshilinchlik hissini qo'zg'atuvchi hodisa yoki o'zgarish qilishga bo'lgan motivatsiya
usage: Harold's sudden chest pain was the wake-up call he needed to finally see his doctor.

meaning: not always pleasant
meaning_uz: har doim yoqimli emas
usage: Being in a relationship is not all moonlight and roses, it requires a lot of compromises.

meaning: the time at which a change or an effect cannot be stopped
meaning_uz: o'zgarish yoki ta'sirni to'xtatib bo'lmaydigan vaqt
usage: The earth has already passed the tipping point in terms of global warming.

meaning: something that you say when you tell someone about something that you are certain will happen in the future
meaning_uz: birovga ishonchingiz komil bo'lgan narsa haqida gapirganda aytgan narsangiz kelajakda sodir bo'ladi
usage: Mark my words, Penny will be glad she made this decision one day.

meaning: to be featured in news articles in newspapers, as due to being particularly important, popular, fashionable, etc
meaning_uz: gazeta yangiliklar maqolalar namoyish etiladi, chunki ayniqsa muhim bo'lish, mashhur, moda, va hokazo
usage: The pop star made the papers yesterday after his latest run-in with police.

meaning: to snitch or inform on someone to a person of higher authority
meaning_uz: yuqori mansabga ega bo'lgan shaxsga birovni snitch qilish yoki xabardor qilish uchun
usage: Timmy is such a teacher's pet, always ready to drop a dime on any of the other students he thinks are misbehaving.

meaning: a word or phrase used to describe a broad range of similarly related things, usually resulting in diluting the specific meaning of individual items
meaning_uz: shunga o'xshash keng ko'lamli narsalarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan so'z yoki ibora, odatda, alohida narsalarning o'ziga xos ma'nosini kamaytirishga olib keladi
usage: "Idiom" is often used as a blanket term for any element of language that is used strangely or uniquely by its users.

meaning: to cry or complain about something when nothing is really wrong
meaning_uz: hech narsa haqiqatan ham noto'g'ri bo'lmaganda yig'lash yoki biror narsadan shikoyat qilish
usage: I'm sure there's no real crisis - Janet is always crying wolf so that we'll do her work for her.

meaning: to scream very loudly
meaning_uz: juda baland ovozda qichqirishga
usage: You should have heard my toddler scream the place down when she dropped her ice cream.

meaning: to cause a lot of problems
meaning_uz: juda ko'p muammolarni keltirib chiqaradigan
usage: Termites have wreaked havoc on the structural integrity of our house, unfortunately.

idiom: see someone or something in a new light
meaning: to perceive, regard, or understand someone or something in a new, typically more positive way
meaning_uz: birovni yoki biror narsani yangicha, odatda, salbiyroq tarzda idrok etish, e'tiborga olish yoki tushunish
usage: You really start to see your parents in a new light once you have children of your own.

meaning: to be very pleased
meaning_uz: juda mamnun bo'lish uchun
usage: She was over the moon with her new bike.

meaning: to tell a seemingly small or harmless lie, often in order not to offend or upset someone
meaning_uz: kichik yoki zararsiz ko'rinadigan yolg'onni aytish, ko'pincha birovni g'azablantirmaslik yoki g'azablantirmaslik uchun
usage: I told my wife a white lie saying that she looked fabulous in her new clothes.

idiom: the pot calling the kettle black
meaning: something you say that means people should not criticize someone else for a fault that they have themselves
meaning_uz: siz aytadigan narsa, demak, odamlar o'zlari bor ayb uchun boshqa birovni tanqid qilmasliklari kerak
usage: Elliott accused me of being selfish. Talk about the pot calling the kettle black!

meaning: to humble or lower the dignity of someone, to make someone aware that they are not as important, respected, influential as they think
meaning_uz: kimningdir qadr-qimmatini kamtar qilish yoki pastga tushirish, birovni o'ylaganchalik muhim, hurmatga sazovor, ta'sirli emasligidan xabardor qilish
usage: When he tried to take charge, she immediately put him in his place.

meaning: a good opportunity that isn't available to everyone
meaning_uz: hamma uchun mavjud bo'lmagan yaxshi imkoniyat
usage: Jason heard about a new investment opportunity that has the potential to be very profitable. He definitely wants a bite of the cherry.

meaning: a wild, chaotic, ridiculous, or disastrous event
meaning_uz: yovvoyi, xaotik, kulgili yoki halokatli hodisa
usage: Did you go to that party last night? What a gong show!

meaning: one who is very active, industrious, or busy
meaning_uz: Kimki mazavla boʻlsa va taqvodor boʻlsa.
usage: Can we meet next week instead? I'm a busy bee right now.

meaning: a great deal of fuss, noise, fanfare, or protestation over something of little or no substance, importance, or relevance
meaning_uz: juda ko'p g'alayon, shovqin, fan yoki kam yoki hech qanday narsa, muhimlik yoki ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan narsa ustidan norozilik
usage: My opponent has been making outlandish claims about my track record so as to foment distrust in the public, but I assure you, he is offering great cry and little wool.

meaning: a short or limited period of time in which one has a favorable opportunity to do, obtain, or accomplish something
meaning_uz: biror ishni amalga oshirish, olish yoki amalga oshirish uchun qulay imkoniyatga ega bo'lgan qisqa yoki cheklangan muddat
usage: The summit offers a window of opportunity for the two countries to reach a peace agreement.

meaning: someone or something that is new and different and makes everything seem more exciting
meaning_uz: kimdir yoki yangi va boshqacha bo'lgan va hamma narsani yanada hayajonli ko'rsatadigan narsa
usage: After dating a series of boring men, Sarah found Peter's adventurous nature to be like a breath of fresh air.

meaning: to deal with someone in a way that shows a lack of respect
meaning_uz: hurmatsizlikni ko'rsatadigan tarzda birov bilan muomalada bo'lish
usage: I'm not surprised that so many of your employees are quitting - you treat them like dirt!

meaning: a lot of value for little cost
meaning_uz: kam xarajat uchun ko'p qiymat
usage: That restaurant is great, and the prices are very reasonable - you get a lot of bang for your buck.

meaning: confused
meaning_uz: sarosimaga tushgan
usage: I'm all at sea with the new computer system.

meaning: to do or undertake something redundant, pointless, or futile
meaning_uz: ortiqcha, befoyda yoki behuda ish qilish yoki uni amalga oshirish uchun
usage: The councilor's plans to improve the economy by increasing taxes simply would be bringing owls to Athens.

meaning: to admit that one is wrong, usually when doing so triggers great embarrassment or shame
meaning_uz: birining noto'g'ri ekanligini tan olish, odatda bunday qilish katta uyat yoki uyatga sabab bo'lganda
usage: Ugh, now that my idea has failed, I'll have to eat crow in the board meeting tomorrow.

meaning: miscellaneous articles or remnants
meaning_uz: turli maqolalar yoki qoldiqlar
usage: We bought batteries for the radio and a few other odds and ends.

meaning: a person's livelihood or main source of income, something everyday or ordinary
meaning_uz: insonning tirikchiligi yoki asosiy daromad manbai, kundalik yoki oddiy narsa
usage: Their bread and butter is reporting local events.

meaning: a long time
meaning_uz: uzoq vaqt
usage: I haven't been here in donkey's years - I can't believe how much the town has changed.

meaning: to get married
meaning_uz: turmush qurish uchun
usage: Did you hear? Bill and David got hitched last week!

meaning: unhappy, dejected
meaning_uz: baxtsiz, g'amgin
usage: The bad news left her feeling really down in the mouth.

meaning: in many small fragments
meaning_uz: ko'plab mayda parchalarda
usage: We heard about the boss's affair in bits and pieces from her secretary.

idiom: The early bird gets the worm
meaning: said to advise someone that they will have an advantage if they do something immediately or before anyone else does it
meaning_uz: birovga biror ishni darhol yoki boshqa birov qilishidan oldin qilsalar, afzallikka ega bo'lishlarini maslahat berish uchun
usage: If you see a job that interests you, apply as soon as possible. The early bird gets the worm.

meaning: to increase, expand, or grow into something much larger in size, scope, or scale than something was initially, especially in a short space of time
meaning_uz: hajmi, ko'lami yoki o'lchovi avvaliga qaraganda ancha kattaroq narsaga ko'payishi, kengayishi yoki o'sishi, ayniqsa qisqa fursatda
usage: The question of pay suddenly mushroomed into a major matter when the management insulted the staff.

meaning: shared interests, beliefs, or opinions between two people or groups of people who disagree about most other subjects
meaning_uz: ikki kishi yoki boshqa aksariyat mavzular bo'yicha ixtilofga tushgan odamlar guruhi o'rtasidagi umumiy qiziqishlar, e'tiqodlar yoki fikrlar
usage: It seems increasingly unlikely that the two sides will find any common ground.

meaning: to frighten someone very much
meaning_uz: birovni juda qo'rqitish uchun
usage: This is a film that will chill you to the marrow.

meaning: to do something that will cause a series of actions to start
meaning_uz: bir qator amallarning boshlanishiga sabab bo'ladigan biror ishni bajarishga
usage: We've been planning the details for months, but it's ultimately up to the boss to set the wheels in motion.

meaning: to keep a place, group, or organization very well-organized and operating efficiently
meaning_uz: joy, guruh yoki tashkilotni juda yaxshi tashkil etish va samarali faoliyat ko'rsata
usage: Jane sure ran a tight ship around here. The department has devolved into chaos without her leadership.

meaning: to gradually end, often in a disappointing or weak way
meaning_uz: bosqichma-bosqich tugashi, ko'pincha ko'ngilsiz yoki kuchsiz tarzda
usage: They went to different universities and their relationship just fizzled out.

meaning: to be able to act without having to depend on anyone
meaning_uz: hech kimga bog'liq bo'lmasdan harakat qila olishi
usage: She is a strong woman and can paddle her own canoe without having a man in her life.

idiom: between a rock and a hard place
meaning: facing two equally unpleasant, dangerous, or risky alternatives, where the avoidance of one ensures encountering the harm of the other
meaning_uz: ikkita teng yoqimsiz, xavfli yoki xavfli alternativaga duch keladi, bu erda biridan qochish ikkinchisining zarariga duch kelishni ta'minlaydi
usage: You were really between a rock and a hard place when you had to choose between your career and your relationship.

meaning: to cause discord between two people or things
meaning_uz: Ikki kishi yoki narsalar o'rtasida nizo keltirib chiqaradigan
usage: I used to be close friends with Tiffany, but once she started dating my ex-boyfriend, it really drove a wedge between us.

meaning: to say that someone is telling the truth, to support or help someone
meaning_uz: birov haqiqatni aytyapti, deb aytish, birovni qo'llab-quvvatlash yoki yordam berish
usage: That's exactly what happened - Cleo will back me up.

meaning: on a whim or fancy; for fun or as a joke
meaning_uz: xohish yoki xohish bilan; ko'ngilxushlik uchun yoki hazil sifatida
usage: On a lark, we all decided to ditch our Friday classes and drive to New York City for the weekend.

idiom: take the words out of somebody's mouth
meaning: to say something that another person was just about to say or was thinking
meaning_uz: boshqa odam endigina aytmoqchi bo'lgan yoki o'ylayotgan narsani aytishga
usage: "What a rude and obnoxious man!" "You took the words right out of my mouth!"

meaning: unable to function or move, inoperable
meaning_uz: ishlay olmaydi yoki harakatlana olmadi, ishlamaydigan
usage: The project is out of funds and dead in the water for the time being.

meaning: in a sudden and abrupt manner
meaning_uz: to'satdan va to'satdan
usage: I had to quit drinking cold turkey.

meaning: to cutoff/destroy all ways to go back to a an earlier place, situation or relationship
meaning_uz: avvalgi joyga, vaziyatga yoki munosabatlarga qaytishning barcha yo'llarini kesib tashlash/yo'q qilish
usage: Not only did he quit his job, but also burnt his bridges by publicly cursing his boss and colleagues.

meaning: said when one thing needs to be prioritized over others
meaning_uz: bir narsani boshqalardan ustun qo'yish kerak bo'lganda aytilgan
usage: I know we have a lot to discuss, but first things first, has anyone heard back from the client?

meaning: something that is very unpleasant but must be accepted
meaning_uz: juda yoqimsiz bo'lgan, ammo qabul qilinishi kerak bo'lgan narsa
usage: Losing to a younger player was a bitter pill to swallow.

meaning: to try very hard to get something you want
meaning_uz: o'zingiz xohlagan narsani olish uchun juda ko'p harakat qilish
usage: We fought tooth and nail to get the route of the new road changed.

meaning: to express one's repressed feelings about something
meaning_uz: biror narsaga nisbatan repressiyaga uchragan his-tuyg'ularini ifodalash uchun
usage: I'm sorry but I just have to get something off my chest. How could you treat me like that last night?

meaning: to discover the truth about a situation
meaning_uz: vaziyat to'g'risidagi haqiqatni kashf etish uchun
usage: I'm not sure what is causing the problem, but I'm determined to get to the bottom of it.

meaning: a time when the effect of a past mistake is experienced or when a crime is punished
meaning_uz: o'tmishdagi xatoning ta'siri boshdan kechirilgan yoki jinoyat jazoga tortilgan davr
usage: Well, it's the day of reckoning now - whether you studied or not, you have to take the test.

meaning: a situation in which danger or problems are barely avoided
meaning_uz: xavf yoki muammolardan oz qochadigan vaziyat
usage: That guy barely made it over the tracks before the train came. What a narrow escape!

meaning: the absolute lowest or worst point
meaning_uz: mutlaq eng past yoki eng yomon nuqta
usage: The price of milk is at rock bottom right now, which is great for consumers, but bad for dairy farmers.

meaning: to hit the circle in the center of a target, to be correct or accurate, to have the desired effect
meaning_uz: nishon markazida aylanaga urilishi, to'g'ri yoki to'g'ri bo'lishi, istalgan ta'sirga ega bo'lishi
usage: You really hit the bull's eye with that answer, good job.

idiom: paint something with a broad brush
meaning: to describe or characterize something in very general, vague, or broad terms, ignoring or neglecting to include specific details
meaning_uz: biror narsani juda umumiy, noaniq yoki keng so'zlar bilan ifodalash yoki xarakterlash, aniq tafsilotlarni kiritishga e'tibor bermaslik yoki e'tiborsiz qoldirish
usage: When asked about how he would stabilize the economy, the candidate painted his plan with a broad brush, resorting to vague claims about creating jobs and getting people back to work.

meaning: to behave in a moral way when other people are not behaving morally
meaning_uz: boshqa odamlar o'zini axloqli tutmayotganda o'zini axloqiy jihatdan
usage: Taking the high road, Alvarez never fired back with insults of his own.

meaning: something important or unusual that happens suddenly or unexpectedly
meaning_uz: to'satdan yoki kutilmaganda sodir bo'ladigan muhim yoki g'ayrioddiy narsa
usage: The resignation of the chairman came like a bolt from the blue.

meaning: never surrender or give up, don't stop trying
meaning_uz: hech qachon taslim bo'lmang yoki taslim bo'lmang, urinishdan to'xtamang
usage: No matter how many things go wrong, never say die - we'll find a way to finish this on time.

meaning: if you say that something bad serves someone right, you mean that that person deserves it
meaning_uz: biror yomon narsa birovga to'g'ri xizmat qiladi desangiz, demak, o'sha odam bunga loyiq
usage: "He hit me!" "It serves you right. You shouldn't have been so mean to him."

meaning: to still be confused about something even after it has been explained to you
meaning_uz: sizga tushuntirilgandan keyin ham biror narsa haqida chalkashib ketish
usage: I've read the instructions twice and I'm still none the wiser.

meaning: use against your opponent the same methods he or she is using against you
meaning_uz: raqibingizga nisbatan aynan sizga qarshi qo'llayotgan usullardan foydalanish
usage: When evangelists would come to our house and try to convert us, Mother would fight fire with fire and try to convert them to her religion.

meaning: affected by or made to be involved in a conflict or issue that one is not a part of
meaning_uz: bir qismi bo'lmagan nizo yoki masala bilan shug'ullanish uchun ta'sir ko'rsatadi yoki
usage: I was caught in the crossfire of their argument over the budget, but I refused to take sides and told them to work it out on their own.

meaning: to prepare for difficult times
meaning_uz: qiyin kunlarga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun
usage: When you're coming down with a cold, all you can do is batten down the hatches and wait for the body to fight it off.

meaning: to give a false or insincere declaration that one supposedly values, supports, respects, or believes in something
meaning_uz: biror narsani qadrlaydigan, qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan, hurmat qiladigan yoki ishonadigan yolg'on yoki samimiy deklaratsiya berish
usage: I'm tired of politicians who do nothing but pay lip service to the major issues affecting our country.

meaning: said when there will be trouble for someone, or someone will be punished, if they do a particular thing
meaning_uz: kimgadir qiyinchilik bo'ladi, yoki kimdir jazolanadi, muayyan ishni qilsalar
usage: This is the second time he's been sent home from school this month, so woe betide him if it happens again!

idiom: on the tip of your tongue
meaning: almost remember something
meaning_uz: biror narsani deyarli eslab qolish
usage: John had the answer on the tip of his tongue, but Anne said it first.

meaning: to be in trouble or experiencing difficulties
meaning_uz: qiyinchilikka duch kelishi yoki qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishi
usage: I was in the soup after I dented my mom's brand new car.

meaning: to scold, reprimand, or reprove one severely for an error or mistake
meaning_uz: xato yoki xato uchun birni qattiq tanbeh berish, tanbeh berish yoki tanbeh berish
usage: I was read the riot act by my boss last week for messing up the accounting software.

meaning: to be ultimately left up to someone to decide
meaning_uz: nihoyat qaror qabul qilish uchun birovga qoldirilishi
usage: I think we should use the extra money to invest in some new computer upgrades, but it's the boss's call in the end.

meaning: having no legal force
meaning_uz: qonuniy kuchga ega bo'lmagan
usage: The change in the law makes the previous agreement null and void.

idiom: throw a wrench in the works
meaning: to do something that prevents a plan or activity from succeeding
meaning_uz: reja yoki faoliyatning muvaffaqiyatga erishishiga to'sqinlik qiladigan ishni bajarishga
usage: We were hoping to get the project started in June but the funding was withdrawn so that rather threw a wrench in the works.

meaning: read all the way through from the beginning to the end
meaning_uz: boshidan oxirigacha o'qib
usage: That book was so thrilling that I read that book from cover to cover in one day.

meaning: easy to prove or answer
meaning_uz: isbotlash yoki javob berish oson
usage: He thought it was an open and shut case until the prime suspect was murdered.

meaning: to impact one on a deep, emotionally meaningful level; to stir a strong emotion in one, especially sadness, pity, etc
meaning_uz: chuqur, hissiy jihatdan mazmunli darajaga ta'sir ko'rsatish; birida kuchli his-tuyg'ularni qo'zg'atish, ayniqsa, qayg'u, rahm-shafqat va boshqalar
usage: When the lights came on, the room was silent, and you could tell the documentary had pierced everyone's heart.

meaning: to be very hardworking, enthusiastic, and/or skillful
meaning_uz: juda mehnatkash, g'ayratli va/yoki mahoratli bo'lishi
usage: Tom might not be the friendliest coworker in the world, but he's no slouch when it comes to running the company's IT systems.

idiom: have a bee in your bonnet
meaning: to keep talking about something again and again because you think it is very important
meaning_uz: biror narsa haqida qayta-qayta gapirishda davom etish, chunki siz buni juda muhim deb hisoblaysiz
usage: She never stops talking about dieting - she's got a real bee in her bonnet about it.

meaning: lacking experience, immature
meaning_uz: tajribasi yo'qligi, yetuk bo'lmagan
usage: The job put a lot of responsibility on someone who was still wet behind the ears, but he learned fast.

meaning: to start or recoil, as from shock, surprise, or fear
meaning_uz: boshlash yoki qayta tiklashga, xuddi shok, hayrat yoki qo'rquvdan
usage: I positively jumped in my skin when I heard the door bang open in the middle of the night.

meaning: to be at the height of or experience success or prosperity
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyat yoki farovonlikning eng yuqori cho'qqisida bo'lishi yoki
usage: Any of you who is determined and willing to put in hard work will have her day eventually.

meaning: to become familiar with and confident in a new situation
meaning_uz: bilan tanishish va yangi vaziyatga ishonch hosil qilish
usage: Did it take you long to find your feet when you started your new job?

idiom: hit one where it hurts most
meaning: to attack one in the area that is most vulnerable or that will result in the most harm
meaning_uz: eng zaif bo'lgan yoki eng ko'p zarar keltiradigan hududda bittasiga hujum qilish
usage: By questioning his parenting, Gina hit Ken where it hurt most.

meaning: a person's secondary or alternative personality
meaning_uz: insonning ikkilamchi yoki alternativ xulq
usage: Superman is Clark Kent's alter ego.

meaning: a secret and improper influence
meaning_uz: maxfiy va noto'g'ri ta'sir
usage: He did not deseve the job, however, he got it by backstairs influence.

meaning: talking continuously about something in a noisy or eager way
meaning_uz: shovqinli yoki intiluvchan tarzda biror narsa haqida to'xtovsiz gapirish
usage: The opposition was in full cry in Parliament last night over the proposed changes to the education bill.

meaning: to think of something that is outside of or beyond what is considered usual, traditional, or conventional, to think innovatively
meaning_uz: odatdagi, an'anaviy yoki an'anaviy hisoblangan narsadan tashqarida yoki undan tashqarida bo'lgan narsani o'ylab topish, yangicha fikrlash
usage: OK, team, we really need to think outside of the box if we're going to impress the CEO.

meaning: rising in power or influence
meaning_uz: hokimiyat yoki ta'sir ko'rsatishda ko'tarilish
usage: The reformers are in the ascendant.

meaning: a story that is obviously not true, especially one given as an excuse
meaning_uz: to'g'ri emasligi aniq bo'lgan hikoya, ayniqsa, bahona sifatida berilgan
usage: He gave me some cock-and-bull story about having to be at his cousin's engagement party.

meaning: an extremely long time from now in the past or future
meaning_uz: o'tmishda yoki kelajakda bundan nihoyatda uzoq vaqt
usage: It all happened when I was at college, which seems light years away now that I'm over 50.

meaning: to make something more enticing, alluring, or attractive, especially from a financial perspective
meaning_uz: jozibadorroq, jozibali yoki jozibali, ayniqsa, moliyaviy nuqtai nazardan
usage: He was still unsure whether he wanted the job, so the company offered to sweeten the pot with an excellent pension plan.

meaning: pressurize someone into doing something that they are reluctant to do
meaning_uz: birovni o'zlari istamagan ishni qilishga majbur qilish
usage: I didn't want to go to the exhibition, but Linda twisted my arm.

meaning: go wrong
meaning_uz: noto'g'ri yo'l tuting
usage: We'd planned to go away for the weekend, but it all went pear-shaped.

meaning: to escape from someone
meaning_uz: birovdan qochib qutulish uchun
usage: All of us chased the thief but he managed to give us the slip by climbing over the high wall.

meaning: a view looking down at an object or area from a high elevation, a consideration of a problem or situation from a comprehensive perspective
meaning_uz: ob'ekt yoki hududga yuqori ko'tarilishdan pastga qarab qarash, muammo yoki vaziyatni kompleks nuqtai nazardan ko'rib chiqish
usage: In order to determine why the company was headed towards a fiscal disaster, the CFO had to take a step back and get a bird's eye view of the situation so he could locate the cause of the problem.

meaning: a single thing or person that is spoiling a situation that could have been very positive or enjoyable
meaning_uz: juda ijobiy yoki zavqli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyatni talon-taroj qilayotgan yakka narsa yoki shaxs
usage: I'm looking forward to Sunday, the only fly in the ointment being the fact that I'll have to sit next to my mother-in-law.

meaning: said in order to avoid bad luck, either when you mention good luck that you have had in the past or when you mention hopes you have for the future
meaning_uz: yomon omaddan qochish uchun, ya'ni ilgari bo'lgan omadingizni aytib o'tganingizda yoki kelajakka bo'lgan umidlaringizni aytib o'tganingizda aytdi
usage: The deal will be agreed on Wednesday, knock on wood.

meaning: the detailed or complicated facts of something
meaning_uz: biror narsaning batafsil yoki murakkab faktlarini
usage: I know how to use computers, but I don't really understand the ins and outs of how they work.

meaning: an independent or uninhibited person, someone who does not conform to social norms or expectations
meaning_uz: mustaqil yoki taqiqlanmagan shaxs, ijtimoiy me'yor va umidlarga mos kelmaydigan
usage: Maria is too much of a free spirit to be working in a stuffy corporate environment.

meaning: escape or released from a tough situation
meaning_uz: qochish yoki qiyin vaziyatdan ozod qilish
usage: He was charged with leaking confidential information, but I got him off the hook by vouching for his integrity.

meaning: back to something that you don't want to do
meaning_uz: qilishni istamagan narsaga qaytish
usage: Well, it's Monday morning. Back to the salt mines.

meaning: to do everything you can to achieve something
meaning_uz: biror narsaga erishish uchun qo'lingizdan kelgan barcha ishni qilish
usage: I had to move heaven and earth to get a flight home during the Christmas season.

meaning: easily or conveniently accessed, accomplished, or achieved
meaning_uz: oson yoki qulay tarzda kirish, amalga oshirish yoki erishilgan
usage: Because the Internet is so easy to access these days, we have every resource imaginable at our fingertips!

meaning: a serious conversation between two people, usually close friends, in which they talk honestly about their feelings
meaning_uz: ikki kishi, odatda yaqin do'stlar o'rtasida jiddiy suhbat bo'lib o'tadigan bo'lib, bunda ular o'z his-tuyg'ulari haqida xolisona
usage: We had a heart-to-heart over a bottle of wine.

meaning: used to indicate the continual repetition of an action or sequence of events, typically in a way regarded as tiresomely predictable
meaning_uz: harakat yoki voqealar ketma-ketligini doimiy takrorlashini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi, odatda, charchagan bashoratli deb hisoblangan tarzda
usage: If the sun doesn't come out soon, I'm going to very sad. Rain, clouds, grey, cold. Rinse, repeat.

idiom: jump in at the deep end
meaning: to begin doing something very complex and/or unfamiliar, especially suddenly and without guidance, assistance, or preparation
meaning_uz: juda murakkab va/yoki notanish, ayniqsa, to'satdan va yo'l-yo'riqsiz, yordamsiz va tayyorlovsiz biror ishni boshlash uchun
usage: Those who go the furthest in life are the ones willing to jump in at the deep end when a great opportunity arises.

meaning: to distinctly regard one as being a certain type of person
meaning_uz: birini ma'lum bir turdagi shaxs deb alohida e'tiborga
usage: I had you pegged as a coward, but I'm impressed with how you stood up to that criminal.

meaning: very calm or very calmly, especially when this is surprising
meaning_uz: juda xotirjam yoki juda xotirjam, ayniqsa bu ajablanarli bo'lganda
usage: She walked in as cool as a cucumber, as if nothing had happened.

idiom: be a legend in one's own lifetime
meaning: to be very famous while you are still alive
meaning_uz: hali tirik bo'lganingizda juda mashhur bo'lish uchun
usage: Garbo was a legend in her own lifetime.

meaning: said when an event or performance has come to an end, or when someone or something has left a place, especially in a dramatic fashion
meaning_uz: tadbir yoki ijro yakuniga yetganda yoki biror kishi yoki biror narsa joy qoldirganda, ayniqsa dramatik tarzda
usage: I came here, to take photos of the tornado from near, but it turned away before reaching to us. Elvis has left the building.

meaning: to allow something to be done which is technically against the rules or not normally accepted
meaning_uz: qoidalarga texnik jihatdan qarshi bo'lgan yoki odatdagidan qabul qilinmagan biror ishni bajarishga ruxsat berish
usage: It's galling to know that the management team, who are so strict with the lower-level employees, all bend the rules to give themselves more vacation time and bigger bonuses.

meaning: put great effort to think of or remember something
meaning_uz: biror narsani o'ylash yoki eslash uchun katta kuch sarflang
usage: The detective kept racking his brain to solve the mystery when his eyes got stuck at the evidence kept on the table.

meaning: to be very successful and garner a lot of public attention
meaning_uz: juda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishi va omma e'tiborini ko'p to'plashi
usage: The low-budget indie movie is making a big splash with audiences worldwide.

meaning: a frightened or excited feeling
meaning_uz: qo'rqinchli yoki hayajonli tuyg'u
usage: At its most terrifying, his writing sends shivers up and down my spine.

idiom: be on a hiding to nothing
meaning: to be likely to fail, to be in a futile situation
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashi, behuda ahvolga
usage: You're on a hiding to nothing if you think you're going to get a raise out of the boss.

meaning: to seem suspicious
meaning_uz: shubhali ko'rinishga ega bo'lish
usage: Something about the deal smelled fishy - it was too good to be true.

meaning: to become unsteady or flustered due to having a strong emotional reaction to someone or something
meaning_uz: birovga yoki biror narsaga kuchli hissiy reaktsiyaga ega bo'lish tufayli sarsoba yoki shovqin-suronli bo'lish
usage: The thought of kissing her made me go weak at the knees.

meaning: someone or something that looks very similar to someone or something else
meaning_uz: kimgadir yoki boshqa narsaga juda o'xshash ko'rinadigan biror
usage: Susie was such a dead ringer for Kate Winslet that sometimes people would ask her for her autograph.

meaning: to enter into a situation or begin a process or journey that is particularly strange, problematic, difficult, complex, or chaotic, especially one that becomes increasingly so as it develops or unfolds
meaning_uz: vaziyatga kirish yoki ayniqsa g'alati, muammoli, qiyin, murakkab yoki xaotik bo'lgan jarayon yoki sayohatni boshlash, ayniqsa, u rivojlanishi yoki yuz berishi bilan tobora ko'payib borayotgan
usage: Owning your own business is a huge responsibility that not everyone is prepared for. Are you sure you're ready to go down the rabbit hole?

meaning: to spend time in sunlight, often by sunbathing
meaning_uz: vaqtni quyosh nurida o'tkazishga, ko'pincha quyosh botishi bilan
usage: I love laying on the beach and catching some rays.

meaning: an event or activity often performed or experienced as part of passing from one stage of life to another
meaning_uz: hayotning bir bosqichidan boshqasiga o'tish doirasida ko'pincha bajariladigan yoki tajriba orttirilgan hodisa yoki faoliyat
usage: Getting lost while trying to find their classrooms is kind of a rite of passage for freshmen at this school.

meaning: to be indicted, arrested, and/or tried
meaning_uz: ayblov eʼlon qilinishi, hibsga olinishi va/yoki sudga
usage: The CEO was had up for embezzling nearly 18 million dollars of company money.

meaning: in small portions, bit by bit
meaning_uz: kichik qismlarda, bit-bit
usage: The whole story is being revealed in dribs and drabs.

meaning: in a risky or uncertain situation
meaning_uz: xavfli yoki noaniq vaziyatda
usage: The student was on thin ice because he was absent from class too many times.

meaning: the area someone comes from, or the area where you are
meaning_uz: kimdir kelib chiqqan hudud, ya'ni siz bo'lgan hudud
usage: I'm surprised to see you in this neck of the woods.

meaning: try to find out whether something is likely to succeed
meaning_uz: biror narsa muvaffaqiyatga erishishi mumkinmi yoki yo'qligini bilishga harakat qiling
usage: Your idea might not be popular with people, so before you start marketing it you should test the waters.

meaning: in opposition or contrary to what is generally understood, assumed, practiced, or accepted
meaning_uz: qarshilikda yoki umuman tushunilgan, taxmin qilingan, amalda bo'lgan yoki qabul qilingan narsaga zid
usage: The artist always tried to go against the grain, ignoring the artistic trends of her day.

meaning: to do or complete something very near to its limit, especially of time
meaning_uz: qilish yoki uning chegarasiga juda yaqin bo'lgan ishni bajarish yoki tugatish, ayniqsa, vaqt
usage: We'll be cutting it close if we leave now, but we should get there just before the movie starts.

meaning: to a certain degree or extent; somewhat
meaning_uz: ma'lum darajada yoki darajada; biroz
usage: While hard work and perseverance will take you far, success also depends in a measure on good fortune.

meaning: to fall, to die, to end in failure
