meaning_uz: yiqilishga, o'limga, muvaffaqiyatsiz tugashiga
usage: His career bit the dust when he lost his job.

idiom: the bigger they come, the harder they fall
meaning: those who are exceptionally large, powerful, or influential will have more to lose when they fail, and their failure will be all the more dramatic or spectacular because of it
meaning_uz: nihoyatda katta, qudratli yoki ta'sirli bo'lganlar muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganlarida ko'proq yutqazishlari kerak bo'ladi va ularning muvaffaqiyatsizligi buning uchun yanada dramatik yoki ajoyib bo'ladi
usage: That bully thinks he's untouchable, but the bigger they come, the harder they fall.

meaning: in a successful or important position, doing very well, in a state of euphoric happiness, excitement, or enthusiasm
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatli yoki muhim pozitsiyada, juda yaxshi ish qilish, quvonchli baxt, hayajon yoki g'ayrat holatida
usage: The country was flying high for several years, but the recession brought everything crashing back down to the ground.

meaning: the choice between taking what is offered and getting nothing at all
meaning_uz: taklif qilingan narsalarni olish va umuman hech narsa olish o'rtasidagi tanlov
usage: If you want a yellow car, it's Hobson's choice. The garage has only one and it is already rented out.

idiom: kill the goose that lays the golden egg
meaning: to ruin or destroy something that brings one wealth
meaning_uz: bitta boylik keltiradigan narsani buzish yoki yo'q qilish uchun
usage: Firing the programmer who created your most successful app is like killing the goose that lays the golden egg.

meaning: the best of a group of similar things or people
meaning_uz: o'xshash narsalar yoki odamlar guruhining eng yaxshi
usage: The medical school's graduates are considered to be the cream of the crop and can get jobs wherever they want to.

meaning: not required to adhere to current laws, rules, or standards
meaning_uz: joriy qonuniyatlarga, qoidalarga va normalarga rioya qilish talab etilmaydi
usage: Many computer hackers act as though they are above the law when they steal valuable data from companies and attempt to sell it online.

meaning: from the beginning, without using anything that already exists
meaning_uz: boshidan, allaqachon mavjud bo'lgan hech narsadan foydalanmasdan
usage: Ben built the shed from scratch without anyone's help.

meaning: to do the same things every day and to not want to change those habits
meaning_uz: har kuni bir xil ishlarni qilish va o'sha odatlarni o'zgartirishni istamaslik
usage: As people get older, they often become set in their ways.

meaning: in a difficult situation
meaning_uz: qiyin vaziyatda
usage: If the insurance company won't pay for the damage, I'll be up a tree.

meaning: someone who saves you from a difficult or dangerous situation
meaning_uz: sizni qiyin yoki xavfli vaziyatdan qutqaradigan odam
usage: Thank you so much for fixing my flat tire. You are a knight in shining armour.

meaning: to transfer or bestow one's position or responsibilities to someone else
meaning_uz: o'zgaga o'tkazish yoki o'z pozitsiyasi yoki vakolatlarini
usage: Because Gina is retiring, she is passing the torch to me as head of the department.

meaning: to be willing and prepared to help or defend someone, to look out for someone in case they need assistance
meaning_uz: birovga yordam berishga yoki himoya qilishga tayyor va tayyor bo'lish, yordamga muhtoj bo'lgan taqdirda birovga ehtiyot bo'lish
usage: You can always rely on your parents to have your back.

meaning: to waste one's time or energy idly or frivolously; to neither progress nor regress, but remain in a fixed, neutral position
meaning_uz: o'z vaqtini yoki energiyasini behuda yoki arzimas ravishda sarflash; na rivoj va na regressga, balki belgilangan, betaraf holatda qolishga
usage: They kept me on to manage what's left of this division, but to be honest, I've just been spinning my wheels here for the last couple of years.

meaning: to set, throw, drop, or place someone, something, or oneself heavily down to a lower level
meaning_uz: birovni, biror narsani yoki o'zini pastroq darajagacha o'rnatish, tashlash, tushirish yoki qo'yish uchun
usage: He plunked the bag down on the table and went into his room without a word.

meaning: to succeed when others thought you would not, to finally be more successful than someone who was unpleasant to you
meaning_uz: yo'q deb o'ylaganida muvaffaqiyatga erishish, nihoyat sizga yoqimsiz bo'lgan odamdan ko'ra muvaffaqiyatliroq bo'lish
usage: She was fired from the company last year, but she had the last laugh when she was hired by their main rival at twice the salary.

meaning: a time that is expected to never arrive or occur
meaning_uz: hech qachon kelmasligi yoki sodir bo'lishi kutilayotgan vaqt
usage: You lent that leech John more money? It'll be at the Greek calends when he pays you back.

meaning: to talk negatively or unflatteringly about someone or something
meaning_uz: kimgadir yoki biror narsa haqida nojo'ya yoki noxush gapirishga
usage: I'm sorry to cast aspersions on Julie, but her work ethic is really terrible.

idiom: not have a penny to one's name
meaning: to be extremely poor, to have very little or no money to spend
meaning_uz: nihoyatda kambag'al bo'lishi, sarflash uchun juda kam yoki hech qanday pulga ega bo'lishi
usage: During college, when I didn't have a penny to my name, I survived off of ramen noodles for months at a time.

meaning: to be very similar
meaning_uz: juda o'xshash bo'lishi
usage: Both the brothers are equally mean, they seem to be cast in the same mould.

meaning: remain firmly in one's place
meaning_uz: birining o'rnida qat'iy qolib
usage: Getting your portrait painted won't take long - just sit tight.

meaning: an event or experience that helps you achieve something else
meaning_uz: boshqa narsaga erishishga yordam beradigan hodisa yoki tajriba
usage: I see this job just as a stepping stone to better things.

idiom: like a bull in a china shop
meaning: to be careless in the way one move or behaves, clumsy
meaning_uz: bir harakat yoki o'zini tutishida beparvo bo'lish, qo'pol
usage: We told her it was a delicate situation but she went into the meeting like a bull in a china shop.

idiom: hit the nail on the head
meaning: to describe exactly what is causing a situation or problem, to do something exactly right
meaning_uz: vaziyat yoki muammoga nima sabab bo'layotganini aniq ifodalash, aniq to'g'ri ish qilish
usage: I think Mike hit the nail on the head when he said that this company lacks a feeling of confidence.

meaning: fail to achieve a result
meaning_uz: natijaga erisha olmadi
usage: The peace initiative seems to be running into the sand.

meaning: current situation or set of conditions is ideal for the prospects of some activity or endeavor
meaning_uz: hozirgi vaziyat yoki shartlar to'plami ba'zi faoliyat yoki harakat istiqbollari uchun ideal
usage: It seems the stars are aligned for the team to finally take home the championship trophy this year.

meaning: an especially attractive, pleasing, or remarkable sight or visual experience
meaning_uz: ayniqsa jozibali, yoqimli yoki ajoyib ko'rish yoki vizual tajriba
usage: He emerged from the tailor in a brand new designer suit, and I thought he was a feast for the eyes.

meaning: a guess that is made using judgment and a particular level of knowledge and is therefore more likely to be correct
meaning_uz: hukm va muayyan bilim darajasi yordamida amalga oshirilgan va shuning uchun to'g'ri bo'lish ehtimoli ko'proq bo'lgan tahmin
usage: I can't tell you exactly how much the building work will cost, but I can make an educated guess.

meaning: to go out into a city or town and have an enjoyable time, typically by visiting various establishments, such as bars, restaurants, clubs, etc
meaning_uz: shahar yoki shaharga chiqish va odatda barlar, restoranlar, klublar va boshqalar kabi turli muassasalarga tashrif buyurib, zavqli vaqt o'tkazish
usage: After our exams finished, we all decided to get dressed up and paint the town red.

idiom: like two peas in a pod
meaning: very similar, especially in appearance
meaning_uz: juda o'xshash, ayniqsa tashqi ko'rinishda
usage: The twins are like two peas in a pod.

meaning: used to describe a situation where a person who knows nothing is getting advice and help from another person who knows almost nothing
meaning_uz: hech narsani bilmaydigan odam deyarli hech narsani bilmaydigan boshqa odamdan maslahat va yordam olayotgan holatni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi
usage: Nathan offered to be my guide through Philadelphia, but since he had never been there before either, it was a case of the blind leading the blind.

meaning: something that you say to indicate that you have no sympathy for someone or cannot do anything to help them
meaning_uz: birovga hamdardligingiz yo'qligini yoki ularga yordam berish uchun hech narsa qila olmasligingizni ko'rsatadigan biror narsa
usage: This is the only food we have left, and if you don't like it, hard cheese.

meaning: subjected to intense scrutiny or examination
meaning_uz: qattiq tekshiruv yoki imtihonga duchor bo'lgan
usage: John found himself in the dock after his wife caught him having an affair with another woman.

meaning: someone who unexpectedly wins a competition, someone who surprises others with their skills or talents
meaning_uz: kutilmaganda musobaqada g'olib bo'lgan, o'z mahorati yoki iste'dodi bilan boshqalarni hayratda qoldiradigan odam
usage: Angela was suddenly viewed as a dark horse when she displayed her beautiful sculptures at the art fair.

meaning: to endure a painful or otherwise unpleasant situation that is seen as unavoidable
meaning_uz: muqarrar deb ko'riladigan og'riqli yoki aksincha yoqimsiz holatga bardosh berish
usage: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet.

meaning: to be quick to react or take action
meaning_uz: munosabat bildirish yoki chora ko'rish uchun tezkor bo'lishi
usage: You have to be quick off the mark if you're going to be an emergency responder.

meaning: to be a skillful and unyielding negotiator or dealmaker
meaning_uz: mohir va to'ntamas muzokarachi yoki bitim tuzuvchi bo'lishi
usage: Sal is known to drive a hard bargain, so I doubt you'll get that car for the price you want.

meaning: to correct someone's attitude, belief, or behavior, to make sure someone understands something correctly
meaning_uz: birovning munosabati, e'tiqodi yoki xatti-harakatini to'g'rilash, biror narsani to'g'ri tushunishi uchun
usage: Helen told me she thought the moon landing was faked, so I had to put her straight!

meaning: someone's intentions can be judged better by what they do than by what they say
meaning_uz: kimningdir niyatini gapidan ko'ra qilmishlariga ko'ra yaxshiroq hukm qilish mumkin
usage: Of course the government have made all sorts of promises but as we all know, actions speak louder than words.

meaning: something bad that must exist or occur in order for something good to happen
meaning_uz: yaxshi narsa sodir bo'lishi uchun mavjud bo'lishi yoki sodir bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan yomon narsa
usage: These days, student loans are a necessary evil in order to get an education that leads to a well-paying job.

meaning: two unlike things or people
meaning_uz: narsalardan yoki odamlardan farqli o'laroq ikki
usage: Talking about her current book and her previous bestseller is like comparing apples and oranges.

meaning: to say what you mean clearly and directly, even if you upset people by doing this
meaning_uz: bu bilan odamlarni g'azablantirsangiz ham, nimani nazarda tutganingizni aniq va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytish
usage: The report does not mince words, describing the situation as "ludicrous".

meaning: to be as good at something as someone who is extremely good
meaning_uz: nihoyatda yaxshi bo'lgan odam kabi biror narsada yaxshi bo'lishi
usage: Jeff is very talented. He'll give those professional players a run for their money.

meaning: the best and most notable aspect of something
meaning_uz: biror narsaning eng yaxshi va e'qiqli tomoni
usage: The scene is the crowning glory of this marvelously entertaining show.

idiom: dangle a carrot in front of someone
meaning: try to persuade someone to do something by offering them a reward
meaning_uz: mukofot taklif qilib, birovni biror ish qilishga ko'ndirishga harakat qiling
usage: The team has dangled a 17 million dollar carrot in front of the Italian to remain in North America.

meaning: having superior strength or power gives one the ability to control something or enforce one's own agenda, beliefs, justice, etc.
meaning_uz: Yuqori kuchga yoki kuchga ega bo'lish, biror narsani boshqarish yoki o'z kun tartibiga, e'tiqodiga, adolatiga va boshqalarga amal qilish qobiliyatini beradi.
usage: Back in my day, might made right in school - if you were one of the weaker students, you did what the stronger ones said.

meaning: criticize someone behind their back
meaning_uz: orqasidan birovni tanqid
usage: No one wants to hire an individual who bad mouths a prior employer.

meaning: to think carefully about something for a period of time
meaning_uz: ma'l muddatga biror narsa haqida diqqat bilan o'ylab ko'rishga
usage: I need a few days to mull things over before I decide what to do about the offer.

meaning: the last or declining years of one's age or career
meaning_uz: yoshi yoki kasbining so'nggi yoki kamayib borayotgan yillari
usage: Astride his motorcycle with thick chestnut hair and a deep, booming voice, my grandfather looks very little like a man who has slipped into the vale of years.

meaning: someone or something that brings hope into the lives of others
meaning_uz: kimdir yoki boshqalarning hayotiga umid keltiradigan narsa
usage: Her students proved to be ray of sunshine for her when she was was trying to cope up with her illness.

idiom: not get a word in edgeways
meaning: to not be able to say anything because someone else is talking all the time
meaning_uz: hech narsa deya olmaslik, chunki boshqa birov har doim gaplashib
usage: Rosa was talking so much that nobody else could get a word in edgeways!

idiom: a sledgehammer to crack a nut
meaning: use much more force or put more effort than needed
meaning_uz: ancha ko'proq kuch ishlatish yoki keragidan ortiq harakat qilish
usage: Fifty police officers to arrest two unarmed men is surely using a sledgehammer to crack a nut.

meaning: to behave as if a problem is not important or does not worry you
meaning_uz: muammo muhim emasdek tutish yoki sizni tashvishga solmaslik
usage: She seems all right but I think she's just putting on a brave face.

meaning: come to the point
meaning_uz: nuqtaga keling
usage: After a few introductory comments, we cut to the chase and began negotiating.

meaning: rest, relax, or be calm
meaning_uz: dam olish, dam olish yoki sokin bo'lish
usage: You'd better take it easy until you feel better.

meaning: very modern and using the most recent ideas and methods
meaning_uz: juda zamonaviy va eng so'nggi g'oyalar va usullardan foydalangan holda
usage: The control panel uses all the newest technology and is considered state-of-the-art.

idiom: when all is said and done
meaning: when everything is finished and settled, when everything is considered
meaning_uz: hamma narsa tugagach va o'rnashib qolganda, hamma narsa nazarda tutilganda
usage: When all is said and done, I believe I had a very enjoyable time on my vacation.

meaning: to join a popular trend or activity
meaning_uz: ommabop trend yoki faoliyatga qo'shilish uchun
usage: The success of the product led many firms to try and jump on the bandwagon.

idiom: the new kid on the block
meaning: someone who is new in a place or organization and has many things to learn about it
meaning_uz: joyda yoki tashkilotda yangi bo'lgan va bu haqda ko'p narsalarga ega bo'lgan odam
usage: Realizing I was the new kid on the block in this job, I was determined to prove myself.

meaning: difficult to believe
meaning_uz: ishonish qiyin
usage: I found her story rather hard to swallow.

meaning: for an indefinitely long time
meaning_uz: abadiy uzoq vaqt davomida
usage: Those two could talk till the cows came home.

meaning: to make arrangements that result in an unfair advantage over someone or something
meaning_uz: birovdan yoki biror narsadan adolatsiz ustunlikka olib keladigan tartib o'tkaza
usage: By dating the boss's daughter, Jeremy has stacked the deck against the rest of us for an early promotion.

meaning: to keep changing your ideas, opinions, activities, or job
meaning_uz: g'oya, fikr, faoliyat yoki ishingizni o'zgartirishda davom
usage: After six months of chopping and changing, we've decided to go back to our old system.

meaning: becoming more and more successful; improving to a brighter, happier future, especially after some misfortune or unpleasant incident
meaning_uz: tobora muvaffaqiyatli bo'lish; yorqinroq, baxtli kelajakka yaxshilanish, ayniqsa, ba'zi baxtsizlik yoki yoqimsiz hodisadan so'ng
usage: Her publishing career started as an editorial assistant on a women's magazine and it was onwards and upwards from there.

meaning: to constantly pursue things that are unrealistic or unlikely to happen
meaning_uz: sodir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lmagan yoki ehtimoldan xoli bo'lmagan narsalarni doimo izdan
usage: You can't chase rainbows your whole life, you need to pick a stable career and start being an adult.

meaning: used to say an occasion will be more enjoyable if a lot of people are there
meaning_uz: ko'pchilik u yerda bo'lsa, bir voqea yanada quvonchli bo'ladi, deb aytish uchun ishlatiladi
usage: "Do you mind if I bring a couple of friends to your party?" "Not at all - the more the merrier!"

meaning: to ask someone to marry you
meaning_uz: birovdan sizga turmushga chiqishini so'rash uchun
usage: When he popped the question I said yes without a further thought.

meaning: a person of aristocratic or wealthy ancestry
meaning_uz: aristokrat yoki boy ajdodlar shaxsi
usage: Because his great-grandparents made millions, he is regarded as one of the city's blue bloods.

meaning: to push one to do something that one is not inclined to do otherwise
meaning_uz: aks holda qilishga moyil bo'lmagan ishni qilishga undash uchun
usage: I was hoping to play golf today, but the storm forced my hand, so I stayed home instead.

meaning: easily and decisively
meaning_uz: oson va qat'iy
usage: If we had a race, he would win hands down.

meaning: the protection, backing, or support of a particular person or organization
meaning_uz: muayyan shaxs yoki tashkilotning himoyasi, qo'llab-quvvatlashi yoki qo'llab-quvvatlashi
usage: The negotiations were conducted under the aegis of the UN.

idiom: get your foot in the door
meaning: to obtain some kind of advantage at the beginning of a bigger or longer process
meaning_uz: kattaroq yoki uzoqroq jarayonning boshida qandaydir ustunlikka ega bo'lish uchun
usage: An internship might not sound very interesting, but it's a great way to get your foot in the door at this company.

meaning: a lot of trouble, excitement or fuss about something that is not important
meaning_uz: muhim bo'lmagan narsa haqida ko'p qiyinchiliklar, hayajon yoki g'alayon
usage: People have been getting very upset about the seating arrangements for the Christmas dinner, but as far as I am concerned it's all much ado about nothing.

meaning: a good or lucky position
meaning_uz: yaxshi yoki omadli lavozim
usage: He certainly earned his place in the sun as the company's new CEO.

meaning: very quickly and without any delay
meaning_uz: juda tez va hech qanday kechiktirmasdan
usage: He disappeared at the double.

meaning: an equal opportunity, fair treatment
meaning_uz: teng imkoniyat, adolatli muomala
usage: I know I'm not the CEO's niece or daughter, but this is my dream job, and I am more than qualified for it. Can I please just get an even break?

meaning: not very often
meaning_uz: juda tez-tez emas
usage: My sister lives in Alaska, so I only see her once in a blue moon.

meaning: to avoid someone or something
meaning_uz: birov yoki biror narsadan saqlanish uchun
usage: Steer clear of the boss today - he's yelling at everyone he sees.

meaning: to be in a tough situation with limited options
meaning_uz: variantlari cheklangan holda qiyin vaziyatda bo'lishi
usage: The company has its back against the wall and if the employees do not help out now, it will be bankrupt soon.

meaning: something that is difficult or dangerous to deal with
meaning_uz: bilan shug'ullanish qiyin yoki xavfli bo'lgan narsa
usage: The abortion issue is a political hot potato in the United States.

idiom: be another/a different kettle of fish
meaning: to be completely different from something or someone else that has been talked about
meaning_uz: haqida gapirilgan biror narsadan yoki boshqa birovdan butunlay farq qilishi
usage: Having knowledge is one thing but being able to communicate it to others is another kettle of fish.

meaning: old
meaning_uz: eski
usage: Our poor cat is so long in the tooth that he struggles just walking around the house these days.

meaning: to adopt a role, position, attitude, behavior, undertaking, etc., that is seen as being beneath one's abilities or social position in order to achieve one's end
meaning_uz: o'z nihoyasiga yetish maqsadida o'z iqtidori yoki ijtimoiy mavqei ostida deb ko'riladigan rolni, pozitsiyani, munosabatni, xatti-harakatlarni, ishlarni va boshqalarni qabul qilish
usage: Many politicians have started taking advantage of more popular, mainstream entertainment platforms because the only way they can be in public limelight is if they stoop to conquer.

meaning: to actively avoid conflict or attention
meaning_uz: nizo yoki e'tibordan faol qochish uchun
usage: I'm keeping my head down at work these days because I don't want to be among the layoffs that are sure to accompany our recent change in leadership.

meaning: to sacrifice someone to save the rest, to abandon someone to harm
meaning_uz: qolganlarni qutqarish uchun birovni qurbon qilish, birovni zararsizlantirish uchun tashlab ketish
usage: The investigation was going to be rigorous and unpleasant, and I could see they were going to throw someone to the wolves.

meaning: something that will never happen
meaning_uz: hech qachon bo'lmaydigan narsa
usage: He plans to clean his house every week, but he will probably do it only when pigs fly.

meaning: to be good enough
meaning_uz: yetarli darajada yaxshi bo'lishi uchun
usage: Her latest batch of work just isn't up to the mark.

meaning: laughing uncontrollably
meaning_uz: nazoratsiz kulish
usage: Jerry is the funniest guy I know. He can have you in stitches in a matter of minutes.

meaning: to be very unwieldy or unmanageable; to be nearly impossible to organize
meaning_uz: juda g'ayrioddiy yoki boshqarilmaydigan bo'lishi; tashkil etish deyarli imkonsiz bo'lishi
usage: Getting all of the extended family into their right places for the reunion photo was like herding cats!

meaning: to know what your opinion or situation is
meaning_uz: fikringiz yoki holatingiz nimaligini bilishi
usage: I know where I stand on this issue - I'm against the war.

meaning: to make one feel happier or more carefree
meaning_uz: o'zini baxtliroq yoki g'amxo'rroq his qilish uchun
usage: I love my roommate. No matter what mood I'm in, he is always able to raise my spirits.

idiom: go to hell in a handbasket
meaning: to be in an extremely and increasingly bad or ruinous condition, to be on the inevitable path to utter failure or ruin
meaning_uz: nihoyatda va tobora yomon yoki halokatli holatda bo'lish, butunlay muvaffaqiyatsizlik yoki vayronagarchilikning muqarrar yo'lida bo'lish
usage: With the way he's running things, the company is going to hell in a handbasket!

meaning: a hidden, shocking or shameful secret
meaning_uz: yashirin, shov-shuvli yoki sharmandali sir
usage: Even the most innocent looking man has skeletons in his closet.

meaning: in an extraordinary and impressive manner, generally used to describe a final action
meaning_uz: g'aroyib va ta'sirchan tarzda, umuman, yakuniy harakatni ifodalashda qo'llaniladigan
usage: The underdogs of the league finished the season in a blaze of glory by defeating the top-ranked team in a 4-0 stunner.

meaning: to take the blame for something, often another's mistakes or misdeeds
meaning_uz: biror narsada aybni o'z zimmasiga olishi, ko'pincha boshqasining xato yoki qilmishiga
usage: My partner had been cooking the books for years, but because I was the CEO, I had to carry the can for our company's collapse.

meaning: to be lost, ignored, or forgotten
meaning_uz: yo'qotilishi, e'tibordan chetda qolmasligi yoki unutib qo'yilishiga
usage: Have basic decency and manners gone for a toss in this modern age?

idiom: can't hold a candle to someone
meaning: to not be as good as the person or thing mentioned
meaning_uz: aytib o'tilgan shaxs yoki narsa kabi yaxshi bo'lmasligi
usage: Her latest book is readable enough, but it can't hold a candle to her earlier work.

meaning: both sides are equally matched; the contest is equal or level; neither side has been victorious
meaning_uz: ikkala tomon ham bir xil mos keladi; konkurs teng yoki daraja; Va hech bir taraf ham gʻolib boʻlmagan.
usage: At the end of an amazing game, honours are even between these two teams.

meaning: at a further, later, or unspecified point
meaning_uz: boshqa, keyinchalik yoki aniqlanmagan nuqtada
usage: He thought that military action was still a long way down the line.

meaning: a small, noticeable part of a problem, the total size of which is really much greater
meaning_uz: muammoning kichik, sezilarli qismi, uning umumiy hajmi haqiqatan ham ancha katta
usage: These small local protests are just the tip of the iceberg. The problem is much deeper.

meaning: use your authority to make someone obey you or work more efficiently
meaning_uz: kimdir sizga bo'ysunish yoki yanada samarali ishlashi uchun o'z vakolatingizdan foydalaning
usage: Every so often the manager cracks the whip to make sure they meet the deadline.

meaning: to awaken a vague or indistinct memory, something that sounds familiar
meaning_uz: noto'g'ri yoki noaniq xotirani uyg'otish uchun, tanish tuyulgan narsa
usage: The place he was talking about rang a bell but I couldn't remember where I had read about it.

meaning: to do everything possible in order to achieve or find something
meaning_uz: biror narsaga erishish yoki topish maqsadida qo'lidan kelgan barcha ishni
usage: He left no stone unturned in his search for his natural mother.

meaning: something or someone that is lazy and not helpful or useful
meaning_uz: biror narsa yoki dangasa bo'lgan va foydali bo'lmagan yoki foydali bo'lmagan
usage: This junky old computer my dad gave me is good for nothing!

meaning: to be happy because you are doing what you like or can do best
meaning_uz: baxtli bo'lish, chunki siz o'zingizga yoqqan yoki eng yaxshisini qila oladigan
usage: Kate, of course, was in her element, making all the arrangements for the party.

meaning: to be likely to steal
meaning_uz: o'g'irlash ehtimoli bo'lishi
usage: The last person we hired as a cashier turned out to have sticky fingers.

meaning: thoroughly, down to the last detail
meaning_uz: yaxshilab, oxirgi tafsilotgacha
usage: I have been studying this material for weeks now, so I know it inside and out.

meaning: if someone blows smoke they deliberately confuse or deceive you
meaning_uz: agar kimdir tutun chalsa, ular sizni qasddan chalg'itadi yoki aldaydi
usage: I think they're blowing smoke about giving regular raises to their employees. I couldn't find any evidence to support that claim.

idiom: take up or throw down the gauntlet
meaning: accept or issue a challenge
meaning_uz: da'voni qabul qilish yoki rasmiylashtirish
usage: A price war looks likely now that a leading supermarket has thrown down the gauntlet to its competitors.

meaning: the exact double of another person or thing
meaning_uz: boshqa odamning yoki narsaning aniq ikki barobari
usage: She's the spitting image of her mum.

meaning: family relations and bonds are closer than other relationships
meaning_uz: oilaviy munosabatlar va bog'lanishlar boshqa munosabatlarga qaraganda yaqinroq
usage: When you get into trouble, usually your family will be the ones to bail you out, not your friends. After all, blood is thicker than water.

idiom: cost an arm and a leg
meaning: be extremely expensive
meaning_uz: nihoyatda qimmat bo'ling
usage: The new phone had cost him an arm and a leg.

meaning: all day and all night
meaning_uz: kun bo'yi va tun bo'yi
usage: I've got a team working around the clock.

meaning: at a dead end, on a route that leads nowhere
meaning_uz: o'lik chekkada, hech qaerga olib boradigan yo'lda
usage: The police are up a blind alley in their investigation of the crime.

meaning: in full, unrestricted view; visibly, openly, or publicly
meaning_uz: to'liq, cheklanmagan ko'rinishda; ko'zga ko'ringan, oshkora yoki ochiq
usage: I can't believe you go outside in plain view of the neighbors with your bathrobe open!

meaning: a person who remains unfixed to a certain location, relocating from one place to another
meaning_uz: ma'lum bir joyga aloqasiz qolgan, bir joydan boshqa joyga ko'chib o'tgan shaxs
usage: The economy has forced me to become a bird of passage, moving around the state to wherever I can find work.

meaning: to mark the end of the previous year and usher in the start of a new one, typically with a party or other celebration
meaning_uz: o'tgan yil yakunini belgilash va yangisining boshlanishini boshlab berish, odatda, partiya yoki boshqa bayram bilan
usage: My friends and I all rang in the new year with a wild party at Sarah's house.

meaning: an utterly shocking or startling thing, situation, or revelation
meaning_uz: butunlay dahshatli yoki hayratlanarli narsa, vaziyat yoki vahiy
usage: Learning about John's opium addiction was a real eye-opener for me.

meaning: used for saying that two things or options are essentially the same or have no significant difference between them
meaning_uz: ikki narsa yoki variant aslida bir xil yoki ular o'rtasida sezilarli farq yo'q, deb aytish uchun ishlatiladi
usage: He could not decide which formal suit to purchase - he thought the choice was just about as broad as it was long.

meaning: a task or activity that has no hope of success
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatga umidi bo'lmagan vazifa yoki faoliyat
usage: It is a fool's errand trying to get Lena to join in anything.

meaning: for a very long time
meaning_uz: juda uzoq vaqt davomida
usage: I could sit here and argue with you till the cows come home, but it wouldn't solve anything.

meaning: to start behaving in a way that is not generally acceptable, especially dishonestly or illegally
meaning_uz: o'zini umuman ma'qul bo'lmagan tarzda, ayniqsa, nohaqlik yoki noqonuniy tarzda boshlash
usage: He went off the rails in his first year at university.

meaning: used in reference to a person's ability to judge what is right and wrong and act accordingly
meaning_uz: insonning to'g'ri va noto'g'ri bo'lgan narsalarni hukm qila olishi va shunga muvofiq harakat qilishi nazarda tutilgan holda qo'llaniladi
usage: He is by no means the only senior politician who has mislaid his moral compass.

meaning: at the correct moment, as if planned to happen exactly at that moment
meaning_uz: to'g'ri vaqtda, xuddi o'sha paytda aniq sodir bo'lishi rejalashtirilgandek
usage: We were just about to say "I do" when, right on cue, my little cousin started crying.

meaning: tangential or insignificant to the main issue being discussed
meaning_uz: muhokama qilinayotgan asosiy masalaga tangensial yoki ahamiyatsiz
usage: I do love the apartment, but that's beside the point because I don't have enough money for a security deposit right now.

idiom: put your foot in your mouth
meaning: to say or do something that you should not have, esp. something that embarrasses someone else
meaning_uz: bo'lmasligi kerak bo'lgan narsani aytish yoki qilish, esp. boshqa birovni uyatga qoldiradigan narsa
usage: I really put my foot in my mouth - I asked her if Jane was her mother, but she said Jane is her sister.

meaning: to give someone a hard time by means of aggressive actions or attitude, to scold or reprimand someone, to produce or present problems or challenges for one
meaning_uz: tajovuzkor harakatlar yoki munosabat orqali birovga qiyinchilik tug'dirish, birovni tanbeh berish yoki tanbeh berish, muammo yoki qiyinchiliklarni keltirib chiqarish yoki taqdim etish
usage: Mom will give you hell if you come home after curfew yet again.

meaning: very active, often suddenly
meaning_uz: juda faol, ko'pincha to'satdan
usage: Well, your grandmother is on an earlier flight, so I've been on a tear trying to get everything ready for her arrival.

meaning: to ease, solve, or remove minor difficulties, troubles, or problematic details
meaning_uz: engillashtirish, hal qilish yoki kichik qiyinchiliklar, muammolar yoki muammoli tafsilotlarni olib tashlash uchun
usage: Bob and Janet are seeing a counselor to try and iron out the wrinkles in their marriage.

meaning: to be responsible for someone's death
meaning_uz: birovning o'limiga sababchi bo'lishi
usage: The leaders of this war have the blood of many thousands of people on their hands.

meaning: to help to explain a situation
meaning_uz: vaziyatni tushuntirishga yordam berish uchun
usage: Experts hope the plane's flight recorders will shed light on the cause of the crash.

meaning: characteristic of the working class, especially manual laborers
meaning_uz: ishchi sinfga xos xususiyat, xususan, qo'l mehnati bilan shug'ullanuvchi
usage: Blue collar workers have always been an important part of our economy.

meaning: very inexpensive
meaning_uz: juda arzon
usage: These shoes were dirt cheap - I found them on the clearance rack.

meaning: in a risky or dangerous manner
meaning_uz: xavfli yoki xavfli tarzda
usage: If you keep sailing so near the wind, the police are going to arrest you eventually.

meaning: a concession that a person or statement must be regarded as correct or justified, if the contrary has not been proven
meaning_uz: shaxs yoki gap to'g'ri yoki asosli deb hisoblanishi kerak bo'lgan imtiyoz, agar aksincha isbotlanmagan bo'lsa
usage: I'll give you the benefit of the doubt as to whether it was deliberate or not.

meaning: on the whole
meaning_uz: umuman olganda
usage: Sure, it rained on our vacation, but all in all we had a great time.

meaning: a feeling of unhappiness
meaning_uz: baxtsizlik hissi
usage: With a heavy heart, she turned to wave the final goodbye.

meaning: taken by surprise, caught in a vulnerable or often embarrassing position or situation
meaning_uz: hayrat bilan olingan, ojiz yoki ko'pincha uyatli holatga tushib qolgan
usage: After spending years shouting about morality and family values, the governor was caught with his pants down when a reporter asked him about his own affair.

idiom: where the rubber meets the road
meaning: at the point in a process where there are challenges, issues, or problems
meaning_uz: qiyinchiliklar, masalalar yoki muammolar mavjud bo'lgan jarayonning nuqtasida
usage: Now we have spelled out the main area of dissent. This is where the rubber meets the road.

meaning: to open a book, often used in the negative
meaning_uz: kitob ochishga, ko'pincha negativda qo'llaniladigan
usage: I really need to study for that test on Monday because I haven't cracked a book all weekend.

meaning: to have learned or succeeded in something that might be an advantage in the future
meaning_uz: kelajakda afzallik bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsada o'rgangan yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishgan bo'lishi
usage: Basic computer skills are a good thing to have under your belt.

meaning: someone known for spending or gambling large amounts of money
meaning_uz: katta miqdordagi pulni sarflash yoki qimor bilan tanilgan odam
usage: The back room at the casino was reserved exclusively for high rollers willing to play for big stakes.

meaning: to squeeze one's way out of something, to evade or avoid a job or responsibility
meaning_uz: birovning biror narsadan chiqish yo'lini siqib chiqarish, ishdan yoki mas'uliyatdan qochish yoki undan qochish uchun
usage: Although they had signed the contract they tried to weasel out of the deal later.

meaning: disguise one's true nature or intentions
meaning_uz: haqiqiy tabiatni yoki niyatni o'zgartirish
usage: He felt the waiters could see that in his cashmere tweed jacket he is sailing under false colors.

meaning: hard physical work, especially vigorous polishing or cleaning
meaning_uz: qattiq jismoniy mehnat, ayniqsa kuchli polishing yoki tozalash
usage: It took some elbow grease, but I finally got this old engine up and running again.

meaning: to purchase a vehicle that constantly gives problems or stops running after you drive it away
meaning_uz: muammolarni beradigan yoki haydab yuborganingizdan so'ng yugurishni to'xtatadigan transport vositasini sotib olish uchun
usage: We often try to save money by buying second-hand cars but little do we realise that we may be buying a lemon.

meaning: to understand something by piecing together hints or other bits of information
meaning_uz: ma'lumotlarni yoki boshqa bitiklarni bir-biriga bo'lish orqali biror narsani tushunishga
usage: Once I started to connect the dots, I realized that, if they hadn't called me by now, I probably wasn't getting the job.

meaning: interject a remark
meaning_uz: bir gapni o'zaro bog'lash
usage: Andy chimed in with his view of the situation.

meaning: a series or period of drastic changes that occur without warning
meaning_uz: ogohlantirmasdan sodir bo'ladigan qator yoki jiddiy o'zgarishlar davri
usage: After she graduated from college, her life became a roller coaster ride filled with ups and downs as she tried to establish herself as a fashion designer.

meaning: very excited and enthusiastic
meaning_uz: juda hayajonli va g'ayratli
usage: Kids are always as keen as mustard to learn new things around them.

meaning: an advantage you have that other people do not know much about
meaning_uz: sizda boshqa odamlar ko'p narsani bilmaydigan afzallik
usage: The local team has an ace in the hole with their new player.

meaning: a long and complicated statement or story, sometimes one that is not true
meaning_uz: uzoq va murakkab gap yoki hikoya, ba'zan haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan
usage: She gave me some song and dance about how busy she is and thus cannot meet me.

meaning: someone who spends a lot of time exercising in the gym, and who cares very much about the shape and condition of their body
meaning_uz: mashg'ulotda mashg'ulotlarga ko'p vaqt sarflaydigan, tanasining shakli va holatiga juda g'amxo'rlik qiladigan odam
usage: There was no way I'd ever be gym bunny enough to be in that good shape again.

meaning: someone or something that is difficult to know or understand
meaning_uz: bilish yoki tushunish qiyin bo'lgan biror kishi yoki
usage: She's such a private person that I don't know much about her. I guess she's a closed book.

meaning: to be firmly resolute and confident in one's ideas, intentions, plans, or opinions
meaning_uz: qat'iy qat'iyatli bo'lish va o'z g'oyalari, niyatlari, rejalari yoki fikrlariga ishonch hosil qilish uchun
usage: I've never worried too much about the effects of peer pressure on Kelly, as she really knows her own mind on what's right or wrong.

meaning: to be so worried, confused, or annoyed that you do not know what to do next
meaning_uz: shunchalik xavotirga tushish, sarosimaga tushish yoki asabiylashish, bundan keyin nima qilishni bilmay
usage: I am at my wits' end. I don't know how to help him.

meaning: an incredibly difficult, unlikely, and/or elusive achievement or period of success
meaning_uz: nihoyatda qiyin, ehtimoldan xoli emas va / yoki qiyin yutuq yoki muvaffaqiyat davri
usage: The playwright caught lightning in a bottle with his first play, taking the world by storm and thrusting him into the spotlight of fame.

idiom: one swallow does not make a summer
meaning: you should not assume that something is true just because you have seen one piece of evidence for it
meaning_uz: uchun bitta dalilni ko'rganingiz uchun biror narsa haqiqat deb hisoblamasligingiz kerak
usage: Amanda: I got a good grade on this quiz! My troubles in school are over. Nancy: One swallow does not a summer make.

meaning: to be very serious and determined
meaning_uz: juda jiddiy va qat'iy bo'lishi
usage: The border is sealed by troops who mean business.

meaning: predetermined and not changeable, simple and easy to understand
meaning_uz: oldindan belgilangan va o'zgarmas, sodda va tushunish oson
usage: The coursework is cut and dried, so don't even think about coming to me in pursuit of extra credit.

meaning: back to the beginning, return to where one started from
meaning_uz: boshiga qaytish, biri boshlangan joyga qaytish
usage: The opposing parties had been trying to come to a compromise, but when the negotiations broke down, they were back to square one.

meaning: free, uncaptured
meaning_uz: erkin, qo'lga o'tkazilmagan
usage: Twelve prisoners are at large following a series of escapes.

meaning: to take attention or credit away from someone else
meaning_uz: e'tibor yoki kreditni boshqa birovdan uzoqlashtirish uchun
usage: She did not announce the news at the party because her friend was getting married and she did not want to steal her thunder.

meaning: the space, time, or freedom to make changes as needed
meaning_uz: kerak bo'lganda o'zgartirishlar kiritish uchun bo'sh joy, vaqt yoki erkinlik
usage: We need to leave ourselves some wiggle room when we're negotiating the deal.

meaning: to try to worry an opponent or enemy by publicly showing military, political, or financial power
meaning_uz: harbiy, siyosiy yoki moliyaviy qudratni ochiq ko'rsatish orqali raqib yoki dushmanni tashvishga solishga harakat qilish
usage: The parade is the first sign of the new regime flexing its military muscles.

meaning: to die
meaning_uz: o'limga
usage: If you crash at 60 mph, the odds are you'll buy the farm.

meaning: to pierce or puncture one's eye such that one can no longer see out of it
meaning_uz: birovning ko'zini teshib qo'yish yoki teshish uchun endi undan ko'ra olmaydigan
usage: The kid put his eye out playing with a pellet gun.

meaning: to foist responsibility or guilt for something onto one; to allow one to take the blame for something
meaning_uz: bir narsa uchun mas'uliyatni yoki aybni bir-biriga qo'zg'atish; biror narsada aybni o'z zimmasiga olishga yo'l qo'yish uchun
usage: My partner had been cooking the books for years, and he left me holding the baby when the business collapsed.

meaning: in a continuous, uninterrupted series
meaning_uz: uzluksiz, uzluksiz ketma-ketlikda
usage: I can't believe you won ten games in a row!

meaning: waste a great deal of time or effort in creating something that already exists
meaning_uz: allaqachon mavjud bo'lgan narsani yaratishda ko'p vaqt yoki kuch sarflash
usage: You can use the existing blueprints and improve upon them, there is no need to start from scratch and reinvent the wheel.

meaning: to find out about or come to understand a particular state of affairs or the way a situation exists or has developed, especially before taking any decisive or definitive action
meaning_uz: muayyan holatni yoki vaziyatning mavjudligi yoki rivojlanish yo'lini bilish yoki tushunishga, ayniqsa, har qanday hal qiluvchi yoki aniq choralar ko'rishdan oldin
usage: Given the turbulent nature of this market, I think it would be prudent for us to see how the land lies before we agree to invest in your company.

meaning: someone who you can trust to do an important job well, without making mistakes
meaning_uz: muhim ishni yaxshi bajarish uchun ishonib bo'ladigan odam, xatolarga yo'l qo'ymasdan
usage: That struggling company really needs a leader who is a safe pair of hands and can make some positive changes.

meaning: a coolly composed, unemotional woman; a woman without affection or warmth of feeling
meaning_uz: salqin tarkib topgan, emotsional bo'lmagan ayol; his-tuyg'u mehri va iliqligisiz ayol
usage: Many see the principal as some kind of ice maiden, but I think she's just being as tough as she needs to be.

meaning: without feeling, with cruel intent
meaning_uz: his qilmasdan, shafqatsiz niyat bilan
usage: The killer walked up and shot the woman in cold blood.

meaning: making you feel very upset or worried
meaning_uz: sizni juda xafa qilish yoki xavotirga soladi
usage: Gut-wrenching scenes of bloodshed.

meaning: said to emphasize that sometimes it is better for you if you do not know all the facts about a situation
meaning_uz: vaziyat haqidagi barcha faktlarni bilmasangiz, ba'zan siz uchun yaxshiroq ekanligini ta'kidlash uchun aytilgan
usage: I don't want to hear about my ex, ignorance is bliss.

meaning: a worthless hunt or chase, a futile pursuit
meaning_uz: arzimas ov yoki ta'qib, behuda ta'qib
usage: Physicists searching for the hypothetical particle may be on a wild goose chase.

meaning: to not follow what everyone else is doing
meaning_uz: hammaning qilayotgan ishlariga rioya qilmaslik uchun
usage: It's very difficult to go against the tide and follow your dreams.

meaning: to do something slowly because you do not want to do it
meaning_uz: qilishni istamaganingiz uchun sekin-asta biror ish qilish
usage: I suspect the management is dragging its heels on this issue.

meaning: show no surprise or concern
meaning_uz: ajablanarli va xavotir ko'rsatmang
usage: She paid the bill without batting an eyelid.

meaning: something or someone that appears to be good, useful, or benevolent, but that in reality proves to be the opposite
meaning_uz: yaxshi, foydali yoki xayrixoh bo'lib ko'rinadigan narsa yoki kimdir, lekin aslida buning aksi ekanligini isbotlaydi
usage: When I first met my ex-husband, I thought he was the nicest, most generous man alive, but he turned out to be the devil in disguise.

meaning: young people who have a lot of energy and ideas
meaning_uz: kuch va g'oyalari ko'p bo'lgan yoshlar
usage: We need to introduce more young blood into the organization.

meaning: said when you think it is best not to take risks even when it seems boring or difficult to be careful
meaning_uz: zerikarli yoki ehtiyot bo'lish qiyin bo'lib ko'rinsa ham xavf-xatarni qo'lga kiritmaslik yaxshiroq deb o'ylaganingizda
usage: Make sure you take an umbrella – I know it's sunny now, but better safe than sorry.

meaning: to continue living after a point at which you might easily have died, to continue to exist longer than expected
meaning_uz: osongina o'lgan bo'lishingiz mumkin bo'lgan nuqtadan keyin ham yashashni davom ettirishingiz, kutilganidan ko'ra uzoqroq vaqt davomida yashashingiz uchun
usage: It is unlikely that serious decisions will be made by a CEO living on borrowed time.

meaning: something that a particular person finds especially annoying
meaning_uz: muayyan odam ayniqsa zerikarli deb bladigan narsa
usage: One of my biggest pet peeves is poor customer service.

meaning: in an uncertain or critical state
meaning_uz: noaniq yoki tanqidiy holatda
usage: The court is just about to issue its verdict, and our company's future is hanging in the balance.

meaning: very smallest of detail or amount
meaning_uz: juda kichik detal yoki miqdor
usage: Not a single jot or tittle goes past the eye of the boss without her noticing.

meaning: to be progressing or finding success in some area of one's life
meaning_uz: o'z hayotining biror sohasida rivojlanib borishi yoki muvaffaqiyat topishi
usage: Alice is definitely going places with that singing voice of hers.

meaning: an axiom that encourages careful first steps in order to avoid extra work later on
meaning_uz: keyinchalik qo'shimcha ishdan qochish uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan birinchi qadamlarni rag'batlantiradigan aksiom
usage: I have to go back to the store because I cut the wrong size out of my last piece of material. "Measure twice, cut once" should be my new motto!

meaning: to have the courage or resolution to do something
meaning_uz: biror ishni bajarishga jur'at yoki rezolyutsiyaga ega bo'lishi
usage: Ken doesn't have the stomach for fighting.

meaning: to deceive or trick someone
meaning_uz: birovni aldash yoki aldash uchun
usage: You paid too much, I think he pulled a fast one on you.

meaning: a feature of an activity or a way of life that is of greater importance than any other
meaning_uz: faoliyatning xususiyati yoki boshqalardan ko'ra katta ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan turmush tarzi
usage: Getting into Harvard Law School became the be-all and end-all of Tony's existence.

meaning: to blame someone or make them responsible for a problem that you should deal with
meaning_uz: birovni ayblash yoki ularni hal qilish kerak bo'lgan muammo uchun javobgarlikka
usage: She's always trying to pass the buck and I'm sick of it!

meaning: monitor a dispute or conflict without becoming involved in it
meaning_uz: nizoni yoki ziddiyatni unga aloqador bo'lmasdan turib nazorat
usage: The judge is there to hold the ring impartially and to direct the jury on the law.

meaning: having or pursuing multiple opportunities simultaneously
meaning_uz: bir vaqtning o'zida bir nechta imkoniyatlarga ega bo'lish yoki ta'qib qilish
usage: Although I have been out of work for 6 months, I have a number of irons in the fire.

meaning: be confronted with the unpleasant consequences of one's actions
meaning_uz: o'z qilmishining yoqimsiz oqibatlari bilan to'qnash
usage: We would later have to face the music over our bold moves.

meaning: be accepted as adequate or satisfactory
meaning_uz: yetarli yoki qoniqarli deb qabul qilinishi
usage: This manifesto would not pass muster with the voters.

meaning: every possible way
meaning_uz: mumkin bo'lgan har bir
usage: I've tried every trick in the book to get him to notice me, and still no luck!

meaning: to accept the general terms and/or conditions of a deal without having completed or agreed upon the specific details
meaning_uz: bitimning umumiy shartlari va / yoki shartlarini aniq tafsilotlarni bajarmagan yoki kelishib olmasdan qabul qilish
usage: The government has agreed in principle that it will cover the cost of building a new school, but so far we haven't seen a clear proposal on how this would be accomplished.

meaning: something that is very difficult to do and needs a lot of effort and determination
meaning_uz: qilish juda qiyin bo'lgan va ko'p harakat va qat'iyatga muhtoj bo'lgan narsa
usage: Rehabilitation of the affected population will be an uphill task for the government.

meaning: full of talk, but low on action
meaning_uz: gapga to'la, lekin amalda past
usage: He has these grand plans of being an entrepreneur and owning a big business, but he never takes any action. He is all bark and no bite.

meaning: a man of many talents
meaning_uz: ko'p iste'dodli inson
usage: Patrick is such a brilliant artist and author - he is truly a man of parts.

meaning: to criticize, judge, or disapprove of someone
meaning_uz: kimnidir tanqid qilish, hukm qilish yoki ma'qullash
usage: I just know my boss is going to give me stick for that accounting error I made last week.

meaning: to delay/avoid making a decision
meaning_uz: qaror qabul qilishni kechiktirish/bermaslik uchun
usage: Has he decided which offer he is going to accept or is he still sitting on the fence?

meaning: available and ready to be won or taken
meaning_uz: mavjud va g'olib bo'lish yoki olishga tayyor
usage: There are hundreds of prizes up for grabs at the fair.

meaning: something that worsens an already difficult or negative situation
meaning_uz: allaqachon qiyin yoki salbiy vaziyatni yomonlashtiradigan narsa
usage: My financial situation is already dire, so that traffic ticket is a real turn of the screw.

meaning: to always do what someone tells you to do
meaning_uz: har doim birovning aytganini qilish uchun
usage: Powerful businessman seem to have the district officials dancing to their tune.

meaning: to bribe one discreetly, as by slipping money into their palm
meaning_uz: qo'llariga pul tushirib yuborganidek, ehtiyotkorlik bilan pora berish uchun
usage: I greased my brother's palm to stop him from telling Mom that I had a party while she was away.

meaning: to try to discover things that are not really related to you
meaning_uz: bilan bog'liq bo'lmagan narsalarni kashf etishga harakat qilish
usage: I wish he'd stop sticking his nose into my personal life!

meaning: to be very observant
meaning_uz: juda kuzatuvchi bo'lishi
usage: Mom has eyes like a hawk, so she'll definitely notice if you sneak some of those cookies out of the kitchen.

meaning: a highly unexpected or coincidental event, especially one that has an important or far-reaching influence on the future
meaning_uz: juda kutilmagan yoki tasodifiy hodisa, ayniqsa, kelajakka muhim yoki keng qamrovli ta'sir ko'rsatib
usage: Really, it was down to a twist of fate that I happened to get this job.

meaning: the imagining or discussion of a very unlikely future event or situation as if it were possible and might one day happen
meaning_uz: kelajakda juda ehtimoldan xoli bo'lmagan hodisa yoki holatni iloji boricha tasavvur qilish yoki muhokama qilish va bir kun sodir bo'lishi mumkin
usage: "Do you think you might be in line for promotion?" "No, it's just wishful thinking."

meaning: make an attempt to make someone say something nice to you or about you
meaning_uz: birovni sizga yoki sizga yaxshi gap aytishga urinish
usage: When the student said that he was still not confident of the subject after a score of 95 on 100 in the test, the teacher knew that he was only fishing for a compliment.

meaning: an encouraging stimulus
meaning_uz: rag'batlantiruvchi rag'batlantiruvchi
usage: The movie was a real shot in the arm for our crew.

meaning: to have a very large number of people
meaning_uz: juda ko'p sonli kishilarga ega bo'lishi
usage: Now that they have six children, their little house is bursting at the seams.

meaning: to become silent suddenly, usually because you are embarrassed or nervous, or do not want to talk about a particular subject
meaning_uz: to'satdan jim bo'lib qolish, odatda, uyatchan yoki asabiylashganingiz yoki muayyan mavzu haqida gapirishni istamasligingiz uchun
usage: He just clams up if you ask him about his childhood.

meaning: to deal with only a small part of a subject or a problem
meaning_uz: sub'ekt yoki muammoning faqat kichik qismi bilan shug'ullanish uchun
usage: The amount of aid that has been offered is hardly going to scratch the surface of the problem.

meaning: something that is completely unexpected
meaning_uz: butunlay kutilmagan narsa
usage: One day, out of the blue, she announced that she was leaving.

meaning: romantic and loving talk
meaning_uz: romantik va mehr-muhabbatli nutq
usage: They're the couple in the corner, whispering/murmuring sweet nothings to each other.

meaning: to irritate or exasperate
meaning_uz: g'azablantirish yoki g'azablantirish uchun
usage: Let's leave John alone for now - I think we brassed him off a bit with our criticism.

meaning: to become quiet and calm, to stop being loud or boisterous
meaning_uz: sokin va sokin bo'lish, baland ovozda yoki shovqinli bo'lishni to'xtatish uchun
usage: We piped down when we realized he was trying to tell us something important.

meaning: earn just enough money to live on
meaning_uz: yashash uchun etarli pul toping
usage: They were finding it hard to make ends meet.

meaning: to spoil a good situation with something unpleasant, to have influence over something
meaning_uz: yoqimsiz narsa bilan yaxshi vaziyatni talon-taroj qilish, biror narsa ustidan ta'sir o'tkazish
usage: Her father's illness had cast a shadow over the birth of her baby.

meaning: at the last possible moment
meaning_uz: mumkin bo'lgan oxirgi lahzada
usage: We got there just in the nick of time.

meaning: someone or something that is very annoying
meaning_uz: kimdir yoki juda zerikarli bo'lgan narsa
usage: That child is a real pain in the neck.

meaning: exactly as instructed, exactly as written
meaning_uz: aniq ko'rsatma bo'yicha, aynan yozilganidek
usage: I followed the recipe to the letter, but the cake did not turn out very well.

idiom: go down like a lead balloon
meaning: a total failure
meaning_uz: to'g'ari muvaffaqiyatsizlik
usage: The joke he cracked went down like a lead balloon.

meaning: to do wonderful or exciting things that cause a great or remarkable sensation in the world
meaning_uz: dunyoda katta yoki ajoyib hissiyotga sabab bo'ladigan ajoyib yoki hayajonli ishlarni amalga
usage: As a girl, Janet dreamed of setting the world on fire as a famous actress.

meaning: the most important piece of work done by a writer or artist
meaning_uz: yozuvchi yoki ijodkor tomonidan amalga oshirilgan eng muhim asar
usage: Picasso's Guernica is considered by many to be his magnum opus.

meaning: retributive or vengeful justice, retaliation, punishment in which an offender suffers what the victim has suffered
meaning_uz: qasos oluvchi yoki qasoskor adolat, aybdor jabrlanuvchi chekkan azobni tortadigan jazo
usage: Some guy took his wife, so he took the wives of others, it was an eye for an eye.

idiom: a house divided against itself cannot stand
meaning: if a group's members are in perpetual disagreement, the group will eventually cease to exist
meaning_uz: guruh a'zolari abadiy kelishmovchilikda bo'lsa, oxir-oqibat guruh mavjud bo'lishdan to'xtaydi
usage: The candidate urged the members of his political party to unite because he understood that a house divided against itself cannot stand.

meaning: to carefully review something and issue an opinion or analysis of it
meaning_uz: biror narsani diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqib, uni fikr yoki tahlil qilib
usage: My article in this month's issue casts an eye on all the big spring fashion shows.

meaning: to move quickly and directly toward something
meaning_uz: biror narsaga nisbatan tez va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri harakat qilish
usage: When he saw me in the kitchen, he made a beeline for the door.

meaning: more than one expected to encounter, experience, deal with, etc
meaning_uz: uchrashishi, tajriba o'tkazishi, shug'ullanishi va hokazolardan ko'p kutilgan
usage: This project is more work than I'd bargained for, I have no time to do anything else.

meaning: a mistake made unintentionally or unknowingly and without the intention of causing harm; a mistake that anyone might have made in similar circumstances
meaning_uz: bilmasdan yoki bilmasdan va zarar etkazish niyatida bo'lmagan holda qilingan xato; har kim shunga o'xshash vaziyatda yo'l qo'ygan bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan xato
usage: It was an honest mistake! How was I to know that you wouldn't want me to send that letter with the rest of the mail?

meaning: to cause someone or some group to become particularly excited and animated, especially in an angry or irritated manner
meaning_uz: birov yoki biror guruhning ayniqsa hayajonlanib, jonlanishiga sabab bo'lishi, ayniqsa, g'azablangan yoki g'azablangan tarzda
usage: Seeing that kind of injustice on the news always riles me up to no end.

meaning: a very good or worthy person
meaning_uz: juda yaxshi yoki munosib inson
usage: Mrs. Jones is the salt of the earth. She is the first to help anyone in trouble.

meaning: fall deeply and completely in love, especially suddenly
meaning_uz: chuqur va butunlay sevib qoladi, ayniqsa, to'satdan
usage: Tom and Mary are head over heels in love with each other and are going to get married next month.

meaning: extremely good
meaning_uz: nihoyatda yaxshi
usage: What a restaurant - the food was out of this world!

meaning: to operate, perform, function, or proceed exceptionally well or at the greatest possible speed or efficiency
meaning_uz: ishlash, bajarish, ishlash yoki juda yaxshi yoki eng katta tezlik yoki samaradorlik bilan davom etish
usage: We'll be hitting on all cylinders if we get Janet to join our team.

meaning: very well-dressed and fashionable, typically in an attempt to impress other people
meaning_uz: juda yaxshi kiyingan va moda, odatda, boshqa odamlarni hayratga solish maqsadida
usage: I have to be dressed to kill at this event tonight-a lot of important people will be there.

meaning: a particularly good or successful period of time
meaning_uz: ayniqsa yaxshi yoki muvaffaqiyatli davr
usage: 2004 was a banner year for astronomy.

meaning: a concept or topic that is not clearly defined or that exists somewhere between two extreme positions
meaning_uz: aniq belgilanmagan yoki ikki ekstremal pozitsiya o'rtasida biror joyda mavjud bo'lgan tushuncha yoki mavzu
usage: There's a large grey area regarding whether the use of the new surveillance technology is lawful.

meaning: a fault in someone's character or an argument that may cause problems for them
meaning_uz: birovning xarakteridagi xato yoki ularga muammo tug'dirishi mumkin bo'lgan argument
usage: A single chink in our armour at the negotiating table means we could lose out badly.

meaning: used to say that something is typical of America
meaning_uz: biror narsa Amerikaga xos deb aytadigan bo'lsak
usage: Baseball is as American as apple pie.

meaning: good for everyone who is involved
meaning_uz: shug'ullanuvchi har bir kishi uchun yaxshi
usage: Flexible working hours are a win-win situation for employers and employees.

idiom: put the cat among the pigeons
meaning: to do or say something that is likely to cause alarm, controversy, or unrest among a lot of people
meaning_uz: qilish yoki ko'pchilik orasida ogohlantirish, tortishuv yoki tartibsizliklarni keltirib chiqaradigan biror
usage: The bank is poised to put the cat among the pigeons this morning by slashing the cost of borrowing.

meaning: in, at, or during the period of one's greatest success, power, vigor, etc
meaning_uz: eng katta muvaffaqiyat, kuch, kuch va boshqalar davrida, ichida yoki
usage: In my heyday as a stock broker, I was making millions of dollars each year, but when the economy crashed, I lost nearly everything.

meaning: cause someone to remain alert and ready for anything that might happen
meaning_uz: kimdir hushyor va sodir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday narsaga tayyor bo'lishiga sabab bo'ladi
usage: He keeps changing the rules, just to keep us on our toes.

meaning: to do what you want or go where you want
meaning_uz: xohlagan ishingizni qilish yoki xohlagan joyingizga
usage: You're young and healthy and you have no commitments - the world is your oyster.

meaning: to be slightly ill or slightly unhappy
meaning_uz: bir oz kasal bo'lishi yoki biroz baxtsiz bo'lishi
usage: I think something is bugging John, because he's been rather out of sorts lately.

idiom: keep something straight in one's mind
meaning: to be able to understand something clearly and comprehensively; to keep the details of something clear in one's mind
meaning_uz: biror narsani aniq va har tomonlama tushuna bilishi; biror narsaning tafsilotlarini ongida aniq saqlash uchun
usage: This project is getting so out of control. I can barely keep it straight in my mind anymore!

meaning: inflict a humiliating defeat on someone
meaning_uz: kimgadir sharmandali mag'lubiyat
usage: They wiped the floor with us in a 3-0 win.

meaning: to consider or remember something when judging a situation
meaning_uz: vaziyatni hukm qilishda biror narsani ko'rib chiqish yoki eslab qolish
usage: I hope my teacher will take into account the fact that I was ill just before the exams when she marks my paper.

idiom: dot the i's and cross the t's
meaning: to pay a great deal of attention to the details of something, especially when you are trying to complete a task
meaning_uz: biror narsaning tafsilotlariga katta e'tibor berish, ayniqsa biror vazifani bajarishga harakat qilayotganda
usage: The negotiations are nearly finished, but we still have to dot the i's and cross the t's.

meaning: to die
meaning_uz: o'limga
usage: Any plant under my care kicks the bucket in about a week.

idiom: by the skin of ones teeth
meaning: narrowly, barely, usually used in regard to a narrow escape from a disaster
meaning_uz: tor, oz, odatda, falokatdan tor qochib qutulish borasida ishlatiladigan
usage: He passed the test by the skin of his teeth.

idiom: a burnt child dreads the fire
meaning: someone who has experienced some kind of negative situation or consequence will try to avoid making the same mistake or experiencing the same situation again
meaning_uz: qandaydir nojo'ya holat yoki oqibatni boshdan kechirgan odam aynan shu xatoga yo'l qo'ymaslikka yoki yana bir xil vaziyatni boshdan kechirishga harakat qiladi
usage: Joseph refuses to invest any money after losing his retirement fund during the stock market crash, a burnt child dreads the fire.

meaning: to engage in a verbal duel with someone, in which both parties continuously exchange arguments, quips, and retorts
meaning_uz: kimdir bilan og'zaki duelga kirishish uchun, bunda ikkala tomon ham doimiy ravishda tortishuvlar, so'zlar va retortlar almashishadi
usage: They got into some heated debate about whether Star Wars or Star Trek is better. They've been thrusting and parrying like that for the last hour.

meaning: perfectly judged; extremely accurate
meaning_uz: mukammal hukm qilingan; nihoyatda to'g'ri
usage: With only a few seconds left, the striker managed an inch-perfect goal from midfield.

meaning: to start working or studying hard
meaning_uz: ishlashni boshlash yoki astoydil o'rganishga
usage: If you want to get a passing grade this semester, you'll really need to knuckle down and study hard.

meaning: to behave in more extreme ways, or to try new things that have not been acceptable or tried before
meaning_uz: o'zini yanada extiyot yo'llar bilan tutishi, ya'ni ilgari ma'qul bo'lmagan yoki sinab ko'rilmagan yangi narsalarni sinab
usage: The company is renowned for pushing the envelope whenever they develop a new piece of technology.

meaning: something that is purchased without having been thoroughly inspected, often with negative consequences
meaning_uz: yaxshilab tekshirilmasdan sotib olingan narsa, ko'pincha salbiy oqibatlarga olib keladigan
usage: Purchasing a home without getting it inspected first is like buying a pig in a poke.

meaning: according to the information or reports that are available or from what people are saying
meaning_uz: mavjud bo'lgan ma'lumot yoki hisobotlarga ko'ra yoki odamlarning gaplaridan
usage: I don't know how we survived that plane crash. By all accounts, we should be dead right now!

meaning: a continuous period of great success, luck, or fortune; a winning streak
meaning_uz: katta muvaffaqiyat, omad yoki boylikning uzluksiz davri; g'alaba qozonish jarayoni
usage: I'm not usually any good at poker, but I had a hot hand last night.

meaning: an estimate
meaning_uz: hisob-kitob
usage: We're expecting sales of the book to generate around 10,000 dollars, although obviously that's just a ballpark figure.

idiom: A Leopard Can't Change His Spots
meaning: one cannot change who they are
meaning_uz: kim ekanligini o'zgartira olmaydi
usage: He is bound to fail the exam again, a Leopard cannot change his spots after all.

meaning: to live to be very old
meaning_uz: juda qari bo'lish uchun yashashga
usage: I think those of us here who are making old bones would agree that this policy flies in the face of what our country is supposed to stand for.

meaning: to betray someone's confidence
meaning_uz: birovning ishonchiga xiyonat qilish uchun
usage: The farmers feel they've been sold out by their government in the negotiations.

meaning: free of responsibilities, including romantic commitments
meaning_uz: vakolatlar, shu jumladan romantik majburiyatlar erkin
usage: Now that I have a family and a mortgage, I miss being footloose and fancy-free.

meaning: spoil a plan or disturb the status quo
meaning_uz: rejani buzing yoki status-kvoni bezovta qiling
usage: It will only upset the apple cart and confuse the issue if the topic is raised too soon.

meaning: to have or seek out new experiences, especially if one's experiences have been relatively limited
meaning_uz: yangi tajribalarga ega bo'lish yoki izlash, ayniqsa, tajribalari ancha cheklangan bo'lsa
usage: I can't believe that Molly has never left the state before! She seriously needs to expand her horizons!

meaning: to think or behave as though one is superior to others or better than one really is, to have or assume a pretentious or self-aggrandizing attitude
meaning_uz: o'zini boshqalardan ustun yoki aslidagidan yaxshiroqdek o'ylash yoki o'zini tutish, g'ayrioddiy yoki o'z-o'zini maqtash munosabatiga ega bo'lish yoki o'z zimmasiga olish
usage: I think John is really a decent fellow at heart, but I really wish he wouldn't give himself such airs about his writing abilities.

meaning: a situation in which everyone has the same chance of succeeding
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun har bir inson bir xil imkoniyatga ega bo'lgan vaziyat
usage: If the tax systems are different in each European country, how can industries start on a level playing field?

meaning: the continuing and spreading results of an event or action
meaning_uz: hodisa yoki harakatning davom etayotgan va tarqalayotgan natijalarini
usage: She always hoped that the kindness she showed others would have a positive ripple effect through her community.

meaning: an honest, affable, reliable, and trustworthy person
meaning_uz: xolis, xushmuomala, ishonchli va ishonchli shaxs
usage: Your dad's a good scout, you know that? He's helped me out of so many jams without even thinking twice.

meaning: a conclusive test of the success or value of something
meaning_uz: biror narsaning muvaffaqiyati yoki qiymatining aniq sinovi
usage: The training course was very interesting but the acid test will come when I start my new job.

meaning: to no longer be able to do something as good as you could before
meaning_uz: endi qo'lingizdan kelgancha yaxshi ish qila olmaslik
usage: He was once a great player, but with age, he has lost his touch.

meaning: to surprise someone in a way that makes the person feel confused or uncertain
meaning_uz: odamni sarosimaga soladigan yoki noaniq his qiladigan tarzda hayratda qoldirish
usage: The news caught her completely off guard - she didn't know what to say.

meaning: to have fallen victim to one's own trap or schemes
meaning_uz: o'z tuzog'i yoki sxemalari qurboni bo'lgan bo'lishi
usage: I tried to get my boss fired by planting drugs on him, but I was hoist by my own petard when the police caught me with them beforehand.

meaning: to do or say something in order to make people stop arguing and become calmer
meaning_uz: odamlarni tortishishni to'xtatish va tinchroq bo'lish maqsadida biror ish qilish yoki
usage: My husband is always arguing with my father, and I am the one who has to pour oil on troubled waters.

meaning: if what was planned cannot happen
meaning_uz: rejalashtirilgan narsa sodir bo'lmasa
usage: We could go to the beach or to my sister's house, and if all else fails, we can always find something to do at home.

meaning: on the verge of doing something or of having some imminent event happen, especially that which is bad or disastrous
meaning_uz: biror ish qilish yoki yaqinlashib kelayotgan biror voqea sodir bo'lishi arafasida, ayniqsa, yomon yoki halokatli
usage: The company is still doing business, but ever since the recession hit they've been teetering on the brink of closing down.

meaning: voluntarily, without being forced
meaning_uz: o'z xohishi bilan, majburlanmasdan
usage: He would not seek treatment of his own accord.

meaning: to bestow a particular responsibility or job on someone
meaning_uz: muayyan mas'uliyat yoki ishga birovga
usage: I have so much work to do now that my boss has retired and passed the baton to me.

meaning: to be ruthless, aggressive, or harsh in order to achieve a certain result, especially compared to previous, less aggressive tactics
meaning_uz: ma'lum natijaga erishish maqsadida shafqatsiz, tajovuzkor yoki qattiqqo'l bo'lish, ayniqsa oldingi, kamroq tajovuzkor taktikaga qaraganda
usage: I think it's time we play hardball with the suspect - he's not going to talk otherwise.

meaning: the same unpleasant experience or treatment that one has given to others
meaning_uz: birining boshqalarga bergan bir xil yoqimsiz tajribasi yoki muomala
usage: This team likes to play rough, so let's go out there and give them a taste of their own medicine!

meaning: the smallest or least important part of something in control of the larger or more important elements, a reversal of typical roles or dynamics of power
meaning_uz: kattaroq yoki undan muhim elementlarni boshqarishda biror narsaning eng kichik yoki eng kichik muhim qismi, odatda, hokimiyatning odatiy rollari yoki dinamikasining o'zgarishi
usage: They reorganized their entire weekly schedule just because their son likes to sleep in late. Talk about the tail wagging the dog.

meaning: a very angry argument, a big fight
meaning_uz: juda g'azablangan bahs, katta janjal
usage: Jim and Sally called off their wedding after they had a blazing row over their honeymoon destination.

meaning: to believe that something is absolutely true without any hesitation or reservations
meaning_uz: biror narsaning hech qanday shoshmasdan va e'tirozsiz mutlaqo haqiqat ekanligiga ishonish
usage: The beloved professor's opinions on the author are taken as gospel by his students.

meaning: to take the opportunity to do something at the present moment without worrying about the future
meaning_uz: fursatdan foydalanib, kelajak haqida qayg'urga solmasdan hozirgi vaqtda biror
usage: This is our time. Let's seize the day! We may never get a chance to do this again.

idiom: take your cue from someone or something
meaning: to be strongly influenced by something or someone
meaning_uz: biror narsa yoki kimningdir kuchli ta'sir ko'rsatishi
usage: The architects took their cue for the design of the new hotel from the nearby banks.

meaning: to make distorted, silly, or humorous facial expressions at someone, usually for one's own or someone else's amusement, or as a show of disgust
meaning_uz: birovga, odatda, o'z yoki o'yin-kulgi uchun yoki jirkanchlik ko'rsatuvi sifatida buzib ko'rsatilgan, ahmoqona yoki hazil-mutoyiba yuz ifodalarini qilish
usage: Jimmy, quit making faces at Sarah this instant and pay attention!

meaning: an issue, law, or matter that is no longer important or that no longer has force or power
meaning_uz: endi muhim bo'lmagan yoki endi kuch va kuchga ega bo'lmagan masala, qonun yoki materiya
usage: The ceasefire agreement was a dead letter as soon as it was signed.

meaning: the most easily achieved of a set of tasks, measures, goals, etc
meaning_uz: vazifalar, chora-tadbirlar, maqsadlar va boshqalar to'plamining eng oson erishilishi
usage: Don't be satisfied with the low-hanging fruit. Go after the hard-sell types.

meaning: out of sight of the public at a theatre or organization, secretly
meaning_uz: teatr yoki tashkilotda ommaning ko'z o'ngida, yashirincha
usage: Diplomatic manoeuvres going on behind the scenes.

meaning: there is no explanation for people's preferences
meaning_uz: kishilarning afzalliklariga izoh yo'q
usage: Some people seemed to like the music, although I thought it was worse than noise. There's no accounting for taste.

meaning: a person who prefers to be awake late at night
meaning_uz: kech uyg'oq bo'lishni afzal ko'rgan inson
usage: In my younger days, I was quite a night owl and would often stay up until sunrise.

meaning: to force someone to obey one's wishes or commands, to make someone act in accordance with one's authority
meaning_uz: birovning xohishiga yoki buyrug'iga bo'ysunishga majbur qilish, birovning vakolatiga muvofiq harakat qilish
usage: The boy had always behaved badly, but the new headmaster managed to bring him to heel.

meaning: take care of issues that are not critical but have remained outstanding
meaning_uz: tanqidiy bo'lmagan, ammo dolzarb bo'lib qolgan masalalarni hal qilish
usage: I'm just about ready to move to Europe, but I need to tie up some loose ends with my ex-girlfriend before I go.

idiom: heave in sight or into view
meaning: come into view
meaning_uz: ko'rinishga ega bo'lib
usage: They held out until a British fleet hove in sight.

idiom: not a peep from/Out of someone
meaning: not a single word or sound from someone
meaning_uz: birovdan birorta so'z ham, tovush ham yo'q
usage: There wasn't a peep from the students for the rest of the class after I sent Jonathan to detention.

meaning: to take great risks, take the danger of a shared enterprise upon oneself
meaning_uz: katta xavf-xatarlarni qo'lga kiritish, o'z ustida umumiy korxona xavfini qo'lga kiritish
usage: Who's going to bell the cat and tell dad we wrecked his car?

meaning: honest and not trying to deceive anyone
meaning_uz: xolis va hech kimni aldashga urinmaslik
usage: The deal was completely open and above board.

meaning: sufficient to suit the purpose at hand without needing to be perfect
meaning_uz: mukammal bo'lish kerak bo'lmasdan qo'ldagi maqsadga mos keladigan etarli
usage: There are still a few kinks to work out in how users' comments are displayed, but it's good enough for jazz at the moment.

meaning: to overcome an addiction to something
meaning_uz: biror narsaga bo'lgan giyohvandlikni yengib o'tishga
usage: After saying such horrible things to my parents, I decided it was finally time to kick the booze for good.

meaning: to do something without worrying about the risk or negative results
meaning_uz: xavf yoki nojo'ya natijalar haqida qayg'urmay biror ish qilish
usage: You could always throw caution to the wind and have another glass of wine.

meaning: neat and tidy looking
meaning_uz: to'g'ri va to'g'ri ko'rinish
usage: Bob's home is as nice as ninepence ever since he has got married.

meaning: to remove doubt from a situation, to discuss or otherwise confront a troublesome issue
meaning_uz: shubhani vaziyatdan olib tashlash, muammoli masalani muhokama qilish yoki boshqa yo'l bilan ro'baro' qilish
usage: They were able to clear the air by producing the document in question, so that we could all see it for ourselves.

meaning: a very small amount compared to the amount needed
meaning_uz: zarur bo'lgan miqdorga qaraganda juda oz miqdorda
usage: I'm glad Tony started repaying the money he borrowed from me, but the five dollars he gave me yesterday is just a drop in the ocean compared to what he still owes.

meaning: a result that can be predicted with certainty, an inevitable result
meaning_uz: ishonch bilan bashorat qilish mumkin bo'lgan natija, albatta natija
usage: Considering the poor performance of the team so far this season, it's a foregone conclusion that they won't make it to the championship.

meaning: the very apparent signs that something bad will happen in the future
meaning_uz: kelajakda biror yomon narsa sodir bo'lishining juda yaqqol belgilari
usage: You need to resign now. The writing on the wall says the company is going to fold, and there's no reason you need to go down with it.

meaning: a strong desire for money, especially bribes
meaning_uz: pulga bo'lgan kuchli intilish, ayniqsa pora
usage: Whenever he sees expensive luggage, the hotel doorman gets an itching palm.

meaning: to talk incessantly and/or at great length
meaning_uz: to'xtovsiz va/yoki katta uzunlikda gaplashish uchun
usage: I became so bored while the professor jawed away at us that I nearly fell asleep in the middle of the lecture.

meaning: food that is full of taste and of an exemplary quality
meaning_uz: ta'mga to'la va namunali sifatga ega bo'lgan oziq-ovqat
usage: She is such a wonderful cook. The cakes that she bakes are a dish fit for the gods!

meaning: in a position in which other people are eager to criticize or attack
meaning_uz: boshqa odamlar tanqid qilishga yoki hujum qilishga intilgan holatda
