usage: The CEO has been in the cross hairs of politicians and business people alike for his recent comments on immigration.

idiom: does what it says on the tin
meaning: if something does what it says on the tin, it does exactly what it is intended to do
meaning_uz: biror narsa tindirmada aytganini qilsa, maqsadga muvofiq bo'lgan ishni aniq
usage: The hotel does exactly what it says on the tin and offers customers a relaxing break.

meaning: to leave one in a situation that they have little chance of escaping or improving
meaning_uz: qochib qolish yoki yaxshilash imkoniyati kam bo'lgan vaziyatda bittasini qoldirish uchun
usage: The departure of several key employees has left the business high and dry.

idiom: take with a pinch of salt
meaning: to not completely believe something that you are told, since it is unlikely to be true
meaning_uz: sizga aytilgan narsaga to'liq ishonmaslik kerak, chunki bu haqiqat bo'lishi mumkin emas
usage: You have to take everything she says with a pinch of salt, because she tends to exaggerate.

meaning: to stop understanding or following something, such as an explanation, because one has become distracted or confused
meaning_uz: biror narsani tushunish yoki ergashishni to'xtatish, masalan, tushuntirish, chunki biri chalg'itib yoki chalkashib ketgan
usage: I think this writer is trying to intentionally make us lose the thread so that the story becomes disorienting.

meaning: very difficult or almost impossible to find
meaning_uz: topish juda qiyin yoki deyarli imkonsiz
usage: I tried to find my lost key on the sandy beach, but it was like trying to find a needle in the haystack.

meaning: to discourage or deter someone from doing something, to make something seem less appealing or reduce someone's enthusiasm for something
meaning_uz: birovni biror ish qilishdan to'xtatish yoki to'xtatish, biror narsani kamroq chiroyli ko'rsatish yoki birovning biror narsaga bo'lgan qiziqishini kamaytirish uchun
usage: News of unrest in the area really poured cold water on our plans to vacation there.

meaning: used in reference to something that is constantly changing, especially unpredictably
meaning_uz: doimo o'zgarib turadigan narsaga ishora qilib ishlatiladi, ayniqsa, kutilmagan
usage: Whether something is accepted depends upon the shifting sands of taste.

meaning: to ask someone's advice about a subject the person knows a lot about
meaning_uz: kishi ko'p bilgan mavzu yuzasidan birovning maslahatini so'rashga
usage: Can I pick your brain about how you got rid of those weeds?

meaning: a state of ruin or failure due to having become useless or obsolete
meaning_uz: foydasiz yoki eskirganligi sababli halokat yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlik holati
usage: Once a booming industry before the age of the Internet, home video rental has largely ended up in the knacker's yard these days.

meaning: to be negative about someone's ideas or plans
meaning_uz: birovning g'oyalari yoki rejalariga nojo'ya bo'lishi
usage: You're always throwing cold water on my suggestions.

meaning: every part of a place
meaning_uz: Joyning barcha boʻlagida.
usage: Every nook and cranny of the house was stuffed with souvenirs of their trips abroad.

meaning: lacking in manners or refinement
meaning_uz: odob-axloq yoki mukammallashtirishga ega bo'lmagan
usage: I can't believe he just put his elbows on the dinner table - why, he must be as common as an old shoe!

meaning: something that can be both beneficial and problematic
meaning_uz: ham foydali, ham muammoli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa
usage: This meeting is a double-edged sword - it's a great chance to get the firm wider exposure, but we're just not prepared enough for it.

meaning: to be interested in something and be likely to do a particular activity
meaning_uz: biror narsaga qiziqib, muayyan faoliyat bilan shug'ullanish ehtimolini
usage: He said he was leaning toward entering the race for governor.

idiom: look a gift horse in the mouth
meaning: to show a lack of appreciation or gratitude when receiving a gift
meaning_uz: sovg'a olayotganda minnatdorlik yoki minnatdorchilikning yo'qligini ko'rsatish uchun
usage: I know Aunt Jean isn't your favorite person, but she gave you that beautiful sweater as a present, so don't look a gift horse in the mouth!

meaning: increase your demands or the risks in a situation in order to achieve a better result
meaning_uz: yaxshiroq natijaga erishish maqsadida o'z talablaringizni yoki vaziyatdagi xavf-xatarlarni oshirish
usage: The government has upped the ante by refusing to negotiate until a ceasefire has been agreed.

meaning: to be freshly printed, to be a newly-circulating bit of news or gossip
meaning_uz: yangi chop etilishi, yangilik yoki g'iybatning yangi tarqalayotgan bitigiga
usage: The latest edition of the student newspaper is hot off the press, and my class is going to distribute it at lunch.

meaning: to talk with someone in an informal and friendly way
meaning_uz: birov bilan norasmiy va do'stona tarzda suhbatlashishga
usage: We sat in a bar most of the evening just chewing the fat.

meaning: an inflated notion of one's strength, ego, or bravado due to excess consumption of alcohol
meaning_uz: spirtli ichimliklarni ortiqcha iste'mol qilish tufayli kuch, ego yoki jasorat haqida inflatsiyalangan tasavvur
usage: When he drinks, Jeff always gets beer muscles and wants to fight every guy in the bar.

meaning: take something away from one person to pay another, discharge one debt only to incur another
meaning_uz: boshqasini to'lash uchun bir kishidan biror narsa olib qo'ying, bir qarzni faqat boshqasiga
usage: Funding for the new college was a case of robbing Peter to pay Paul, reducing the budget all around for other not so well known colleges.

meaning: when something good or bad happens, similarly good or bad things tend to follow
meaning_uz: yaxshi yoki yomon narsa sodir bo'lganda, shunga o'xshash yaxshi yoki yomon narsalar ergashishga moyil
usage: I have a new supervisor at the office, three new assistants to train, and enough work to keep me busy for months - when it rains, it pours.

meaning: change your opinion or the way you feel about something
meaning_uz: fikringizni yoki biror narsaga bo'lgan munosabatingizni o'zgartiring
usage: She was going to sell her house but had a change of heart at the last minute.

meaning: continuously or repeatedly over a long period of time
meaning_uz: uzoq muddat davomida uzluksiz yoki takroran
usage: I have to do the same boring jobs day in day out.

meaning: an honest, ethical person who makes good decisions
meaning_uz: to'g'ri qaror qabul qiladigan xolis, etuk shaxs
usage: Kristen was often mocked by her peers for being a straight arrow who always followed the rules and stayed out of trouble.

meaning: to make it easier for something to happen
meaning_uz: biror narsaning sodir bo'lishiga sharoit yaratish uchun
usage: An aid programme was established to oil the wheels of economic reform in the region.

meaning: to frequently drink a lot of alcohol
meaning_uz: tez-tez ko'p spirtli ichimlik ichish uchun
usage: I'm not surprised to hear that Karl got drunk again last night - that guy drinks like a fish!

meaning: to make a situation more confused and less easy to understand or deal with
meaning_uz: vaziyatni yanada chalkash va tushunish yoki bartaraf etish uchun kamroq oson qilish uchun
usage: The lawyer was trying to muddy the waters in order to make his client look less guilty.

meaning: a clever method used by people who are experienced in a particular type of work or activity
meaning_uz: muayyan ish yoki faoliyat turida tajribaga ega bo'lgan kishilar tomonidan qo'llaniladigan aqlli usul
usage: Magazines often improve photographs before they print them - it's one of the tricks of the trade.

meaning: to use one's own intelligence and intellectual ability
meaning_uz: o'z aql-zakovat va intellektual qobiliyatidan foydalanishga
usage: Jenny finally remembered to bring the right books home to do her homework. I'm glad she's finally using her loaf.

meaning: a problem that everyone knows very well but no one talks about because it is taboo, embarrassing, etc.
meaning_uz: hamma juda yaxshi biladigan, lekin hech kim gapirmaydigan muammo, chunki bu tabu, uyatli va boshqalar.
usage: The fact that his 35 year old brother was still financially dependent on his parents was a big elephant in the room at every family gathering.

meaning: to be thought of by one
meaning_uz: biri tomonidan o'ylab ko'rilishi
usage: Take time to form your responses to the interviewer - don't just blurt out the first thing that crosses your mind.

meaning: to do or say something that helps you to get rid of strong feelings or energy
meaning_uz: qilish yoki kuchli his-tuyg'ular yoki energiyadan xalos bo'lishga yordam beradigan biror
usage: She jogs after work to let off steam.

meaning: to remain closely informed about something, to follow the developments of something or some situation
meaning_uz: biror narsa haqida yaqindan xabardor bo'lib qolish, biror narsa yoki qandaydir vaziyatning o'zgarishlariga rioya qilish
usage: As a news correspondent for the region, it's my job to keep abreast of any changes in the political landscape here.

meaning: to declare the end of a task
meaning_uz: vazifaning yakunini e'lon qilish uchun
usage: We have been at this for hours, let's call it a day and come back tomorrow when we are fresh.

meaning: to speak to someone angrily when there is no reason to
meaning_uz: uchun hech qanday sabab bo'lmaganda birov bilan g'azab bilan gaplashish
usage: What's wrong with the boss today? I just tried to ask him a question, and he totally bit my head off!

meaning: to try to defeat someone by tricking that person into making a mistake so that you have an advantage over them
meaning_uz: ulardan ustunlikka ega bo'lishingiz uchun o'sha odamni xatoga yo'l qo'yishga aldab, birovni mag'lub etishga harakat qilish
usage: The popular singer spent a large proportion of the week playing cat and mouse with the press.

meaning: friends and relatives, people known to someone
meaning_uz: do'stlar va qarindoshlar, kimgadir ma'lum bo'lgan kishilar
usage: I was delighted to find all my kith and kin waiting for me at the airport to welcome me home.

meaning: make a great effort to think of or remember something
meaning_uz: biror narsani o'ylash yoki eslash uchun katta harakat qiling
usage: Meg racked her brain for inspiration.

idiom: the wolf is at the door
meaning: some danger, threat, or calamity imminent or at hand, often used in plural constructions
meaning_uz: ba'zi xavf, tahdid yoki kulfat yaqin yoki qo'lda, ko'pincha ko'p qurilish ishlatiladigan
usage: Our nation is facing unprecedented threats from all over the world. The wolves are at our door, and we need to be prepared to confront them.

meaning: a brief period of celebrity or notoriety
meaning_uz: mashhurlik yoki mashhurlikning qisqa davri
usage: Jane had her fifteen minutes of fame when she appeared on the nightly news broadcast.

meaning: to give one the freedom or permission to take any action in pursuit of a desire or goal, especially spending as much money or using as much resources as needed
meaning_uz: istak yoki maqsadga intilishda har qanday chora ko'rish uchun erkinlik yoki ruxsat berish, ayniqsa, ko'p pul sarflash yoki kerak bo'lgancha mablag'lardan foydalanish
usage: The company was having a difficult time retaining good employees so the CEO gave the manager a blank check to increase salaries and restructure his department.

meaning: the ability to ignore verbal attacks or criticism from others
meaning_uz: boshqalardan og'zaki hujumlar yoki tanqidlarga e'tibor bermaslik qobiliyatini
usage: If you're going to pursue a career in politics, you're going to have to develop a thick skin and not let the criticism of your detractors bother you.

idiom: at the end of your rope
meaning: to have no more patience or strength
meaning_uz: ortiq sabr va kuch-quvvatga ega bo'lmasligi
usage: I'm at the end of my rope with these kids!

meaning: confused, not well organized, or giving importance to unexpected things
meaning_uz: sarosimaga tushgan, yaxshi tashkil etilmagan yoki kutilmagan narsalarga ahamiyat berib
usage: The government's topsy-turvy priorities meant that the spending on education would remain low.

meaning: used to indicate that a mistake or instance of misconduct should be excused because it has not caused damage
meaning_uz: zarar etkazmaganligi sababli xato yoki xatti-harakatlar misolini oqlash kerakligini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi
usage: Strictly speaking it was petty trespassing, but no harm, no foul.

idiom: make a mountain out of a molehill
meaning: to make a major issue out of a minor one,  to exaggerate
meaning_uz: katta masalani kichikdan chiqarish, haddan tashqari
usage: You are making a mountain out of a molehill. You wrote one bad essay, it does not mean you are going to fail.

meaning: to fail to conduct oneself in a way that helps or reflects well on one's group; to let down the group
meaning_uz: o'z-o'zini yordam beradigan yoki o'z guruhida yaxshi fikr yuritadigan tarzda o'tkaza olmasligi; guruhni xafa qilish uchun
usage: I'm rubbish at football, so I'd rather not play than let the side down.

meaning: to rise to a very high level
meaning_uz: juda yuqori darajaga ko'tarilishi
usage: Real estate prices have gone through the roof.

meaning: to do mathematical work involving large amounts of information or numbers
meaning_uz: ko'p miqdorda axborot yoki sonlar ishtirokida matematik ishlarni bajarishga
usage: Civil engineering is not just about crunching numbers and solving technical matters, it requires a lot of creativity too.

meaning: to clearly separate or create boundaries for two things, to establish a figurative boundary that someone or some group refuses to cross or beyond which no further advance or compromise is accepted
meaning_uz: ikki narsa uchun chegaralarni aniq ajratish yoki yaratish, kimdir yoki qandaydir guruh o'tishdan bosh tortadigan yoki undan tashqarida ilgarilab borish yoki murosa qabul qilinmagan ramziy chegarani o'rnatish uchun
usage: If you're going to work closely with your wife, you really need to draw the line between your professional life and your personal life.

meaning: do something to appease someone, typically by making a minor concession or helping them in a small way
meaning_uz: birovni tinchlantirish uchun biror narsa qilish, odatda, kichik imtiyoz berish yoki ularga kichik yo'l bilan yordam berish orqali
usage: The finance minister threw first time home buyers a bone in the form of a minor tax benefit.

meaning: attract a great deal of attention or interest
meaning_uz: katta e'tibor yoki qiziqishni jalb
usage: The new concept car is really turning heads at the auto show and attracting a lot of press.

meaning: a dishonest or ill-behaved person
meaning_uz: Nohaq yoki nohaq odam
usage: We could tell he was a bad egg even at a young age.

meaning: a complete change of opinion or belief
meaning_uz: fikr yoki e'tiqodning to'liq o'zgarishi
usage: Everyone was surprised when the candidate made a complete volte-face on her stance on taxes.

meaning: to move quickly, to accelerate or go faster
meaning_uz: tez harakat qilish, tezlashtirish yoki tezroq borish
usage: We'll need to hit the gas if we want to make it to the movie on time.

meaning: exactly what is wanted or needed
meaning_uz: istalgan yoki kerak bo'lgan narsa aniq
usage: Thanks, a strong cup of coffee in the morning is just what the doctor ordered.

meaning: have a subordinate role to someone or something, be treated as less important than someone or something
meaning_uz: birovga yoki biror narsaga bo'ysunuvchi rolga ega bo'lish, kimgadir yoki biror narsadan kamroq ahamiyatga ega deb qaralishi
usage: He resented playing second fiddle to his younger brother.

meaning: a time or event that seems unlikely or will never come to pass
meaning_uz: ehtimoldan xoli bo'lib ko'rinadigan yoki hech qachon sodir bo'lmaydigan vaqt yoki hodisa
usage: It'll be a cold day in July before they get that new interstate built.

meaning: said when you are pretending to be sorry for using a word that may be considered offensive
meaning_uz: g'azabli deb hisoblanishi mumkin bo'lgan so'zni ishlatganingiz uchun o'zingizni afsusda ko'rsatayotganingizda aytdi
usage: Pardon my French, but that's a damned shame!

meaning: to reach adulthood, to develop or progress fully
meaning_uz: voyaga yetishi, rivojlanishi yoki to'la rivoj
usage: Watching my daughters come of age has been the biggest joy of my life.

meaning: fully and deeply engrossed in a thought or idea, often to such a degree as to be unaware of or insensitive to the outside world
meaning_uz: fikr yoki g'oyaga to'liq va chuqur singib ketgan, ko'pincha tashqi dunyoga bexabar yoki e'tiborsiz bo'lish darajasigacha
usage: It's no use trying to talk to Helen when she's lost in thought like that, it's as if we don't even exist!

meaning: any serious, difficult, or arduous work or activities
meaning_uz: har qanday jiddiy, qiyin yoki og'ir ish yoki faoliyat
usage: I'm only the assistant manager, but I'm the one who does all the heavy lifting in the company.

meaning: to look ill and pale
meaning_uz: kasal va rang-barang ko'rinishga ega bo'lish
usage: Some of the passengers looked kind of green around the gills after the trip!

meaning: problems that happen in the early stages of doing something new
meaning_uz: yangi bir ishni bajarishning dastlabki bosqichlarida sodir bo'ladigan muammolar
usage: There were the usual teething troubles at the beginning of the project, but that's to be expected.

meaning: to affect in someone an intense feeling of fright, horror, or revulsion
meaning_uz: birovga qo'rquv, dahshat yoki nafrat hissi ta'sir qilish
usage: When we were camping last weekend, we heard a scream in the night that froze our blood.

meaning: in or into an isolated place
meaning_uz: ichida yoki kimsasiz joyga
usage: We tried to find locations slightly off the beaten track, to have an adventure.

meaning: to faint, sicken, collapse, die or fail in large numbers
meaning_uz: hushidan ketish, kasal bo'lish, qulash, o'lish yoki ko'p sonli muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash
usage: When one of the children in the class got infected, most of the other children started dropping like flies.

idiom: throw your hat into the ring
meaning: to announce your intention of entering a competition or election
meaning_uz: musobaqa yoki saylovga kirish niyatingizni e'lon qilish uchun
usage: After Arnold Schwarzenegger was elected governor of California, it seemed like all sorts of celebrities tried tossing their hats in the ring.

meaning: to happen
meaning_uz: bo'lishi
usage: Our only hope now is that these dire predictions will not come to pass.

meaning: to be worried and not relaxed
meaning_uz: xavotirga tushish va dam olmaslik
usage: He seemed ill at ease and not his usual self.

meaning: exactly the thing that is or was needed or called for
meaning_uz: bo'lgan yoki kerak bo'lgan yoki chaqirilgan narsani aniq
usage: The new opening act turned out to be just the ticket for the variety show - they were a hit!

meaning: used to tell someone to be quiet or stop making so much noise
meaning_uz: birovga sukut saqlashni yoki shunchalik shovqin qilishni to'xtatishni aytardi
usage: Hey, put a sock in it, will you? I'm trying to work here.

meaning: to have a physical fight or a serious argument with someone
meaning_uz: jismoniy kurash yoki birov bilan jiddiy tortishuvga ega bo'lish
usage: Demonstrators nearly came to blows with the police during the march.

meaning: a person who likes to meddle or pry into other people's lives
meaning_uz: boshqa odamlar hayotiga aralashish yoki pry qilishni yaxshi ko'radigan inson
usage: I have to be careful about what I tell Betty because she's such a nosy parker that she'll bombard you with questions at the slightest provocation.

meaning: when you are in a very difficult or dangerous situation, especially one that makes you understand the true value of people or things
meaning_uz: juda qiyin yoki xavfli vaziyatda bo'lganingizda, ayniqsa, odamlar yoki narsalarning haqiqiy qadrini tushunishga undaydigan
usage: One day when the chips are down, you will know who your true friends are.

meaning: a place that is full of something good
meaning_uz: yaxshi narsaga to'la joy
usage: Though small, this museum is a veritable treasure trove of history.

meaning: a singular element of truth or wisdom within a greater story, narrative, speech, or claim, especially when most or all other elements are fictitious or of questionable veracity
meaning_uz: katta hikoya, hikoya, nutq yoki da'vo ichida haqiqat yoki donolikning yagona elementi, ayniqsa boshqa elementlarning aksariyati yoki barchasi xayoliy yoki shubhali haqiqiylik bo'lganda
usage: Although he get's criticized severely, there is a certain kernel of truth in his writings.

meaning: very common or ordinary
meaning_uz: juda keng tarqalgan yoki oddiy
usage: Although his new book was launched with much fanfare, it is just an ordinary, garden variety mystery story.

meaning: a mild exclamation of surprise, alarm, dismay, annoyance, or exasperation
meaning_uz: hayrat, signal, bezovtalik, g'azab yoki g'azabning engil qo'zg'atuvchisi
usage: Goodness me, look at the time! How is it nearly midnight already?

meaning: to learn something by an unpleasant experience
meaning_uz: yoqimsiz tajriba bo'yicha biror narsani o'rganishga
usage: I found out the hard way that it's difficult to work and go to school at the same time.

meaning: to reminisce over memories of past events, especially happy ones
meaning_uz: o'tgan voqealar, ayniqsa, baxtlilar haqidagi xotiralar haqida eslash uchun
usage: My grandmother spends more time walking down memory lane these days than talking about the present.

idiom: by any stretch of the imagination
meaning: as much or as far as one is able to imagine or believe, usually used in the negative
meaning_uz: ko'p yoki bir kishi tasavvur qila oladigan yoki ishona oladigan darajada, odatda negativda qo'llaniladigan
usage: I don't see how anyone by any stretch of the imagination could fail to understand what my last sentence meant.

idiom: have a wolf by the ears
meaning: to be in a difficult situation from which it is as dangerous to extricate oneself as it is to remain in it
meaning_uz: o'zini o'zi chiqarish xavfli bo'lgan qiyin vaziyatda bo'lishi unda qolish kabi
usage: The authoritarian regime has the wolf by the ear with the way it treats the population.

meaning: in a confused and excited state
meaning_uz: sarosimaga tushgan va hayajonlangan holatda
usage: When economic statistics are first published they grab headlines and put markets in a flutter.

meaning: accept misfortune courageously or stoically
meaning_uz: baxtsizlikni mardona yoki stoik qabul
usage: One of her great strengths is her ability to take it on the chin.

meaning: to look exceptionally attractive or in very robust health
meaning_uz: nihoyatda jozibali ko'rinishga yoki o'ta mustahkam sog'liqda
usage: Wow, George looks like a million dollars in that new suit!

meaning: courageous action is often rewarded
meaning_uz: mardonavor harakat ko'pincha mukofotlanadi
usage: I decided to ask out the most popular girl in school because fortune favors the brave, right?

meaning: to cause someone to be very angry
meaning_uz: birovning juda g'azablanishiga sabab bo'lishi
usage: When I hear stories of cruelty to animals, it makes my blood boil.

meaning: an attempt that is not expected to succeed or has very little chance of working
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatga erishishi kutilmagan yoki ishlash imkoniyati juda kam bo'lgan urinish
usage: Well, this is just a shot in the dark, but I'm going to say that the answer to the question is 52.

meaning: to think about, consider, or keep in mind someone or something in regards to the future
meaning_uz: kelajakka nisbatan biror kimsa yoki nimanidir o'ylab, o'ylab ko'rish yoki esda saqlash
usage: We'll be taking into account your years of loyal service while we consider what should be done.

meaning: to quash or suppress something; to control something so as to keep it from flourishing, increasing, or succeeding
meaning_uz: biror narsani bekor qilish yoki bostirish; gullab-yashnashi, ko'payishi yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishishidan saqlanishi uchun biror narsani boshqarishga
usage: We need to keep the lid on rumors about the company going bankrupt.

meaning: to be available or put forward, as for consideration, acceptance, discussion, etc
meaning_uz: ko'rib chiqish, qabul qilish, muhokama qilish va boshqalar uchun mavjud bo'lishi yoki ilgari surilishi
usage: I wouldn't wait too long to accept the job offer - it might not be on the table for very long.

meaning: an attitude of moral superiority
meaning_uz: axloqiy ustunlikka munosabat
usage: My sister needs to get off her high horse and stop lecturing me because I know she was a troublemaker as a teenager!

meaning: an oath expressing surprise, shock, frustration, anger, or annoyance
meaning_uz: hayrat, shov-shuv, g'amginlik, g'azab yoki g'azabni bildiruvchi qasamyod
usage: Good God! If we'd stopped the car one second later, that train would have hit us!

meaning: to be very angry
meaning_uz: juda g'azablanishi
usage: They're up in arms over the new management structure.

meaning: logical explanation
meaning_uz: mantiqiy tushuntirish
usage: His mood suddenly changed without rhyme or reason.

meaning: have a great financial success
meaning_uz: katta moliyaviy muvaffaqiyatga erishish
usage: They made a killing with the sale of their London house.

meaning: only by facing, dealing with, or subjecting oneself to difficulty or hardship will one truly improve or progress
meaning_uz: faqat duch kelish, bartaraf etish yoki o'zini qiyinchilik yoki qiyinchiliklarga duchor qilish orqali bir kishi chindan ham yaxshilanadi yoki rivojlanadi
usage: The road to becoming a doctor is long, hard, and exhausting, not to mention expensive! But no pain, no gain.

meaning: a situation in which someone cannot make a fair decision because they will be affected by the result
meaning_uz: natijasidan ta'sirlangani uchun kimdir adolatli qaror qabul qila olmaydigan holat
usage: I need to declare a conflict of interest here - one of the candidates for the job is a friend of mine.

meaning: to walk through the streets looking for a job
meaning_uz: ish izlab ko'chalarda yurishga
usage: Mary had children to feed, so she kept pounding the pavement until she finally landed a job at a burger restaurant.

meaning: to be too busy
meaning_uz: juda band bo'lishi uchun
usage: If you have too much on your plate, I can help you out.

meaning: to continue doing something even when you have no energy left, to operate with low resources or money
meaning_uz: energiyangiz qolmaganda ham biror ishni davom ettirish, kam resurs yoki pul bilan ishlash
usage: After having partied late into the night, he was running on fumes the next day at work.

meaning: some backup that someone has in case of potential problems, often financial ones
meaning_uz: mumkin bo'lgan muammolar yuzaga kelganda, ko'pincha moliyaviy zaxira
usage: With the unpredictability of freelance work, I always make sure I have money in my savings account as a safety net.

meaning: loud argument or disagreement that is not usually serious
meaning_uz: odatda jiddiy bo'lmagan balandparvoz tortishuv yoki kelishmovchilik
usage: A bit of argy-bargy between actor and director.

meaning: harshly or unfairly treated
meaning_uz: qo'pol yoki adolatsiz muomalada bo'lgan
usage: She would be justified in feeling hard done by after what he did to her.

meaning: used to emphasize one's certainty
meaning_uz: birining ishonchini ta'kidlash uchun ishlatiladi
usage: I'd bet dollars to doughnuts he's a medical student.

meaning: time when something important is to begin
meaning_uz: muhim narsa boshlanishi kerak bo'lgan vaqt
usage: I have so much studying left to do before the exam, and zero hour is 8 AM!

meaning: said when you think that it is better for someone or something to be late than never to arrive or to happen
meaning_uz: hech qachon kelmaslikdan yoki sodir bo'lgandan ko'ra, kimdir yoki biror narsa kech bo'lgani yaxshiroq deb o'ylaganingizda
usage: After two weeks, I finally got a return phone call from that company. Better late than never, I guess.

idiom: sure as God made little green apples
meaning: absolutely certain
meaning_uz: mutlaqo aniq
usage: I'm as sure as God made little green apples that he's the one who has been provoking everyone against me.

meaning: to deal with every part of a situation or activity
meaning_uz: vaziyat yoki faoliyatning har bir bo'g'ini bilan shug'ullanish
usage: I think I have covered all the bases - I called everyone, ordered the food , and bought some decorations.

meaning: laughing uncontrollably, generally used for an audience
meaning_uz: nazoratsiz kulish, umuman auditoriya uchun ishlatiladigan
usage: The new comedy series had them rolling in the aisles.

meaning: say or do something which upsets or annoys people
meaning_uz: odamlarni gʻazablantiradigan yoki gʻazablantiradigan ishni aytish yoki
usage: His new management style ruffled a few feathers.

meaning: to have a lot of energy and enthusiasm
meaning_uz: ko'p kuch va g'ayratga ega bo'lishi
usage: Kelly's outstanding results in her finals made her parents full of beans.

meaning: to stop something from continuing or worsening
meaning_uz: biror narsani davom ettirish yoki yomonlashishdan to'xtatish uchun
usage: Once the people turn on you, you'll have a hard time stemming the tide of rebellion.

meaning: one who always agrees with authority figures, in order to gain favor with them
meaning_uz: hokimiyat vakillari bilan doimo rozi bo'lgan kishi, ularga yoqishi uchun
usage: Stephanie only hired Tim because he's a yes man and won't challenge her authority.

meaning: to accept something that proves to be fraudulent or deceitful, to be swindled or conned
meaning_uz: soxta yoki aldov ekanligini isbotlovchi narsani qabul qilish, aldanish yoki kondirish
usage: I'm done accepting wooden nickels - capricious women who say they love me, then get bored and decide I'm not worth their time.

meaning: to come up against an immovable or insurmountable difficulty or obstacle
meaning_uz: ko'chmas yoki yechilmas qiyinchilik yoki to'siqqa qarshi chiqish uchun
usage: Our project was going well, but we hit a brick wall when our funding was suddenly cut.

meaning: a tendency to be cowardly or easily frightened
meaning_uz: qo'rqoq yoki osonlik bilan qo'rqitishga moyillik
usage: He knew what they were doing was wrong, but his yellow streak kept him from intervening.

meaning: cause someone to feel sympathy, emotion, or enthusiasm
meaning_uz: birovning hamdardlik, hissiyot yoki g'ayrat his etishiga sabab bo'lishi
usage: The issue of food safety strikes a chord with almost everyone.

meaning: uncertain, subject to change
meaning_uz: noaniq, o'zgarishiga bo'ysunadi
usage: The whole future of the project is still up in the air.

meaning: incredibly scarce or rare, extremely difficult or impossible to find
meaning_uz: nihoyatda kam yoki kam uchraydigan, topish nihoyatda qiyin yoki imkonsiz
usage: Critics always complain that good movies that the whole family can see together are rare than hen's teeth.

idiom: put all eggs in one basket
meaning: to depend for your success on a single person or plan of action
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatingizga bog'liq bo'lish uchun yagona shaxsga yoki harakat rejasiga
usage: I'm applying for several jobs because I don't really want to put all my eggs in one basket.

meaning: a very lively or energetic person
meaning_uz: juda jonli yoki baquvvat inson
usage: Greg's such a live wire that it's tough to keep up with his stories!

meaning: something that makes you feel very disappointed or upset, especially when you have been trying hard to achieve something
meaning_uz: sizni juda ranjitadigan yoki xafa qiladigan narsa, ayniqsa biror narsaga erishish uchun astoydil harakat qilganingizda
usage: He described the court's decision as a kick in the teeth to the people of the nation.

meaning: to reveal something that is very surprising or unexpected
meaning_uz: juda ajablanarli yoki kutilmagan narsani ochib berish uchun
usage: When we got a tip that the newspaper was about to drop a bombshell about our candidate, we all wondered what information they could possibly have.

meaning: trying to find some way to succeed when nothing you choose is likely to work, trying to find a reason to feel hopeful in a bad situation
meaning_uz: siz tanlagan hech narsa ishlamaslik ehtimoli bo'lganda muvaffaqiyatga erishishning qandaydir yo'lini topishga harakat qilish, yomon vaziyatda o'zingizni umidvor his qilish uchun sabab topishga harakat qilish
usage: We searched all the backup tapes, trying to find the missing files, but we knew we were grasping at straws.

meaning: to cause someone to be very busy
meaning_uz: birovning juda band bo'lishiga sabab bo'lishi
usage: There's only one secretary working for the whole accounts department and the poor woman is run off her feet.

meaning: a situation that is not well known and may be dangerous
meaning_uz: yaxshi ma'lum bo'lmagan va xavfli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat
usage: After the Wall Street crash, the American economy moved into uncharted waters.

meaning: to be very unhappy because someone has something that you want
meaning_uz: juda baxtsiz bo'lishi kerak, chunki kimdir siz xohlagan narsaga ega
usage: Chad is heading off to Spain for the week, and I'm green with envy.

meaning: a significant amount
meaning_uz: sezilarli miqdorda
usage: Please take some cake home with you - there's quite a bit left.

meaning: to be forgotten, especially of an obligation
meaning_uz: unutilishi, ayniqsa, majburiyatning
usage: I'm sorry I didn't call you back sooner, it totally slipped my mind.

meaning: to do or undertake something redundant, pointless, or futile, usually in the context of bringing something to a location where it is abundant or unnecessary
meaning_uz: ortiqcha, befoyda yoki behuda narsa qilish yoki uni amalga oshirish, odatda biror narsani ko'p yoki keraksiz joyga olib kelish sharoitida
usage: The company always caters lunch for these meetings, so I don't know why you bring in your own sandwich. You might as well bring sand to the beach!

meaning: a hilarious joke, especially one that evokes loud and prolonged laughter
meaning_uz: xushbo'y hazil, ayniqsa, baland ovozda va uzoq vaqt kulgi uyg'otadigan
usage: My uncle told me a real knee-slapper the other day! Do you want to hear it?

meaning: used to say that one is about to give someone advice or a warning
meaning_uz: biri birovga maslahat yoki ogohlantirish bermoqchi, deb aytadigan bo'lsak
usage: A word to the wise - don't use Amy's baby shower as an opportunity to announce your engagement.

meaning: if everything happens as expected
meaning_uz: agar hamma narsa kutilganidek bo'lsa
usage: All things being equal, I'll be at home on Tuesday.

meaning: a person, thing, or brand that has become widely popular or commonly known
meaning_uz: keng ommalashgan yoki keng tarqalgan ma'lum bo'lib qolgan shaxs, narsa yoki tovar
usage: Now old and forgotten, he was a household name in the 1950s.

meaning: watch for danger or threats to oneself
meaning_uz: o'ziga xavf yoki tahdidlarni kuzatib boring
usage: Bob has been a little paranoid since the robbery, and is always looking over his shoulder.

meaning: in the same statement; in or at the very next moment or opportunity; in a very short space of time
meaning_uz: ayni gapda; ichida yoki keyingi paytda yoki imkoniyatda; juda qisqa fursat ichida
usage: The boss spent nearly an hour talking about how we had to cut spending in the office, but in the next breath, he was telling his secretary to upgrade his company car.

meaning: to accept that something or someone is as it seems based only on an initial or outward appearance, without further verifying or investigating
meaning_uz: biror narsa yoki kimdir faqat boshlang'ich yoki tashqi ko'rinishga asoslangan ko'rinadiganidek, qo'shimcha tekshirmasdan yoki tekshirmasdan qabul qilish
usage: The committee took the report at face value and approved the suggested changes.

idiom: need like a hole in the head
meaning: to have absolutely no need or use for something
meaning_uz: biror narsaga mutlaqo ehtiyoj va foydalanishga ega bo'lmasligi
usage: We have enough problems with the business as it is, so we need an audit right now like we need a hole in the head.

meaning: as a result of something
meaning_uz: bir narsa oqibatida
usage: They were excluded from voting by virtue of being too young.

meaning: to uncover a lot of unsuspected problems
meaning_uz: ko'p ehtiyotsiz muammolarni ochib berishga
usage: Sadly, his reforms opened up a Pandora's box of domestic problems.

meaning: the person who someone loves most and is very proud of
meaning_uz: kimdir eng ko'p sevadigan va juda faxrlangan inson
usage: His youngest daughter was the apple of his eye.

meaning: to ask/aim for the best or the most you could hope for
meaning_uz: siz umid qilishingiz mumkin bo'lgan eng yaxshi yoki eng ko'p narsani so'rash / maqsad qilish
usage: You might as well shoot for the moon and ask for a promotion as well as a raise.

meaning: a particularly difficult and precarious situation in which several things are being attempted or must be maintained at the same time
meaning_uz: bir vaqtning o'zida bir nechta narsaga urinilayotgan yoki saqlanib qolishi kerak bo'lgan ayniqsa qiyin va xavfli vaziyat
usage: I think I need to hire an assistant, because keeping track of all these accounts and transactions on my own has become quite a juggling act!

meaning: extremely short of money
meaning_uz: nihoyatda kam pul
usage: Joe invited us out to lunch because we were both on our uppers.

meaning: to make a mistake; to forget about or neglect someone or something
meaning_uz: xatoga yo'l qo'yish; birovni yoki biror narsani unutish yoki e'tiborsiz qoldirish uchun
usage: I think she really dropped the ball when she decided to quit that promising internship.

meaning: to be dying; to be approaching or very close to death
meaning_uz: o'layotgan bo'lishi; yaqinlashayotgan yoki o'limga juda yaqin bo'lishi
usage: My grandfather fought a good fight against his stomach cancer, but I'm afraid he's knocking on heaven's door now.

meaning: talk boastfully about one's achievements
meaning_uz: birining yutuqlari bilan maqtanib gapiring
usage: I don't mean to blow my own trumpet, but this pasta sauce I made is quite delicious!

meaning: to make oneself aware of the specific terms, conditions, restrictions, limitations, etc., of an agreement, contract, or other document, which are often printed in very small type and thus easy to miss
meaning_uz: kelishuv, shartnoma yoki boshqa hujjatning aniq shartlari, shartlari, cheklovlari, cheklovlari va boshqalar haqida xabardor bo'lish uchun, ular ko'pincha juda kichik shaklda chop etiladi va shuning uchun o'tkazib yuborish oson
usage: The terms of the loan look pretty good at face value, but be sure to read the fine print or you could find yourself in a heap of trouble down the line.

meaning: to meet or be defeated by one's final and insurmountable challenge
meaning_uz: birovning final va yechilmas da'vosi bilan to'qnash kelish yoki mag'lub bo'lish
usage: The boss is being very hard on Bill. It seems that Bill has finally met his Waterloo.

idiom: take someone or something for granted
meaning: to underestimate or undervalue someone or something, to not properly recognize or appreciate someone or something
meaning_uz: birovni yoki biror narsani kamsitish yoki qadrsizlash, birovni yoki biror narsani to'g'ri tan olmaslik yoki qadrlamaslik
usage: The boss takes us for granted, but if we weren't here, this whole company would collapse.

meaning: in a state of anxious, excited, or nervous anticipation
meaning_uz: tashvishli, hayajonlangan yoki asabiy intizorlik holatida
usage: With the game tied, fans on both sides were on tenterhooks for the last quarter.

meaning: a person who is an expert at a particular activity
meaning_uz: muayyan faoliyat bo'yicha mutaxassis bo'lgan shaxs
usage: Liam is a dab hand at golf.

meaning: to be obligated, obliged, or required to
meaning_uz: majburiyatini, majburiyatini yoki talab qilinishini
usage: I have got to get this essay finished before Monday!

idiom: have your cake and eat it too
meaning: to have or do two good things at the same time that are impossible to have or do at the same time
meaning_uz: ega bo'lish yoki bir vaqtning o'zida amalga oshirish imkoni bo'lmagan ikkita yaxshi narsaga ega bo'lish yoki
usage: If you want a senior consultant to work here, you must pay the salary she demands. You cannot have your cake and eat it too.

meaning: to separate or remove people from a larger group
meaning_uz: odamlarni kattaroq guruhdan ajratish yoki olib tashlash uchun
usage: Universities have long used standardized test results as a means of culling the herd of applicants they receive each year.

meaning: to be waiting eagerly to hear about something
meaning_uz: biror narsa haqida eshitishga intizorlik bilan kutishga
usage: I'm all ears, tell us what they had to say.

meaning: to stop focusing on something that happened in the past
meaning_uz: o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan voqeaga e'tiborni to'xtatish
usage: I said I was sorry - can't we let bygones be bygones?

meaning: a serious error of judgement
meaning_uz: hukmning jiddiy xatosi
usage: He committed the cardinal sin of criticizing his teammates.

meaning: to misdirect one away from their pursuit, to steer one's investigation or suspicions in the wrong direction
meaning_uz: ta'qibidan noto'g'ri yo'lga qo'yish, tergov yoki shubhalarni noto'g'ri yo'lga yo'naltirish
usage: That outlier data threw me off the scent for a while, but I think my research is back on track now.

meaning: an important or a powerful person in a group or family
meaning_uz: guruh yoki oilada muhim yoki qudratli shaxs
usage: Apparently her father is a big cheese in one of the major banks.

meaning: to be unwilling to talk openly or share details about someone or something
meaning_uz: ochiq gapirishni istamaslik yoki biror kishi yoki biror narsa haqida tafsilotlarni baham ko'rish
usage: I still don't know anything about Maria's new boyfriend because she's so tight-lipped about him.

meaning: to no longer be in danger or difficulty
meaning_uz: endi xavf va qiyinchilikda bo'lmasligi
usage: The project has been given funding for another year, but it's not out of the woods yet.

meaning: if you do something against the clock, you do it as fast as possible and try to finish it before a certain time
meaning_uz: soatga qarshi biror ish qilsangiz, imkon qadar tez bajarib, uni ma'lum vaqtdan oldin tugatishga harakat
usage: In a race against the clock, they rushed the accident victim to the hospital.

meaning: to leave a situation alone so as to avoid worsening it
meaning_uz: yomonlashmaslik uchun vaziyatni yolg'iz qoldirishga
usage: Oh, don't mention that fight they had months ago - let sleeping dogs lie!

meaning: to change your opinion completely, especially because you know it will bring you an advantage
meaning_uz: fikringizni butunlay o'zgartirish uchun, ayniqsa, bu sizga ustunlik keltirishini bilganingiz uchun
usage: He was against the idea to start with, but he soon changed his tune when he realized how much money he'd get.

meaning: an angry attitude from someone who feels unfairly treated
meaning_uz: nohaq munosabatda bo'lganini his qilgan odamning g'azablangan munosabati
usage: She's not going to make any friends if she walks around with a chip on her shoulder like that.

meaning: commit oneself to a course of action about which one is nervous
meaning_uz: qaysi biri asabiy ekanligi to'g'risida harakat yo'nalishiga o'zini bag'ishlash
usage: She wondered whether to enter for the race, and finally decided to take the plunge.

meaning: used for wishing someone good luck, especially before a performance
meaning_uz: birovga omad tilash uchun ishlatiladi, ayniqsa ijrodan oldin
usage: You all look great in your costumes! Break a leg!

meaning: satisfying only one's immediate needs because of lack of money for future plans and investments
meaning_uz: kelajakdagi rejalar va investitsiyalar uchun pul etishmasligi tufayli faqat darhol ehtiyojlarni qondirish
usage: They were flat broke and living hand to mouth.

meaning: a spontaneous, automatic reaction to something
meaning_uz: biror narsaga o'z-o'zidan, somatik reaksiya
usage: Her rude remark was probably a knee jerk reaction to your comments, which were not very flattering either.

meaning: to show your opinion by leaving an organization or by no longer supporting, using, or buying something
meaning_uz: tashkilotdan chiqib yoki endi biror narsani qo'llab-quvvatlamaslik, ishlatish yoki sotib olish orqali o'z fikringizni ko'rsatish
usage: When the price of skiing doubled, tourists voted with their feet and just stopped going.

meaning: in thorough and exact detail
meaning_uz: chuqur va aniq tafsilotlarda
usage: She can give chapter and verse on current legislation.

meaning: one should help family and close friends before helping others
meaning_uz: boshqalarga yordam berishdan oldin oila a'zolari va yaqin do'stlariga yordam berish kerak
usage: She seems to have forgotten that charity begins at home - she has no problem volunteering at the church but rarely visits her own mother.

meaning: a person requires the company and support of others and society as a whole in order to thrive
meaning_uz: inson gullab-yashnashi uchun o'zgalar va butun jamiyatning kompaniyasi va qo'llab-quvvatlashini talab qiladi
usage: Look, I know you're very proud man, but you need to let other people help you if you're in trouble. No man is an island, Dan.

meaning: to be very healthy and strong
meaning_uz: juda sog'lom va kuchli bo'lishi
usage: My grandmother's 89, but she's as fit as a fiddle.

meaning: to admit that you were wrong
meaning_uz: noto'g'ri ekanligingizni tan olish uchun
usage: After boasting that his company could outperform the industry's best, he's been forced to eat humble pie.

meaning: to clash with another person on a particular issue
meaning_uz: muayyan masalada boshqa shaxs bilan to'qnashishga
usage: Monica and I are always bumping heads with each other about how to go about these reports because she wants to start writing, while I think we should research first.

meaning: to achieve much success, to be very useful or helpful
meaning_uz: ko'p muvaffaqiyatlarga erishish, juda foydali yoki yordamchi bo'lish
usage: You'll go a long way if you learn to never quit.

meaning: to be taught how to do or perform a job, task, or activity; to have explained or demonstrated how something is done
meaning_uz: ish, vazifa yoki faoliyatni bajarish yoki bajarishga o'rgatilishi; biror ish qanday amalga oshirilishini tushuntirib yoki namoyish etgan bo'lishi
usage: I had never worked on a ranch before, but I was shown the ropes by a friend of mine.

meaning: make a wrong or inappropriate choice
meaning_uz: noto'g'ri yoki noto'g'ri tanlov qilish
usage: Only after investing all their money in the company did they realized that they had backed the wrong horse.

meaning: following closely after
meaning_uz: so'ng yaqindan ergashib
usage: He headed off with Sammy at his heels.

meaning: in the past, some time ago
meaning_uz: ilgari, bir qancha vaqt oldin
usage: Back in the day, he'd had one of the greatest minds I'd ever come across.

meaning: being planned, worked on, or produced
meaning_uz: rejalashtirilayotgan, ustida ishlayotgan yoki ishlab chiqarilayotgan
usage: A major consolidation of companies was in the works.

meaning: examining something carefully to not miss out any details
meaning_uz: hech qanday tafsilotni o'tkazib yubormaslik uchun biror narsani diqqat bilan tekshirish
usage: The boss examined my report with a fine tooth comb before submitting it to the senior management.

meaning: to take action to become well-organized, prepared, or in a better state of life
meaning_uz: yaxshi tashkil etilgan, tayyor bo'lish yoki yaxlit hayotiy ahvolda bo'lish uchun choralar ko'rish
usage: I had no direction after college and drifted along for several years, until I got my act together in my thirties with a steady job and good relationship.

meaning: experience hardship, especially financial
meaning_uz: qiyinchiliklarni boshdan kechirish, ayniqsa, moliyaviy
usage: Staff were beginning to feel the pinch as the dispute entered its third week.

meaning: to lose a significant amount of one's money, often all of it
meaning_uz: birining sezilarli miqdorda pulini yo'qotishga, ko'pincha barchasini
usage: This is my last chance - I'll lose my shirt if this business venture fails.

meaning: to glare at someone very angrily, spitefully, or disdainfully
meaning_uz: birovga juda g'azab bilan, jirkanch yoki nafrat bilan qarash
usage: I noticed the bride looking daggers at the best man as he started making vulgar jokes during his speech.

meaning: a small, exclusive, and intimate group of like-minded people sharing a common goal, pursuit, or purpose
meaning_uz: umumiy maqsad, intilish yoki maqsadni baham ko'radigan kichik, eksklyuziv va yaqin fikrli guruh
usage: After nearly 20 years working for the company, I was finally brought into the board of directors' inner circle.

meaning: to annoy or frustrate one to the point of exasperation
meaning_uz: asabiylashish yoki g'azablanish nuqtasiga bir
usage: A week on vacation with my relatives is enough to drive me up the wall.

meaning: do something innovative and beneficial
meaning_uz: zamonaviy va manfaatli ish qilish
usage: This case breaks new ground of great constitutional importance.

idiom: the long arm of the law
meaning: the broad, far-reaching power or influence of the police or legal system
meaning_uz: politsiya yoki huquq tizimining keng, keng qamrovli qudrati yoki ta'siri
usage: He may have eluded us for now, but he won't escape the long arm of the law for long.

meaning: to force one to do something instantaneously, often causing them unease or embarrassment
meaning_uz: bir narsani bir zumda bajarishga majbur qilish, ko'pincha ularni bezovta qilish yoki uyalishga olib
usage: When the boss put me on the spot in the meeting today, I wasn't prepared to answer his question and ended up babbling like a fool.

meaning: almost but not quite successful
meaning_uz: deyarli, ammo juda muvaffaqiyatli emas
usage: They didn't catch him in the car - close but no cigar.

meaning: alert to new ideas, methods, and trends
meaning_uz: yangi g'oyalar, usullar va tendensiyalardan ogoh
usage: Maintaining contact with customers keeps me on the ball.

meaning: very attractive to look at, someone or something that one is excited or overjoyed to see
meaning_uz: qarash juda jozibali, kimdir yoki ko'rib hayajonlangan yoki haddan tashqari xursand bo'lgan narsa
usage: The sunset over the Strait of Malacca is a sight for sore eyes.

meaning: to have or be in control, especially of a group, project, or situation
meaning_uz: ega bo'lishi yoki boshqaruvda bo'lishi, ayniqsa, guruh, loyiha yoki vaziyatning
usage: Though my grandfather was the breadwinner, it was my grandmother who truly held the reins in their house.

meaning: misunderstanding or having different aims from one another
meaning_uz: noto'g'ri tushunish yoki bir-biridan farqli maqsadlarga ega bo'lish
usage: We had been talking at cross purposes.

meaning: too much curiosity can lead to dangerous situations
meaning_uz: juda ko'p qiziquvchanlik xavfli vaziyatlarga olib kelishi mumkin
usage: When he started asking too many questions of his neighbours about their whereabouts during the weekend, they warned him that curiosity killed the cat.

meaning: likely to happen or exist soon
meaning_uz: ehtimol bo'lishi yoki yaqin orada mavjud bo'lishi mumkin
usage: There is no new drug on the horizon that will make this disease easier to treat.

meaning: plans or hopes that have very little chances of happening
meaning_uz: sodir bo'lish ehtimoli juda kam bo'lgan rejalar yoki umidlar
usage: She keeps talking about her ambitious plans, but it's all castles in the air.

meaning: to try very hard to please someone in authority, usually in order to get an advantage
meaning_uz: hokimiyatda birovni rozi qilish uchun juda ko'p harakat qilish, odatda, ustunlikka erishish maqsadida
usage: It's no wonder you're the teacher's favorite from the way you lick her boots!

meaning: actions or communications that need more than one person
meaning_uz: birdan ortiq shaxsga zarur bo'lgan amallar yoki aloqa
usage: We really need to come to a compromise here, after all it takes two to tango.

meaning: active and healthy
meaning_uz: faol va sog'lom
usage: I thought for sure that old dog wouldn't survive the winter, but he's still alive and kicking!

meaning: the act of speaking to someone severely or angrily because of something they have done or failed to do
meaning_uz: qilgan yoki qilmagan ishi tufayli birov bilan qattiq yoki g'azab bilan gaplashish amali
usage: I got a rap on the knuckles for not finishing my essay on time.

idiom: you scratch my back and I'll scratch yours
meaning: used to tell someone that if they help you, you will help them
meaning_uz: birovga, agar ular sizga yordam berishsa, siz ularga yordam berasiz, deb
usage: I do have some information you might be interested in, but what can you offer me in return? You scratch my back and I'll scratch yours.

meaning: very modern, latest and with all the newest features
meaning_uz: juda zamonaviy, eng so'nggi va barcha yangi xususiyatlarga ega
usage: The new phone is an epitome of cutting-edge design/technology.

meaning: other people are free to like different things or have different preferences
meaning_uz: boshqa odamlar turli narsalarni yoqtirishlari yoki turli xil afzalliklarga ega bo'lishlari mumkin
usage: I don't care for football, but to each his own.

meaning: to be conceited, arrogant, or self-aggrandizing
meaning_uz: mag'rur, mutaassib yoki o'z-o'zini maqtanchoq bo'lishi
usage: Janice has had a bit of a big head ever since she got that promotion.

meaning: a fact, idea, or subject that takes people's attention away from the central point being considered
meaning_uz: ko'rib chiqilayotgan markaziy nuqtadan odamlarning e'tiborini tortadigan fakt, g'oya yoki mavhum
usage: The police investigated many clues, but they were all red herrings.

meaning: to do something that has never been done before
meaning_uz: ilgari hech qachon qilinmagan ishni bajarishga
usage: Le Corbusier blazed a trail in architecture.

meaning: a portion of something, typically implied to be the most important or significant part, often used in the negative
meaning_uz: narsaning bir qismi, odatda, eng muhim yoki muhim qismi bo'lishi kerak, ko'pincha salbiy ishlatilgan
usage: Yes, the company is losing money, but that's only the half of it. If we don't show some improved sales soon, the bank will cut our credit line, too!

meaning: make an overall assessment of a particular situation, typically before making a decision
meaning_uz: muayyan vaziyatga umumiy baho berish, odatda qaror qabul qilishdan oldin
usage: He needed a period of peace and quiet in order to take stock of his life.

meaning: characterized by being very quick and easy to obtain, access, and use
meaning_uz: olish, murojaat qilish va foydalanish juda tez va oson bo'lishi bilan xarakterlanadi
usage: Increasingly busy lifestyles have led to an explosion in the popularity of grab and go meals and snacks.

meaning: the state of something that exists and thrives outside and beyond the control of the point of origin
meaning_uz: mavjud bo'lgan va paydo bo'lish nuqtasini boshqarishdan tashqarida va undan tashqarida gullab-yashnagan narsaning holati
usage: The accusations in the political race began to take on a life of their own, growing meaner and more elaborate every day.

meaning: to scold someone severely
meaning_uz: birovni qattiq tanbeh berish uchun
usage: She was really mad. She laid him out in lavender and really put him in his place.

meaning: the ability to make money out of anything one undertakes; to have the ability to produce successful results
meaning_uz: har qanday narsadan pul topish qobiliyati; muvaffaqiyatli natijalar berish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lishi
usage: The new sales rep seemed to have the Midas touch, turning every lead she found into a sale.

meaning: a punishment or act of justice that is or appears to be much more severe than the offence warrants
meaning_uz: jinoyat farmonlaridan ancha og'ir bo'lgan yoki ko'rinadigan jazo yoki adolat amali
usage: Twenty years in jail for stealing a car? That sounds like Jersey justice to me.

meaning: in a very bad situation that is difficult to fix
meaning_uz: tuzatish qiyin bo'lgan juda yomon vaziyatda
usage: These kids are in dire straits, and the schools are doing nothing to help them!

meaning: full of boastful, arrogant, or shallow talk, usually by a male, who then cannot deliver on his claims
meaning_uz: maqtanchoq, kibrli yoki tubsiz gap-so'zlarga to'la, odatda erkak kishi tomonidan, so'ngra o'z da'volarini bajara olmaydigan
usage: He talks a big game, but when it actually comes to asking out a woman, he's all mouth and no trousers.

idiom: be hounded by someone or something
meaning: to be pursued, chased, badgered, or pestered, especially persistently or relentlessly
meaning_uz: ta'qib qilinishi, quvib o'tilishi, badallanishi yoki pesterlanishi, ayniqsa, davomli yoki tinimsiz
usage: The suspect was hounded by police for days, being pursued as far as the border before he was finally arrested.

meaning: to let someone do what they want without helping/controlling them
meaning_uz: kimgadir yordam bermasdan/nazorat qilmasdan o'zi xohlagan ishni qilishiga yo'l qo'yish
usage: There are four hours of lessons each morning, and in the afternoon students are left to their own devices.

meaning: to make eye contact with one, typically in a way that is confident or without shame
meaning_uz: biri bilan ko'z bilan aloqa qilishni, odatda, ishonchli yoki uyatsiz
usage: She couldn't meet my eye because she knew how angry I was with her.

meaning: a test used to determine someone's true intentions or beliefs
meaning_uz: birovning haqiqiy niyati yoki e'tiqodini aniqlashda qo'llaniladigan sinov
usage: I used his reaction to my favorite movie as a litmus test to determine if he was worth dating.

meaning: start something too soon or early, especially without thinking
meaning_uz: biror ishni juda tez yoki erta boshlash, ayniqsa, o'ylamasdan
usage: The media jumped the gun and gave out their verdict of the scandal even before the investigation was complete.

meaning: when you want something to happen, paying attention to it will make the wait feel much longer
meaning_uz: biror narsa sodir bo'lishini xohlasangiz, unga e'tibor berish kutishni ancha uzoq his qiladi
usage: Would you stop refreshing the page? The results will be posted soon enough, and a watched pot never boils!

meaning: of a person, group, or object, to be on a certain path to conflict, collision, destruction, or ruin with someone or something else
meaning_uz: shaxsning, guruh yoki ob'ektning, birov yoki boshqa narsa bilan nizo, to'qnashuv, halokat yoki vayronagarchilikning ma'lum bir yo'lida bo'lishi
usage: The radical coalition is set to be on a collision course with the majority government this year.

meaning: starting today and continuing into the future
meaning_uz: bugundan boshlab va kelajakka davom
usage: I'm sorry, I'll take my responsibilities more seriously from now on.

meaning: a general principle that comes through experience and not any scientific means
meaning_uz: tajriba orqali kelib chiqadigan va hech qanday ilmiy vosita bo'lmagan umumiy prinsip
usage: A good rule of thumb is to add the ingredients when the water starts to boil.

meaning: in exactly the same or, when translated, exactly equivalent words
meaning_uz: aniq bir xil yoki, tarjima qilinganda, aniq ekvivalent so'zlarda
usage: Benjamin copied the verse down, word for word.

meaning: a strong and often immobilizing type of embrace
meaning_uz: quchoqlashning kuchli va tez-tez immobilizatsiya qiluvchi turi
usage: Jane was so excited to see her dad for the first time since his military deployment, she ran to him, wrapped her arms around him, and gave him a long bear hug.

meaning: to report or relay information to someone else in a way that makes their interpretation or understanding of it more palatable, acceptable, or favorable
meaning_uz: axborotni boshqa birovga o'z talqini yoki tushunchasini yanada ma'qul, ma'qul yoki favqulodda qilish yo'li bilan xabar berish yoki uzatish
usage: Though the crime rate was still higher than anywhere else in the country, the police commissioner tried to put a positive spin on the report by applauding that the city had a 10% crime reduction from the previous year.

meaning: to go to sleep
meaning_uz: uyquga ketish uchun
usage: You mind the cattle, Herb. I'm gonna pound my ear for an hour or so.

meaning: a complicated organization or plan that is very weak and can easily be destroyed or easily go wrong
meaning_uz: juda zaif bo'lgan va osongina yo'q qilinishi yoki osongina noto'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan murakkab tashkilot yoki reja
usage: His plan went down like a house of cards when the police intervened.

meaning: on earth, in existence
meaning_uz: yer yuzida, mavjud bo'lganda
usage: I looked everywhere under the sun for you! Where have you been?

meaning: a quality that you cannot describe that makes someone very special
meaning_uz: birovni juda o'zgacha qiladigan ta'riflay olmaydigan sifat
usage: There are a lot of really talented singers in this contest, but I think Molly is the only one with the X factor.

meaning: used to convey that one's actions have failed or not led to the desired outcome
meaning_uz: o'z xatti-harakatlari muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragan yoki istalgan natijaga olib kelmaganligini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi
usage: I know you worked really hard on this project, but it looks like your cake is dough, and you won't be winning the contest.

meaning: a person, thing, situation, or problem that is particularly difficult to understand, solve, or deal with
meaning_uz: tushunish, hal etish yoki hal etish ayniqsa qiyin bo'lgan shaxs, narsa, holat yoki muammo
usage: I've been dating Jenny for over a year, and I still think she's a tough nut to crack!

meaning: slightly unwell or in low spirits
meaning_uz: biroz shamollash yoki past ruhda
usage: She was sufficiently under the weather to have to pull out of the championship.

meaning: to have a special celebration for someone who has been away for a long time
meaning_uz: uzoq vaqtdan beri uzoqda bo'lgan odam uchun maxsus bayram o'tkazish
usage: My daughter is coming home from college for the summer, so we're going to kill the fatted calf and have a huge barbecue.

idiom: nourish a viper in one's bosom
meaning: to befriend, look after, or take care of someone who proves to be traitorous, untrustworthy, deceitful, or ungrateful
meaning_uz: xoin, ishonchsiz, makkor yoki noshukr ekanligini isbotlaydigan odam bilan do'stlashish, g'amxo'rlik qilish yoki g'amxo'rlik qilish
usage: I thought our love was not only mutual but indestructible, and yet, I have nourished a viper in my bosom all these years, my darling husband has cast me out and run off with a younger woman.

meaning: to say that someone means one thing when the person really meant something else
meaning_uz: odam haqiqatan ham boshqa narsani anglatganda bir narsani anglatadi, deb aytish
usage: I never said you should leave - don't put words in my mouth.

meaning: when the first light of dawn appears
meaning_uz: Tongning birinchi chirog'i paydo bo'lganda
usage: We are leaving tomorrow at first light, so I suggest you guys go to bed early tonight.

meaning: (noun) an unattainable or fanciful hope or scheme
meaning_uz: (noun) amalga oshirib bo'lmaydigan yoki xayoliy umid yoki sxema
usage: His plans are not realistic - they'll never be more than a pipe dream.

meaning: very different from something else
meaning_uz: boshqa narsadan juda farq qiladi
usage: This new school is worlds away from the old one I taught at. For one, the kids actually listen!

idiom: off the top of one's head
meaning: from the knowledge you have in your memory
meaning_uz: xotirangizda bor bilimingizdan
usage: I know of two people who are coming off the top of my head, but I'm pretty sure more said they'd be here.

meaning: to remain calm, steady, and resolute, especially in the face of danger or adversity
meaning_uz: sokin, barqaror va qat'iyatli bo'lib qolish, ayniqsa xavf yoki qiyinchiliklar qarshisida
usage: I know learning to drive can be daunting, but if you can hold your nerve out on the road, you'll do just fine.

meaning: draw the focus of attention to oneself at the expense of others
meaning_uz: e'tiborni o'zgalar evaziga o'ziga qaratish
usage: The experimental car certainly stole the limelight at the motor show.

meaning: to become more relaxed and less serious
meaning_uz: yanada osoyishta va kamroq jiddiy bo'lish uchun
usage: Oh, lighten up! I was only joking!

idiom: make a clean breast of it
meaning: to tell the truth about something
meaning_uz: biror narsa to'g'risida haqiqatni aytishga
usage: Julia finally made a clean breast of it and admitted that she had stolen the money.

meaning: to take offense,to get worked up, aggravated, or annoyed
meaning_uz: g'azabga duchor bo'lish, ish ko'rishga, og'irlashishiga yoki asabiylashishiga
usage: They stopped inviting him to the gatherings, and he really got bent out of shape about it.

meaning: to gain complete control, dominance, or mastery over somebody, to make someone do whatever one wishes
meaning_uz: biror inson ustidan to'liq nazorat, hukmronlik yoki ustuvorlikka erishish, birovni xohlagan ishini qilish uchun
usage: The spoiled little brat has completely wound his parents around his little finger.

meaning: a very close or intimate friend
meaning_uz: juda yaqin yoki yaqin do'st
usage: We were not exactly bosom buddies but we always got on.

meaning: someone who is viewed as emotionally unstable and unable to function in normal situations or a country, business, or other entity that is facing economic strife
meaning_uz: hissiy jihatdan beqaror va normal vaziyatlarda ishlay olmaydigan yoki iqtisodiy nizolarga duch kelayotgan mamlakat, biznes yoki boshqa sub'ekt deb qaraladigan odam
usage: If the unemployment rate doesn't decrease soon, the country is going to become a financial basket case.

meaning: to spend an exorbitant or unrestrained amount of time shopping and buying things
meaning_uz: savdo qilish va narsalarni sotib olish uchun haddan tashqari yoki cheklanmagan miqdorda sarflashga
usage: With a huge range of sales and savings across the country, retailers are hoping that consumers will shop till they drop this weekend.

meaning: close enough to something to hear it
meaning_uz: eshitish uchun biror narsaga yetarlicha yaqin
usage: As soon as I got within earshot of the music, I decided that I really didn't belong there.

meaning: in a state of failure or ruination, wasted
meaning_uz: nosozlik yoki xaroba holatida, isrof bo'lgan
usage: If the factory closes, that will be a million dollars' worth of investment down the drain.

meaning: the largest part of something
meaning_uz: narsaning eng katta qismi
usage: A lion's share of the museum's budget goes on special exhibitions.

meaning: an expression used after one has learned something from personal experience
meaning_uz: shaxsiy tajribadan biror narsani o'rganganidan so'ng ishlatiladigan ifoda
usage: Well, I'll never try to ride my bike in the snow again - live and learn!

idiom: take the wind out of sails
meaning: to make someone feel less confident or less determined to do something
meaning_uz: birovning o'zini kamroq ishonchli yoki biror ish qilishga qat'iy qaror qilishiga
usage: I was all ready to tell him that the relationship was over when he greeted me with a big bunch of flowers - that took the wind out of my sails.

meaning: to perform an action that is very successful
meaning_uz: juda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lgan amalni bajarish uchun
usage: It was an unexpected interview question, but I really feel like a hit a home run with it.

meaning: in the early, nascent period of development or implementation
meaning_uz: rivojlanish yoki amalga oshirishning dastlabki, yangi paydo bo'lgan davrida
usage: Despite social media's ubiquity in modern life, research on its effects on human behavior is still in its infancy.

meaning: to attempt to do something, to take a turn trying to do something
meaning_uz: biror ish qilishga urinish, biror ishni bajarishga harakat qilib navbat
usage: Well, I haven't fixed a motor in nearly 10 years, but I'll certainly have a crack at it.

meaning: to reach a point of intensity at which action must be taken
meaning_uz: harakat qilinishi lozim bo'lgan intensivlik nuqtasiga yetishi
usage: Tensions in our community came to a head following the mayor's insensitive comments.

meaning: to make a significant improvement or dramatic advancement
meaning_uz: sezilarli darajada yaxshilanishi yoki sezilarli darajada ilgarilab borishini
usage: The election of a female Prime Minister is a quantum leap forward for equality in humanity.

idiom: Let the cat out of the bag
meaning: to allow a secret to be known, usually without intending to
meaning_uz: sirning ma'lum bo'lishi uchun yo'l qo'yish, odatda niyat qilmasdan
usage: Joey was trying to keep the party a secret, but Rachel went and let the cat out of the bag.

meaning: an act of believing something that is not easily believed
meaning_uz: oson ishonib bo'lmaydigan narsaga ishonish amali
usage: It took a big leap of faith to decide to quit my job and try something new.

meaning: unfailingly loyal
meaning_uz: begʻarib sodiq
usage: Don't worry, the enemy will not be able to sway Richard - he is true to his colors.

idiom: learn to walk before you can run
meaning: one must understand or become adept at the basic skills, techniques, or details of something before moving on to that which requires greater skill or experience
meaning_uz: ko'proq mahorat yoki tajriba talab qiladigan narsaga o'tishdan oldin biror narsaning asosiy ko'nikmalari, usullari yoki tafsilotlarini tushunish yoki mohir bo'lish kerak
usage: While the results of the drug trial are encouraging, there are still a huge number of tests we have to run - you've got to walk before you can run.

meaning: a purpose or plan behind something that is seemingly crazy
meaning_uz: jinni ko'rinadigan narsaning orqasida maqsad yoki reja
usage: The way the houses were built seemed strange, but when we heard of the natural calamities affecting the region, we realized there was method to the madness.

meaning: immediately, at once, without delay
meaning_uz: darhol, birdaniga, kechiktirmasdan
usage: Right away, I could tell that the plan had no chance of success.

idiom: beyond a shadow of a doubt
meaning: with certainty, for sure
meaning_uz: ishonch bilan, albatta
usage: There isn't a shadow of doubt in my mind about the safety of the system.

idiom: a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush
meaning: it is better to hold onto something one has than to risk losing it by trying to get something better
meaning_uz: biror narsani ushlab turish yaxshiroq narsani olishga harakat qilib, uni yo'qotish xavfini tug'dirishdan ko'ra yaxshiroqdir
usage: If I were you, I'd accept the job. It might not be the best job for you, but a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.

meaning: with sincere intentions
meaning_uz: samimiy niyatlar bilan
usage: If the two sides can't sit down and negotiate in earnest, they're never going to come to an agreement.

meaning: a person who has done something bad that brings embarrassment or shame to his or her family
meaning_uz: oilasiga uyaladigan yoki uyat keltiradigan yomon ish qilgan shaxs
usage: My uncle, a drunkard, was the black sheep of the family and we were never encouraged to talk about him.

meaning: to act as if you have a lot of power or authority, be unpleasantly self-assertive
meaning_uz: ko'p kuch yoki vakolatga ega bo'lgandek harakat qilish, yoqimsiz o'z-o'zini
usage: The district manager came to our office and tried to throw his weight around, but no one paid any attention to him.

meaning: to avoid attracting attention to yourself
meaning_uz: e'tiborni o'ziga jalb qilmaslik uchun
usage: He's been in a little trouble recently so he's trying to keep a low profile.

meaning: to settle one's financial accounts with someone; to get even with someone; to straighten out a misunderstanding with someone
meaning_uz: birovning moliyaviy hisob-kitoblarini birov bilan hal qilish; hatto birov bilan ham olishish; birov bilan tushunmovchilikni to'g'rilashga
usage: Oh, I'll use my fists to square accounts with him after school!

meaning: to allow a situation to become calm or normal again after something exciting or unusual has happened
meaning_uz: hayajonli yoki g'ayrioddiy narsa sodir bo'lganidan so'ng vaziyatning yana sokin yoki normal bo'lishiga yo'l qo'yish
usage: Let's just let the dust settle before we decide what to do.

meaning: an action or accomplishment that is easily done
meaning_uz: osonlik bilan amalga oshiriladigan amal yoki yutuq
usage: Finishing that project with all his experience should be a slam dunk for George.

meaning: a period of inactivity or tranquility before something chaotic begins
meaning_uz: xaotik narsa boshlanishidan oldin induktivlik yoki osoyishtalik davri
usage: Oh, this is the calm before the storm - the dinner rush will turn this place into a mad house.

idiom: kick the can down the road
meaning: put off confronting a difficult issue or making an important decision, typically on a continuing basis
meaning_uz: qiyin masalaga duch kelishni yoki muhim qaror qabul qilishni to'xtatib qo'ying, odatda, davom etayotgan asosda
usage: I appreciate that he doesn't want to raise taxes, but sooner or later you have to stop kicking the can down the road.

meaning: a practice session or test designed to identify and correct possible problems
meaning_uz: mumkin bo'lgan muammolarni aniqlash va tuzatish uchun mo'ljallangan amaliyot seansi yoki test
usage: The theater group did a dry run of the play to iron out any technical problems before opening night.

meaning: criticize or scold someone severely
meaning_uz: tanqid qilish yoki birovni qattiq tanbeh berish
usage: The manager raked him over the coals for being late again.

meaning: to decide how to deal with a situation as it develops, rather than acting according to plans made earlier
meaning_uz: oldinroq tuzilgan rejalarga muvofiq harakat qilishdan ko'ra, yuzaga kelgan vaziyat bilan qanday hal qilish to'g'risida qaror qabul qilish
usage: We can't make a decision yet. Let's just play it by ear.

meaning: to access some large, abundant, or powerful resource
meaning_uz: ba'zi katta, mo'l yoki kuchli resursga murojaat qilish uchun
usage: The new film taps into the nostalgia of fans who grew up with the franchise when they were kids.

meaning: a situation in which something bad, unpleasant, or dangerous almost happens, but you manage to avoid it
meaning_uz: yomon, yoqimsiz yoki xavfli narsa deyarli sodir bo'ladigan vaziyat, lekin siz undan qochishga muvaffaq bo'lasiz
usage: It was a close call for residents when a tornado swept through just west of the town.

meaning: to be very popular at a particular time
meaning_uz: muayyan vaqtda juda mashhur bo'lishi
usage: Long hair for men was all the rage in the 70s.

meaning: the early hours of the morning, between twelve o'clock at night and the time when the sun rises
meaning_uz: erta tongda, kechasi soat o'n ikki bilan quyosh chiqqan vaqt oralig'ida
usage: He was up until the wee hours trying to finish his work.

idiom: can't see the forest for the trees
meaning: cannot see, understand, or focus on a situation in its entirety due to being preoccupied with minor details
meaning_uz: kichik tafsilotlar bilan mashg'ul bo'lish tufayli vaziyatni butunlay ko'ra olmaydi, tushuna olmaydi yoki e'tibor bera olmaydi
usage: The way he's obsessing over one doorknob when we're renovating the entire house makes me think that he can't see the forest for the trees.

meaning: make money for oneself in an opportunistic or selfish way
meaning_uz: opportunistik yoki xudbin tarzda o'ziga pul ishlab
usage: He may have decided to feather his nest by blackmail.

meaning: delivered or given to one, without having put forth much or any effort
meaning_uz: Birlariga etkazilgan yoki ko'p harakat qilmasdan berilgan
usage: Of course the CEO's daughter got the job without having to interview - she gets everything on a silver platter.

meaning: to be permanent or firmly established; to be a normal part of everyday life, especially after once being considered abnormal or unusual
meaning_uz: doimiy yoki mustahkam o'rnatilgan bo'lishi; kundalik hayotning normal qismi bo'lishi, ayniqsa bir marta g'ayritabiiy yoki g'ayritabiiy hisoblanganidan so'ng
usage: It seems social distancing is here to stay, so we'd better get used to it.

meaning: a person whose behaviour seems strange or unusual
meaning_uz: xatti-harakati g'alati yoki g'ayrioddiy ko'rinadigan inson
usage: Everyone could tell he was a queer fish as soon as he walked into the party with his mismatched clothing.

meaning: to tell someone your secret feelings and worries
meaning_uz: yashirin his-tuyg'ularingiz va xavotirlaringizni birovga aytish uchun
usage: She finally broke down and poured her heart out to him.

idiom: in the wink of an eye
meaning: immediately or extremely quickly; at once
meaning_uz: darhol yoki juda tez; birdaniga
usage: Just call us on this number if you have any problems, and we'll be back in the wink of an eye.

meaning: to regard oneself as superior to others and thus act in a haughty or snobbish manner
meaning_uz: o'zini boshqalardan ustun deb hisoblash va shu tariqa kibr yoki snobbish tarzda harakat qilish
usage: Once Jane was promoted to management, she looked down her nose at the people who used to be her colleagues.

meaning: to stop an argument and become friends again
meaning_uz: tortishuvni to'xtatish va yana do'st bo'lish uchun
usage: Susan and Mike agreed that it was time to bury the hatchet. They apologized and decided to be friends again.

meaning: to fail to get an answer or a result
meaning_uz: javob yoki natijani ololmaydigan
usage: He asked me for my phone number and I drew a blank - I just couldn't remember it.

meaning: to have a chance to begin something anew
meaning_uz: biror narsani yangidan boshlash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lish
usage: I'm excited to make a fresh start at my new job.

meaning: a person who makes a substantive yet unrecognized contribution
meaning_uz: tub, ammo tan olinmagan hissa qo'shgan shaxs
usage: They were the unsung heroes of the American Revolution.

meaning: to not be or not appear to be true, verifiable, or able to be supported by facts
meaning_uz: bo'lmasligi yoki ko'rinmasligi haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydi, tekshiriladi yoki faktlar bilan qo'llab-quvvatlana olishi
usage: That old claim has been debunked so many time that it just does not hold water any more.

meaning: used in expressions to mean completely full
meaning_uz: ifodalarda butunlay to'la ma'noni anglatish uchun ishlatiladi
usage: By the time the fourth course was served, I was stuffed to the gills.

meaning: be ecstatically happy
meaning_uz: hayajon bilan baxtli bo'ling
usage: I'm not exactly jumping for joy at the prospect.

idiom: at the drop of a hat
meaning: without any hesitation, instantly
meaning_uz: hech qanday shoshmasdan, darhol
usage: If you need help, just call on Mike. He can come at the drop of a hat.

meaning: to enjoy a life of money and comfort
