meaning_uz: pul va rohat-farog'at hayotidan bahramand bo'lish uchun
usage: With the income from the family estate, she's in clover.

meaning: to hear or learn of something through an informal means of communication, especially gossip
meaning_uz: biror narsani norasmiy muloqot vositasi orqali eshitish yoki o'rganish, ayniqsa g'iybat
usage: I heard on the grapevine that Stacy and Mark are getting a divorce.

meaning: fully and deeply engrossed in a thought or idea, often to such a degree as to be unaware of or insensitive to the outside world
meaning_uz: fikr yoki g'oyaga to'liq va chuqur singib ketgan, ko'pincha tashqi dunyoga bexabar yoki e'tiborsiz bo'lish darajasigacha
usage: It's no use trying to talk to Helen when she's absorbed in thought like that, it's as if we don't even exist!

meaning: most of the time
meaning_uz: ko'p vaqt
usage: More often than not, a student will come up with the right answer.

meaning: automatically thinking or behaving in a particular way
meaning_uz: o'zboshimchalik bilan o'ylash yoki muayyan tarzda o'zini tutish
usage: Babies are hard-wired to pay attention to anything that is fast-moving, brightly colored, or loud.

meaning: someone who is regarded as highly intelligent
meaning_uz: yuqori darajada aqlli deb hisoblangan odam
usage: Kevin is such a brain box that he memorized pi to a hundred decimal places.

meaning: to initiate social interchanges and conversation, to get something started
meaning_uz: ijtimoiy o'zaro almashinuv va suhbatni boshlash, biror ishni boshlash uchun
usage: I tried to break the ice by talking to the people next to me about the weather.

meaning: recent events have been especially positive or beneficial, everything is going especially well
meaning_uz: so'nggi voqealar ayniqsa ijobiy yoki foydali bo'ldi, hamma narsa ayniqsa yaxshi ketmoqda
usage: Wow, everything's coming up roses for me lately - I got the job I wanted and had a wonderful birthday celebration.

meaning: something that warrants serious consideration
meaning_uz: jiddiy ko'rib chiqishga haqli bo'lgan narsa
usage: His study certainly provides food for thought, we should do more research on it.

meaning: over a relatively long or extended length of time in the future
meaning_uz: kelajakda ancha uzoq yoki uzoq vaqt davomida
usage: While the company was initially criticized for their new marketing strategy, it seems to have paid off for them in the long run.

meaning: a big sum of money given to a person when he/she leaves a company or retires
meaning_uz: kishi korxonani tark etganida yoki nafaqaga chiqqanida beriladigan katta miqdordagi pul
usage: The management of the company wanted to decrease their workforce so they offered a golden handshake to their aged employees.

meaning: to have the freedom or an opportunity to do something one wants, to have a very enjoyable time
meaning_uz: erkinlikka ega bo'lish yoki bir istagan ishni qilish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lish, juda quvnoq vaqt o'tkazish
usage: The press is going to have a field day if this story gets out.

meaning: to share information that is supposed to be kept secret, often used in the negative to encourage silence
meaning_uz: sir saqlanishi kerak bo'lgan, ko'pincha sukut saqlashni rag'batlantirish uchun negativda qo'llaniladigan ma'lumotlarni baham ko'rish uchun
usage: If you breathe a word of this to the cops, we'll come after you.

meaning: a contentious young person who goes against the system
meaning_uz: tizimiga qarshi chiqadigan bahsli yosh
usage: At the meeting, it was only the Young Turks that spoke against the Director.

meaning: someone or something that is seen as being the cause of trouble on a particular occasion
meaning_uz: muayyan bir vaziyatda qiyinchilikka sabab bo'lib ko'rilgan kimsa yoki biror
usage: When the minister was forced to resign, the press was generally seen as the villain of the piece.

meaning: a hierarchy of status seen among members of a group of people or animals, originally as observed among hens
meaning_uz: odamlar yoki hayvonlar guruhi a'zolari o'rtasida ko'rilgan holat ierarxiyasi, dastlab, to'ylar orasida kuzatilgan
usage: He started as a clerk but gradually rose in the pecking order.

meaning: a home where a loving and affectionate couple lives, a place where two people meet secretly to have a romantic affair
meaning_uz: mehribon va mehribon er-xotin yashaydigan uy, romantik ish qilish uchun ikki kishi yashirincha uchrashadigan joy
usage: The newlyweds couldn't wait to start building their love nest when they returned from their honeymoon.

meaning: hoping that something may be possible, although it is not likely
meaning_uz: biror narsa mumkin bo'lishi mumkinligiga umid qilmoqda, garchi bu ehtimol bo'lmasa ham
usage: She thought of ringing on the off chance of catching him at the flat.

idiom: not have a snowball's chance in hell
meaning: to have no chance of succeeding
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun hech qanday imkoniyatga ega bo'lmasligi
usage: If he can't afford a good lawyer, he doesn't have a snowball's chance in hell of winning the case.

meaning: to try to win favor from someone
meaning_uz: birovdan iltifot qozonishga harakat qilish
usage: The lawyer tried to curry favor with the judge.

meaning: an unpredictable or uncontrolled person who is liable to cause unintentional damage
meaning_uz: qasddan zarar etkazish uchun javobgar bo'lgan oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan yoki nazoratsiz shaxs
usage: Most of the cop heroes in contemporary films are loners and loose cannons.

meaning: a request or pledge to keep something a secret
meaning_uz: biror narsani sir saqlash haqidagi iltimos yoki vasiyatnoma
usage: Now, I don't want anyone to know that I'm pregnant yet, so mum's the word.

meaning: to do, say, or ask for something repeatedly but to be unable to change a situation
meaning_uz: qilish, aytish yoki biror narsani takroran so'rash, ammo vaziyatni o'zgartira olmasligi
usage: I keep asking her not to park there, but it's like banging my head against a brick wall.

meaning: to try to convince someone about something that they already support, to state one's opinion to those who are already most receptive to it
meaning_uz: birovni allaqachon qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan narsaga ishontirishga, unga eng ko'p e'tibor berganlarga o'z fikrini bildirishga harakat qilish
usage: You're preaching to the choir here - we all have kids and understand how busy life can get.

meaning: to eat something very quickly and voraciously
meaning_uz: biror narsani juda tez va vahshiylik bilan iste'mol qilish
usage: Let me just scarf down some breakfast, and I'll be ready to go!

meaning: to do something sporadically or as a hobby
meaning_uz: tez-tez yoki sevimli mashg'ulot sifatida biror narsa qilish uchun
usage: She dabbled in local politics for a while.

meaning: said when you admit that someone you do not like or admire does have some good qualities
meaning_uz: o'zingizga yoqmaydigan yoki hayratda qolmaydigan odamning ba'zi yaxshi fazilatlari borligini e'tirof etganingizda
usage: I don't like the man but - give the devil his due - he works incredibly hard.

idiom: lock the barn door after the horse has bolted
meaning: take precautions after damage has occurred
meaning_uz: zarar etkazilganidan so'ng ehtiyot choralarini ko'rish
usage: After the burglary they installed an alarm system. No use locking the barn door after the horse has bolted.

meaning: to pursue someone or something, often for selfish reasons
meaning_uz: kimnidir yoki nimanidir ta'qib qilishga, ko'pincha xudbin sabablarga ko'ra
usage: I don't trust him because I think he has designs on my job.

idiom: an empty sack cannot stand upright
meaning: one must eat in order to carry out one's duties
meaning_uz: birining vazifalarini bajarish uchun ovqatlanishi kerak
usage: Have some dinner before you go back to your research. An empty sack cannot stand upright, you know.

meaning: an unpleasant or painful situation or person that you have to accept and deal with
meaning_uz: qabul qilishingiz va hal qilishingiz kerak bo'lgan yoqimsiz yoki og'riqli holat yoki shaxs
usage: He lost all his crop to heavy rain. It was a heavy cross to bear for him.

idiom: can't judge a book by its cover
meaning: outward appearance cannot be an indicator of someone or something's value or worth
meaning_uz: tashqi ko'rinishi birovning yoki biror narsaning qiymatining yoki qiymatining ko'rsatkichi bo'la olmaydi
usage: The hotel looked attractive from outside, but the rooms were damp and not well maintained. You can't judge a book by its cover!

meaning: to cause someone to be interested in something, to cause you to want more of something
meaning_uz: kimnidir biror narsaga qiziqtirishi, ko'proq narsani istashiga sabab bo'lishi
usage: Predictions of defeat only seemed to whet his appetite for battle.

meaning: to increase someone's or one's own excitement, confidence, or mental preparation
meaning_uz: birovning yoki birovning o'z hayajonini, ishonchini yoki aqliy tayyorgarligini oshirishga
usage: The coach pumped us all up just before we headed out onto the field.

meaning: to speak in a very quick or hurried manner, to talk very fast
meaning_uz: juda tez yoki shoshma-shosharlik bilan gapirish, juda tez gaplashish
usage: When the boss gets excited, she starts talking a mile a minute, and I can never follow everything she's trying to say!

meaning: to admit that something you said before was wrong
meaning_uz: oldin aytgan gapingiz noto'g'ri ekanligini tan olish uchun
usage: Sam said it would never sell, but when he sees these sales figures he'll have to eat his words.

meaning: the only male in an all-female environment
meaning_uz: barcha ayollar muhitida yagona erkak
usage: My grandpa always jokingly complains that he's a cock in the henhouse living here with my grandma, my mom, and my twin sister.

idiom: at the top of the agenda
meaning: prioritized as the most important thing to discuss or address
meaning_uz: muhokama qilish yoki hal qilish uchun eng muhim narsa sifatida muhim ahamiyatga ega
usage: Yes, the new dress code is at the top of my agenda to discuss with the principal.

meaning: to make something seem more important or serious than it really is
meaning_uz: biror narsani haqiqatdan ham muhimroq yoki jiddiyroq ko'rsatish uchun
usage: It's ridiculous - we have a tiny disagreement and you blow the whole thing out of proportion!

meaning: to be involved in a difficult situation that you cannot get out of
meaning_uz: chiqa olmaydigan qiyin vaziyatga tushib qolish
usage: Sean tried to pay his gambling debts, but he was in over his head.

meaning: an expression or gesture of praise or approval
meaning_uz: maqtov yoki rozilik ifodasi yoki ishorasi
usage: The only reason she stays late at work is to receive a pat on the back from her boss.

meaning: moving around, especially after a period of injury, illness, or inactivity
meaning_uz: aylanib o'tish, ayniqsa jarohatlanish, kasallik yoki harakatsizlik davridan so'ng
usage: The surgery went very well, and the doctor is optimistic that she'll be up and about soon.

idiom: pull the wool over one's eyes
meaning: to deceive, fool, or misdirect one, especially to gain an advantage
meaning_uz: aldash, ahmoqona yoki noto'g'ri yo'lga qo'yish, ayniqsa, ustunlikka erishish uchun
usage: He tried pulling the wool over our eyes by hiding the profits in separate accounts, but we were quick to catch onto his scheme.

meaning: to demand that someone prove a claim
meaning_uz: birovdan da'voni isbotlashni talab qilish
usage: I don't know why he keeps making these outrageous claims. I've been calling his bluff for years and making him look like a fool.

meaning: a mild exaggeration beyond the truth or what is likely the case
meaning_uz: haqiqatdan tashqari yumshoq nopoklik yoki ehtimol nima
usage: I'm not too fond of taxes either, but it's a bit of a stretch to claim they are the cause of all our problems.

meaning: someone is especially lucky, fortunate, or successful or good things tend to happen to someone
meaning_uz: kimdir ayniqsa omadli, baxtli yoki muvaffaqiyatli yoki yaxshi narsalar kimgadir sodir bo'ladi
usage: I hear that Jenny just won some major award, so soon after her huge promotion. It seems that fortune smiles on her at the moment!

meaning: showing no activity or development, to be depressed and lethargic, sluggish, or lacking energy
meaning_uz: hech qanday faoliyat va rivojlanishni ko'rsatmaslik, tushkunlikka tushish va letargik, yalqov yoki energiya etishmasligi
usage: Sam was in the doldrums after he was insulted by the boss in front of his colleagues.

meaning: to stop yourself from saying something that you would really like to say
meaning_uz: o'zingizni haqiqatan ham aytmoqchi bo'lgan narsani aytishdan to'xtatish uchun
usage: I wanted to tell him exactly what I thought of him, but I had to bite my tongue.

meaning: to thoroughly impress, overwhelm, or excite one
meaning_uz: birini chuqur ta'sir qilish, bosib yoki hayajonga solish uchun
usage: The show of support from everyone just knocked my socks off.

meaning: to have the opportunity to do something or to reveal one's skill in this area
meaning_uz: biror ish qilish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishi yoki bu sohada o'z mahoratini ochib berishi
usage: The boss is so controlling that he never lets the rest of us get a look in.

meaning: in a state of ruin or likely to fail, bankrupt
meaning_uz: vayron bo'lgan yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashi ehtimoli bo'lgan holatda, bankrot
usage: Our accountant says the business is on the rocks.

meaning: to go back in time
meaning_uz: o'z vaqtida ortga qaytish uchun
usage: I wish I could wind back the clock and study harder before that exam I failed.

meaning: (of a statement or request) be ignored
meaning_uz: (gap yoki so'rovning) e'tiborsiz qoldirilishi
usage: Their appeals to release the hostages fell on deaf ears.

meaning: to waste effort on something when there is no chance of succeeding
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyati bo'lmaganda biror narsaga harakatni behuda sarflash
usage: He keeps trying to get his story published but I think he's beating a dead horse.

meaning: a look of contempt, anger, or disgust
meaning_uz: xorlik, g'azab yoki jirkanchlik ko'rinishi
usage: I got a really dirty look from the man sitting next to me when I started talking about politics.

meaning: an expression used to interrupt someone mid-speech and indicate that one's attention is being or about to be diverted
meaning_uz: nutq o'rtasida birovga to'xtalib, e'tibori burilayotganini yoki burilish arafasida ekanligini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladigan ifoda
usage: Sorry, Janet, hold that thought - I'm getting a call on the other line.

meaning: something that is very successful
meaning_uz: juda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lgan narsa
usage: The party was a roaring success.

meaning: an act that makes a very small amount of progress towards achieving something
meaning_uz: biror narsaga erishish yo'lida juda oz miqdorda ilgarilab boradigan akt
usage: Olympic officials have already started to take baby steps to rein in costs.

idiom: keep the wolf from the door
meaning: to do, acquire, or provide something that will allow one or something to narrowly avoid death, ruin, etc
meaning_uz: qilish, olish yoki biror narsaning o'limdan, vayronagarchilikdan va hokazolardan tor-mor bo'lishi uchun imkon beradigan narsalarni
usage: This loan will keep the wolf from the door, at least, but I'm worried it won't last long.

meaning: to sell a lot of goods very quickly
meaning_uz: juda ko'p tovarlarni juda tez sotishga
usage: It was a hot sunny day and the ice cream sellers were doing a roaring trade.

meaning: easily influenced by someone else, excessively willing to do what someone else wishes
meaning_uz: osonlik bilan boshqa birov ta'sir ko'rsatdi, boshqa birovning xohishini bajarishga haddan tashqari rozi
usage: As soon as Jones realized he could get in trouble if they reported him, he became putty in their hands.

meaning: to produce the basic ideas or structures from which something much larger develops
meaning_uz: ancha katta narsa rivojlanadigan asosiy g'oyalar yoki tuzilmalarni hosil qilish uchun
usage: The two leaders have laid the foundations of a new era in cooperation between their countries.

meaning: perfect order or neatness
meaning_uz: mukammal tartib yoki tozalik
usage: His room is always in apple-pie order.

meaning: an unofficial court or a court that disregards current laws and conducts unfair trials
meaning_uz: norasmiy sud yoki amaldagi qonunlarga e'tibor bermay, adolatsiz sudlar o'tkazadigan sud
usage: People who live under oppressive regimes are often treated harshly by corrupt kangaroo courts that don't abide by the law.

meaning: something that one enjoys or finds pleasurable but knows or feels to be bad, inferior, aberrant, or lowbrow, especially as might be perceived or judged by other people
meaning_uz: yoqimli bo'lgan yoki yoqimli bo'lgan, ammo yomon, past, aberrant yoki past bo'lishini biladigan yoki his qiladigan narsa, ayniqsa, boshqa odamlar tomonidan qabul qilinishi yoki hukm qilinishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa
usage: I know these gossip magazines are trashy, but reading them on my commute home is my guilty pleasure!

meaning: to address an audience as the sole speaker or presenting group, especially at length and in an official capacity
meaning_uz: tinglovchilarga yagona ma'ruzachi yoki taqdim etuvchi guruh sifatida murojaat qilish, ayniqsa, uzoq va rasmiy imkoniyatda
usage: The senator held the floor in support of the bill for nearly eight hours yesterday.

meaning: a circumstance that causes difficulty or hesitation
meaning_uz: qiyinchilik tug'diradigan yoki shoshqarib qo'yadigan holat
usage: The country's water shortage was a stumbling block to investors.

idiom: a stitch in time saves nine
meaning: an action taken now will prevent problems later
meaning_uz: endi amalga oshirilgan chora keyinchalik muammolarning oldini oladi
usage: You should consider getting your car repaired now before you're left stranded on the side of the road - a stitch in time saves nine.

meaning: to give an elaborate or detailed description of something that portrays it in a specific way
meaning_uz: aniq bir tarzda tasvirlaydigan narsaning batafsil yoki batafsil tavsifini berish
usage: The board meeting painted a pretty grim picture of the company's future.

meaning: take advantage of or exploit a situation
meaning_uz: vaziyatdan foydalanish yoki undan foydalanish
usage: The breweries were cashing in on the rediscovered taste for real ales.

meaning: extremely or completely wet, especially through one's clothing
meaning_uz: nihoyatda yoki butunlay nam, ayniqsa kiyim orqali
usage: The kids let themselves get soaked to the bone out in the rain, and now one of them is coming down with a cold!

meaning: used to describe when a person or group of people who have been treated badly for a long time suddenly become forceful and stop accepting a difficult situation
meaning_uz: uzoq vaqt davomida yomon muomalada bo'lgan odam yoki guruh birdaniga kuchli bo'lib, qiyin vaziyatni qabul qilishni to'xtatganda tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi
usage: It seems the worm has turned - after years of silence local people are beginning to protest about waste emissions from the factory.

meaning: to cover or extend across a wide and varied range
meaning_uz: qoplash yoki keng va turli xil doira bo'ylab uzatish uchun
usage: The tech company's products run the gamut from home appliances to computer modules for spacecraft.

meaning: someone or something that is functionally necessary but of small significance or importance within a larger operation or organization
meaning_uz: kimdir yoki funktsional jihatdan zarur bo'lgan, ammo kattaroq operatsiya yoki tashkilot ichida kichik ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan yoki muhim ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan biror narsa
usage: I'm tired of working in this thankless IT support job. I don't want to be just a cog in the wheel anymore!

meaning: said when you want to emphasize that real events or things are sometimes stranger than imaginary ones
meaning_uz: ta'kidlamoqchi bo'lganingizda, haqiqiy hodisalar yoki narsalar ba'zan xayoliy hodisalardan begona
usage: Did you see that story about the gorilla making a pet of a mouse? Truth really is stranger than fiction.

meaning: to put someone in an inescapable position or situation, to leave someone with no viable options or solutions
meaning_uz: birovni qochib bo'lmaydigan holatga yoki vaziyatga solib qo'yish, muqobil varianti va yechimi bo'lmagan odamni qoldirish
usage: If I want to stay in the country, I need a job, but if I want a job, I need to be living here - these immigration issues have me coming and going!

meaning: something you have wanted very much for a long time that has now happened
meaning_uz: siz juda ko'p vaqtdan beri juda xohlagan narsa endi sodir bo'lgan
usage: For her, making the Olympic team was a dream come true.

meaning: to eat, often quickly or enthusiastically
meaning_uz: ovqatlanishga, ko'pincha tez yoki g'ayrat bilan
usage: The puppy started chowing down the minute I set down his food bowl.

meaning: not brave enough to say what you mean directly and honestly
meaning_uz: to'g'ridan-to'g'ri va rostgo'ylik bilan nimani nazarda tutganingizni aytishga jasoratli emas
usage: The mealy-mouthed politician was severely criticized by the public.

meaning: speaking or capable of speaking in a loud, resonant voice, especially for prolonged periods
meaning_uz: gapirish yoki baland ovozda, rezonansli ovozda gapirishga qodir, ayniqsa uzoq muddat
usage: The leather-lunged lead singer was able to shake the audience with her soulful outpourings.

meaning: to improve one's position within the hierarchical structure or makeup of a culture, society, or social environment
meaning_uz: madaniyat, jamiyat yoki ijtimoiy muhitning ierarxik tuzilishi yoki tarkib topishi ichida o'z mavqeini oshirishga
usage: Miss Dumfey hopes to climb the social ladder by marrying the local diplomat.

meaning: the essential and most elementary parts of something; a general outline or summary; minimally furnished or adorned
meaning_uz: biror narsaning zaruriy va eng elementar qismlari; umumiy bayoni yoki xulosasi; minimal jihozlangan yoki bezatilgan
usage: Please don't go through each line item in the budget - just give me the bare bones.

meaning: to spend time talking about things that are not important
meaning_uz: muhim bo'lmagan narsalar haqida gapirishga vaqt sarflash uchun
usage: We sat out on the porch, just shooting the breeze.

meaning: alongside each other
meaning_uz: bir-biri bilan birga
usage: A tight fiscal policy working in tandem with a tight foreign exchange policy would hugely help the economy.

meaning: do something thoroughly, enthusiastically, or extravagantly
meaning_uz: biror ishni yaxshilab, g'ayrat bilan yoki nopok qilish
usage: They've really gone to town on their wedding.

idiom: sauce for the goose is sauce for the gander
meaning: if something is good, acceptable, or beneficial for one person, it is or should be equally so for another person or persons as well
meaning_uz: biror narsa bir kishi uchun yaxshi, ma'qul yoki manfaatli bo'lsa, u boshqa shaxs yoki shaxslar uchun ham teng bo'lishi yoki shunday bo'lishi kerak
usage: Well I guess if you are entitled to stay out until all hours, then I'll do the same. What's sauce for the goose is sauce for the gander, right?

meaning: to become extremely angry
meaning_uz: nihoyatda g'azabga to'lishi
usage: My sister will go nuts when she finds out I crashed her car.

meaning: to be very sensitive to something, to have a keen sense of detection or perception
meaning_uz: biror narsaga o'ta sezgir bo'lish, aniqlanish yoki idrok etishning jiddiy his-tuyg'ulariga ega bo'lish
usage: A good teacher must have good antennae for any emotional difficulties their students may be going through.

meaning: the end of something comes
meaning_uz: biror narsaning oxiri keladi
usage: When the curtain falls on the company after 50 years of business, a lot of people will be left jobless.

idiom: take the bitter with the sweet
meaning: to accept both the good and the bad that happens
meaning_uz: sodir bo'ladigan yaxshini ham, yomonni ham qabul qilishni
usage: If you intend to get married, you must be prepared to take the bitter with the sweet.

meaning: to do something that prevents an activity from continuing
meaning_uz: faoliyatni davom ettirishga to'sqinlik qiladigan ishni amalga
usage: If the viewing figures drop much more, the TV network will probably pull the plug on the whole series.

meaning: go to bed
meaning_uz: Uxlagani yoting
usage: I've got a busy day tomorrow, so I think I'll hit the sack.

idiom: work one's fingers to the bone
meaning: work very hard
meaning_uz: juda ko'p mehnat
usage: She worked her fingers to the bone to provide a home and food for seven children.

meaning: to tell the truth about something that you have been keeping secret
meaning_uz: siz sir tutgan narsa haqida haqiqatni aytish uchun
usage: I thought it was time to come clean about my sneaking out in the night.

meaning: to become more outgoing, usually said of a shy or introverted person
meaning_uz: yanada chiquvchi bo'lish uchun, odatda, uyalgan yoki introverted odam haqida aytilgan
usage: Wow, Anna has really come out of her shell lately. I remember when she wouldn't even talk to anyone, and now she's likely to be voted "Most Talkative".

meaning: associate or come into contact with another person
meaning_uz: sherik qilish yoki boshqa shaxs bilan aloqaga kirishish
usage: He rubbed shoulders with TV stars at the party.

meaning: used to tell someone to do something slowly and carefully or to calm down
meaning_uz: birovga biror ishni sekin va ehtiyotkorlik bilan bajarishni yoki tinchlanishni aytish uchun
usage: Easy does it, guys - you're moving a priceless piece of art!

meaning: to be exceptionally proficient at something
meaning_uz: biror narsada nihoyatda mohir bo'lish
usage: Jenny's got a real knack for the piano.

meaning: no ill will, no resentment or anger
meaning_uz: hech qanday yomon iroda, g'azab va g'azab yo'q
usage: Unfortunately these layoffs are out of our control. I hope there are no hard feelings.

meaning: in every way, to an extreme degree
meaning_uz: har tomonlama, ekstremal darajada
usage: I was shocked to the core on hearing his verdict.

meaning: to listen carefully
meaning_uz: diqqat bilan tinglashga
usage: The children pricked up their ears when they heard the word "candy".

meaning: something that seems like a good idea, but would be difficult to do
meaning_uz: yaxshi fikrga o'xshagan, ammo qiyin bo'ladigan narsa
usage: The doctor advised her to stop smoking and drinking but she is addicted so it is easier said than done for her.

meaning: official, bureaucratic rules or methods that are typically overly strict, convoluted, or tedious
meaning_uz: odatda haddan tashqari qat'iy, konvolyutsiyalangan yoki zerikarli bo'lgan rasmiy, byurokratik qoidalar yoki usullar
usage: Our lawyer was able to cut through red tape and get us an answer from the courthouse.

meaning: to do something based on guesswork, intuition, or without any help or instructions
meaning_uz: guesswork, intuitsiya asosida yoki hech qanday yordam va ko'rsatmalarsiz biror ish qilish
usage: I've never filed my own taxes before, so I'm sort of flying blind.

meaning: to have something more important to do
meaning_uz: muhimroq narsaga ega bo'lishi
usage: I won't waste time on your question. I have bigger fish to fry.

meaning: used when you are extremely surprised, confused, or angry about something
meaning_uz: biror narsaga nihoyatda hayron bo'lganda, sarosimaga tushganda yoki g'azablanganda ishlatiladi
usage: What on earth is that awful noise?

meaning: to treat something or someone without enough care
meaning_uz: biror narsa yoki biror kishiga etarlicha g'amxo'rlik qilmasdan davolash uchun
usage: Like many movie-makers, he plays fast and loose with the facts to tell his own version of the story.

meaning: to look twice due to surprise or disbelief
meaning_uz: hayrat yoki kufr tufayli ikki marta ko'rinishga
usage: Everyone did a double take at his shiny new sports car as he drove by.

meaning: be in a state of enjoyment based on false beliefs or hopes, a state of illusory happiness
meaning_uz: yolg'on e'tiqod yoki umidlarga asoslangan lazzatlanish holatida bo'lish, illatli baxt holati
usage: Fred is confident that he will get a big raise this year, but I think he is living in a fool's paradise.

idiom: not know someone from a bar of soap
meaning: to be completely unaware of or know nothing about someone; to have never met the person indicated
meaning_uz: birovdan butunlay bexabar bo'lish yoki hech narsa bilmaslik; ko'rsatilgan shaxs bilan hech qachon uchrashmagan bo'lishi
usage: My girlfriend got really excited when a movie star apparently walked past us, but I wouldn't know him from a bar of soap.

meaning: to desert one in a troubling situation
meaning_uz: tashvishli vaziyatda bittasini cho'lga
usage: He says he's my friend, but then he totally hung me out to dry in that meeting! Not one word of support as the boss tore into me!

meaning: tangible benefits or rewards, material benefits
meaning_uz: taniqli foyda yoki mukofotlar, moddiy manfaatdorlik
usage: Paul hasn't helped us with this project at all, but you know he'll be there for the loaves and fishes if we win the contest!

meaning: to take time to think through an issue, to give some thought to a topic
meaning_uz: bir masala orqali o'ylab ko'rish uchun vaqt ajratish, biror mavzuga ba'zi bir fikrni
usage: I'll speak to the visitors in a moment. I need some time to collect my thoughts.

meaning: with no illusions or pretensions, practical and realistic
meaning_uz: hech qanday illat va gumonlarsiz, amaliy va real
usage: She's a down to earth woman with no pretensions.

meaning: to admire or love someone so much that you believe they have no faults
meaning_uz: birovni shunchalik hayratda qoldirib yoki sevishi kerakki, ularning hech qanday aybi yo'qligiga ishonasiz
usage: Most people put athletes and movie stars on a pedestal.

meaning: to offer a sign of surrender or defeat, to yield or give in
meaning_uz: taslim bo'lish yoki mag'lubiyat belgisini taklif qilish, hosil berish yoki berish
usage: After the prosecutors brought forward their newest evidence, the defendant waved the white flag and agreed to the plea bargain.

idiom: a cat on a hot tin roof
meaning: one who is anxious and unable to sit still or relax
meaning_uz: ovora bo'lib, to'xtab o'tira olmaydigan yoki dam ololmaydigan kimsa
usage: Waiting for the doctor to call with her test results, she's been like a cat on a hot tin roof all day.

meaning: to have a very strong and persistent desire or craving for something
meaning_uz: juda kuchli va davomli bir narsaga intilish yoki intilishga ega bo'lish
usage: I've had a yen for sushi ever since I came back from Tokyo last month.

meaning: something that two or more people argue about strongly over a long period of time
meaning_uz: ikki yoki undan ortiq kishi uzoq vaqt davomida kuchli tortishadigan narsa
usage: Jerry leaving his dirty dishes in the sink for days became a bone of contention between him and his roommate.

meaning: without a person's knowledge and in an unfair way
meaning_uz: insonning bilimisiz va adolatsiz tarzda
usage: Carla made fun of him behind his back.

meaning: to say or do something in a very complicated way when it could be very simple
meaning_uz: juda oddiy bo'lishi mumkin bo'lganda biror narsani juda murakkab tarzda aytish yoki qilish
usage: There's no need to go all round the houses, just tell me straight out what's wrong.

meaning: under the protection, sponsorship, or patronage of or under the oversight, supervision, control, or management of
meaning_uz: nazorati, nazorati, nazorati yoki boshqaruvi ostida yoxud uning nazorati ostida yoki uning himoyasi ostida yoki uning himoyasi ostida
usage: The whole exhibition, under the auspices of the National Organization for Women, aims to draw attention to the injustices women all over the world face every day.

idiom: the devil is in the details
meaning: used for saying that something may seem simple, but in fact the details are complicated and likely to cause problems
meaning_uz: biror narsa oddiy ko'rinishi mumkin, deb aytish uchun ishlatiladi, lekin aslida tafsilotlar murakkab va muammolarga olib kelishi mumkin
usage: The Irish economy is performing strongly, but the devil is in the detail.

meaning: a very difficult task or challenge
meaning_uz: juda qiyin vazifa yoki urg'u
usage: You certainly have a mountain to climb if you intend to get this project done by Thursday.

meaning: to complete or do something successfully
meaning_uz: bajarish yoki biror ishni muvaffaqiyatli bajarish uchun
usage: Although we initially struggled to get funding for our project, we were able to bring it to fruition.

meaning: make an otherwise ordinary or dull day pleasingly memorable for someone
meaning_uz: aksincha oddiy yoki zerikarli kunni birov uchun yoqimli unutilmas qilib qo'ying
usage: Seeing those little kids having so much fun just made my day.

meaning: good at your job
meaning_uz: ishingizda yaxshi
usage: Any accountant worth their salt should be aware of the latest changes in taxation.

meaning: informed or up to date, involved in or aware of what is going on
meaning_uz: bo'layotgan voqealar bilan shug'ullangan yoki xabardor bo'lgan, xabardor bo'lgan yoki dolzarb bo'lgan ma'lumotli yoki dolzarb
usage: Just make sure you keep the boss in the picture about the status of the project.

idiom: wouldn't touch with a barge pole
meaning: do not want to become in any way involved in or with something or someone
meaning_uz: biror narsa bilan yoki biror narsa bilan yoki biror narsa bilan shug'ullanishni xohlamang
usage: You might think John is attractive, but I wouldn't touch him with a barge pole. He seems like a creep.

meaning: to provide or offer a useful skill or attribute
meaning_uz: foydali ko'nikma yoki atributni taqdim etish yoki taklif qilish
usage: He brings years of leadership experience to the table.

meaning: through some ordeal, difficulty, trial, or punishment; through an unpleasant experience
meaning_uz: ba'zi og'ir sinovlar, qiyinchilik, sud yoki jazo orqali; yoqimsiz tajriba orqali
usage: Jake wasn't a great fit for the military, and he was constantly being put through the wringer for disobedience.

meaning: in a confused, badly organized, or difficult situation
meaning_uz: sarosimaga tushgan, yomon tashkil etilgan yoki qiyin vaziyatda
usage: We've been at sixes and sevens in the office this week as the deadline is fast approaching.

meaning: unappreciated or not understood, as of an idea
meaning_uz: qadrlanmagan yoki tushunilmagan, fikrdan kelib
usage: The joke was lost on the audience, unfortunately. I'll have to rewrite it to be less subtle.

meaning: to experience success, to feel confident and/or exuberant because of success or a pleasurable or uplifting experience
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatga erishish, muvaffaqiyat yoki yoqimli yoki ko'tarinki tajriba tufayli o'zingizni ishonchli va / yoki quvonchli his qilish
usage: The candidate is riding high in the polls after a strong debate performance.

meaning: fail to reach a goal or standard
meaning_uz: maqsadga yoki standartga erisha olmadi
usage: We're so close to getting the job done, but we keep coming up short.

idiom: not playing with a full deck
meaning: not very intelligent or bright, not mentally sound
meaning_uz: juda aqlli yoki yorqin emas, aqliy jihatdan tovushli emas
usage: He is a nice person, but with some of the foolish things he does, I think he's not playing with a full deck.

meaning: thoroughly inebriated or drunk to the point of incoherence, senselessness, or the loss of self-control
meaning_uz: bir-biriga zidlik, aqlsizlik yoki o'z-o'zini nazorat qilishning yo'qolishigacha yaxshilab inebriatsiyalangan yoki mast
usage: I hate being in New Orleans during the festival - an appalling number of people are sloshed to the gills!

meaning: said when something, especially money, is easily got and then soon spent or lost
meaning_uz: biror narsa, ayniqsa, pul osongina o'tilganda va keyin tez orada sarflanganda yoki yo'qolganda
usage: I lost £500 in a card game last night, but that's life - easy come, easy go.

meaning: someone who pretends, in an argument or discussion, to be against an idea or plan that a lot of people support, in order to make people discuss and consider it in more detail
meaning_uz: o'zini, bahs yoki muhokamada, ko'pchilik qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan fikr yoki rejaga qarshi deb o'ylaydigan odam, odamlarni muhokama qilish va buni batafsilroq ko'rib chiqish uchun
usage: The schoolmaster often played devil's advocate with his students so that they could have an interesting discussion and look at other point of views.

meaning: make use of one's influence and contacts to gain an advantage unofficially or unfairly
meaning_uz: norasmiy yoki adolatsiz ustunlikka erishish uchun o'z ta'siri va aloqalaridan foydalaning
usage: He tried to pull strings with people he knew to avoid being called up.

meaning: to get married
meaning_uz: turmush qurish uchun
usage: So when are you two going to tie the knot?

idiom: not a dry eye in the house
meaning: used to mean that all the people at a particular place felt very emotional about what they had seen or heard and many of them were crying
meaning_uz: muayyan joydagi barcha odamlar ko'rgan yoki eshitganlaridan juda emotsional his qilganini va ularning ko'pchiligi yig'layotganini anglatardi
usage: His final monologue was simply heartbreaking. There wasn't a dry eye in the house.

meaning: excited, nervous, or filled with suspense while one waits to see what happens next
meaning_uz: hayajonlangan, hayajonlangan yoki shubha bilan to'lib-toshgan, bundan keyin nima bo'lishini kutayotganda
usage: Her character is so deliciously sinister and conniving that I was always on the edge of my seat to see what she would do next.

meaning: if something goes down a treat, people like it very much
meaning_uz: biror narsa taomdan pastga tushsa, odamlarga juda yoqadi
usage: That new vegetarian restaurant seems to be going down a treat.

meaning: irresistibly and dangerously attracted to something or someone
meaning_uz: biror narsaga yoki birovga qarshiliksiz va xavfli jalb qilingan
usage: I never understood why people flocked around him like moths to a flame.

idiom: on the one hand/on the other hand
meaning: used when you are comparing two different facts or two opposite ways of thinking about a situation
meaning_uz: vaziyat haqida ikki xil fakt yoki ikki qarama-qarshi fikrlash usulini solishtirayotganda qo'llaniladi
usage: On the one hand I'd like a job that pays more, but on the other hand I enjoy the work I'm doing at the moment.

meaning: to make public something embarrassing that should be kept secret
meaning_uz: sir saqlanishi kerak bo'lgan uyatli narsani ommaga e'lon qilish
usage: I don't understand why people go on talk shows and air their dirty laundry in public.

idiom: not the sharpest tool in the shed
meaning: not particularly intelligent, witty, or clever
meaning_uz: ayniqsa aqlli, aqlli yoki aqlli emas
usage: Her new boyfriend isn't the sharpest tool in the shed, but he's pretty good looking!

meaning: to begin to understand something
meaning_uz: biror narsani tushunishni boshlash uchun
usage: I was totally confused, but I began to see the light after his explanation.

meaning: to come to see someone, sometimes at a stated place, usually briefly and without a specific invitation
meaning_uz: birovni ko'rish uchun kelish, ba'zan belgilangan joyda, odatda qisqa va aniq taklifsiz
usage: The publisher told the writers they should drop by if they ever wanted a newspaper job.

meaning: to defeat one
meaning_uz: bitta mag'lubiyatga uchratish uchun
usage: I've been practicing really hard because I refuse to let my nemesis eat my lunch again.

idiom: the short end of the stick
meaning: an unequal outcome of a deal that results in a disadvantage or burden
meaning_uz: noqulaylik yoki yukga olib keladigan bitimning tengsiz natijasi
usage: You have to stay calm during business negotiations or else you may end up getting the short end of the stick.

meaning: slow or unable to understand something
meaning_uz: sekin yoki biror narsani tushuna olmaydigan
usage: I was always a bit slow on the uptake as a kid, so school was never my favorite place to be.

meaning: to improvise, to do something extemporaneously
meaning_uz: improvizatsiya qilish, extemporaneously biror ish qilish uchun
usage: I didn't have time to prepare this speech, so I'll have to wing it.

meaning: to have, consume, or experience as much of something as one desires or is able to
meaning_uz: bo'lishi, iste'mol qilishi yoki bir narsaning istalgan yoki qodir bo'lgan darajada bo'lishi, iste'mol qilishi yoki
usage: Make sure you have your fill of cake - we made plenty for everyone!

idiom: keep in step with the times
meaning: to be, strive to be, or appear to be contemporary, fashionable, and/or relevant in modern times
meaning_uz: bo'lish, bo'lishga harakat qilish, ya'ni hozirgi zamonda zamondosh, moda va/yoki dolzarb bo'lib ko'rinishi
usage: As information becomes more readily available in a digital format, publishers are going to have to change their methods if they want to keep in step with the times.

idiom: like a dog with two tails
meaning: used to say that someone is very happy about something
meaning_uz: kimdir biror narsadan juda xursand, deb aytadigan bo'lsak
usage: Lucy will be like a dog with two tails if she gets into the team.

meaning: finished in every practical or functional sense, almost completely done
meaning_uz: har bir amaliy yoki funktsional ma'noda bitilgan, deyarli butunlay amalga
usage: This project is as good as done, so I'm going home for the night.

meaning: to finish, complete, or leave something at a successful, impressive, or climactic point
meaning_uz: ni tugatish, tugatish yoki biror narsani muvaffaqiyatli, ta'sirchan yoki klimaktik nuqtada qoldirish uchun
usage: I know we've had quite a few losses this season, but let's win this last game and end on a high note!

meaning: to suggest or think of an idea or plan
meaning_uz: fikr yoki rejani taklif qilish yoki o'ylash uchun
usage: She's come up with some amazing scheme to double her income.

meaning: reveal secret information unintentionally or indiscreetly
meaning_uz: yashirin ma'lumotlarni bilmasdan yoki beparvo ochib berish
usage: So who spilled the beans about her affair with David?

meaning: a feeling of nervousness
meaning_uz: asabiylashish tuyg'usi
usage: The butterflies in my stomach almost kept me from going on stage and performing.

meaning: be too slow to take advantage of an opportunity
meaning_uz: imkoniyatdan foydalanish uchun juda sekin bo'ling
usage: People who've been holding off buying anything in case prices drop further could find they've missed the boat.

meaning: to greatly or specifically irritate or annoy someone
meaning_uz: birovni juda yoki aniq g'azablantirish yoki g'azablantirish uchun
usage: It really grinds my gears when cyclists go zipping through red lights!

meaning: devotedly
meaning_uz: bag'ishlangan
usage: She loves those children heart and soul.

meaning: pay for something
meaning_uz: biror narsa uchun to'lash
usage: My company will pick up the tab for all moving expenses.

meaning: a part of the profits or advantages that come from an activity
meaning_uz: faoliyatdan kelib chiqadigan foyda yoki afzalliklarning bir qismi
usage: When it comes to lawsuits, everyone seems to want a piece of the action.

meaning: cause something to start happening
meaning_uz: biror narsa sodir bo'lishni boshlashiga sabab bo'ladi
usage: We have to get the ball rolling on this project soon and show the client some progress.

meaning: to learn a piece of information, especially when it has been a secret
meaning_uz: maʼlumotni oʻrganishga, ayniqsa, sir boʻlganda
usage: We have a crisis on our hands and don't want the press to get wind of it.

idiom: keep up one's end of the bargain
meaning: to do as was promised in an agreement or bargain; to carry through with what one agreed to do
meaning_uz: bitim yoki sarmoyada va'da qilinganidek qilish; qilishga rozi bo'lgan ishni bajarish uchun
usage: We've done the work on our end. I just hope their team keeps up their end of the bargain!

meaning: something that has happened and cannot be changed, hence, not important
meaning_uz: sodir bo'lgan va o'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan narsa, shuning uchun muhim emas
usage: I should have negotiated a higher salary when I was offered the job, but that's water under the bridge now.

idiom: a leopard can't change its spots
meaning: one will stay true to one's nature, even if one pretends or claims otherwise
meaning_uz: biri o'zini boshqacha ko'rsatsa yoki da'vo qilsa ham, o'z tabiatiga sodiq qoladi
usage: After our breakup, he came crawling back, trying to convince me that he'd changed, but I know that a leopard can't change its spots.

meaning: information about a situation, especially other people's opinions
meaning_uz: holat to'g'risidagi ma'lumotlar, ayniqsa, boshqa odamlarning fikri
usage: I think I'll see which way the wind is blowing before I vote at the board meeting.

meaning: everyone is paying close attention to someone or something
meaning_uz: hamma birovga yoki biror narsaga diqqat bilan qarayapti
usage: All eyes will be on the Chancellor tomorrow when he gives his Budget speech.

meaning: a person who has good qualities despite a rough exterior, a person with great potential
meaning_uz: qo'pol tashqi ko'rinishiga qaramay yaxshi fazilatlarga ega bo'lgan inson, katta potensialga ega bo'lgan
usage: He's a diamond in the rough - a little hard to take at times, but very smart and helpful.

meaning: barely in time, at the last moment
meaning_uz: vaqt o'tishi bilan, oxirgi vaqtda
usage: I turned in my report just under the wire.

meaning: in a nervous, confused, or agitated state
meaning_uz: asabiylashgan, chalkashib ketgan yoki asabiylashgan holatda
usage: We were all of a dither waiting to meet the president at our school rally.

meaning: to have a specific involvement or participation in something
meaning_uz: biror narsada aniq ishtirok etish yoki ishtirok etish uchun
usage: Look, we all have a part in making sure this campaign is successful, so we each have to do our best.

meaning: the world is made up of many varieties or types of people, so you should not judge people who are different from you
meaning_uz: dunyo ko'plab nav yoki odamlar turlaridan tashkil topgan. Shuning uchun sizdan ajralib turgan odamlarni hukm qilmaslik kerak
usage: I don't understand a lot of the decisions Michael makes, but it takes all kinds to make a world, right?

idiom: variety is the spice of life
meaning: said to emphasize that doing many different things, or often changing what you do, makes life interesting
meaning_uz: ko'plab turli ishlarni bajarish, ya'ni ko'pincha qilayotgan ishingizni o'zgartirish hayotni qiziqarli qilishini ta'kidlash uchun aytilgan
usage: You should really start trying new foods instead of eating the same thing all the time. Variety is the spice of life.

meaning: at a time when someone really needs help
meaning_uz: kimdir haqiqatan ham yordamga muhtoj bo'lgan bir paytda
usage: She helped me in my hour of need, and for that, I am forever grateful.

meaning: to look stupid because of something that you have done
meaning_uz: qilgan ishingiz tufayli ahmoqona ko'rinishga
usage: This latest scandal has left the government with egg on its face.

meaning: to complain or gripe about someone or something
meaning_uz: shikoyat qilish yoki birov yoki biror narsa haqida ushlash uchun
usage: Of course Marjorie is beefing about how I left dishes out in the kitchen - she's not happy unless everything is perfectly put away.

meaning: as time passes, many different issues or problems tend to be resolved or alleviated
meaning_uz: vaqt o'tishi bilan ko'plab turli masalalar yoki muammolar hal bo'lishga yoki yengillashtirishga moyil
usage: I know it's hard to think you'll ever stop grieving, but time works wonders.

meaning: to be promoted to a higher role or position in a company that has little actual responsibility or authority
meaning_uz: haqiqiy mas'uliyati yoki vakolati kam bo'lgan korxonada yuqori rol yoki lavozimga ko'tarilishi
usage: John was kicked upstairs to an assistant manager position so he would stop griping about his pay.

meaning: a view as seen from below or from a humble position
meaning_uz: pastdan yoki kamtarona pozitsiyadan ko'rinib turgan ko'rinish
usage: Because he was stuck in the same menial position for so long, he only had a worm's eye view of how the business operated.

meaning: improving in health or condition, recovering
meaning_uz: sog'lig'i yoki holati yaxshilanishi, tiklanishi
usage: The economy is on the mend thanks to measures taken by the government.

meaning: a confrontation or disagreement that is highly aggressive, emotionally expressive, or dramatic, but which does not end or result in violence
meaning_uz: juda tajovuzkor, hissiy ifodali yoki dramatik bo'lgan, ammo zo'ravonlikka chek qo'yilmaydigan yoki olib kelmaydigan qarama-qarshilik yoki kelishmovchilik
usage: It was handbags at dawn between the two players, who had been verbally taunting one another throughout the match.

meaning: a punch in the mouth
meaning_uz: og'ziga yumush
usage: If you keep mocking me, you're going to get a knuckle sandwich!

meaning: to win
meaning_uz: g'olib bo'lish uchun
usage: I heard that you might bear the palm at the science fair! Congratulations, it would be a well-deserved victory.

meaning: pretend not to notice
meaning_uz: sezmayotgandek ko'rsating
usage: Management often turn a blind eye to bullying in the workplace.

meaning: to live, operate, or function with the unyielding belief in something, especially that which is fanciful, unrealistic, or untrue
meaning_uz: biror narsaga, ayniqsa xayoliy, real bo'lmagan yoki yolg'on bo'lgan narsalarga bo'lgan ishonch bilan yashash, faoliyat yuritish yoki ishlash
usage: Jeremy's always labored under the illusion of being a great writer, even though he's never written more than a few crummy poems.

idiom: run round like a headless chicken
meaning: to be very busy doing a lot of things, but in a way that is not very effective
meaning_uz: ko'p ishlarni bajarish bilan juda band bo'lish, lekin unchalik samarali bo'lmagan tarzda
usage: Give yourself enough time before deadline so that you don't have to be running around like a headless chicken at the last minute.

idiom: the final nail in the coffin
meaning: an event which causes the failure of something that had already started to fail
meaning_uz: allaqachon muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchray boshlagan narsaning muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashiga sabab bo'ladigan hodisa
usage: This latest evidence could be the final nail in the coffin for Jackson's case.

meaning: to be satisfied with your achievements and not to make an effort to do anything else
meaning_uz: yutuqlaringizdan qoniqish hosil qilish va boshqa hech narsa qilishga harakat qilmaslik
usage: Just because you've got your degree doesn't mean you can rest on your laurels.

meaning: to follow along with an event as it proceeds, without trying to assert control over it
meaning_uz: davom etayotgan hodisa bilan birga ergashish, ustidan nazoratni ta'kidlashga urinmasdan
usage: We always do things your way - can't you just go with the flow for once?

meaning: to recognize that something is not as it appears to be or that something dishonest is happening
meaning_uz: biror narsa ko'rinadigan darajada emasligini yoki nohaq narsa sodir bo'layotganini tan olish uchun
usage: She smelled a rat when she phoned him at the office where he was supposed to be working late and he wasn't there.

meaning: tears or expressions of sorrow that are insincere
meaning_uz: samimiy bo'lgan ko'z yoshi yoki qayg'u ifodalari
usage: They weep crocodile tears for the poor and disadvantaged, but are basically happy with things as they are.

meaning: betray someone
meaning_uz: kimgadir xiyonat qilish
usage: He had been lied to and stabbed in the back by people that he thought were his friends.

meaning: rushing through things will give a poor result
meaning_uz: narsalar orqali shoshilish noto'g'ri natija beradi
usage: Be careful while checking the papers. Haste makes waste, so check them thoroughly before submitting them.

meaning: to omit main points of a topic often intentionally or to delay or avoid talking about something difficult or unpleasant
meaning_uz: ko'pincha qasddan mavzuning asosiy nuqtalarini qoldirish yoki qiyin yoki yoqimsiz narsa haqida gapirishni kechiktirish yoki undan qochish uchun
usage: Please stop beating around the bush and tell me what the problem is!

meaning: to leave a place or begin a journey
meaning_uz: joydan chiqib ketish yoki safarni boshlash uchun
usage: I'd love to stay longer but I must be hitting the road.

meaning: to leave or depart very quickly or hastily, especially by driving
meaning_uz: chiqib ketish yoki juda tez yoki shoshib ketish, ayniqsa haydash orqali
usage: The criminals zoomed off just before the police arrived.

meaning: an unacknowledged discriminatory barrier to advancement
meaning_uz: ilgarilab borish uchun noma'nosiz firibgarlik to'sig'i
usage: At the age of 43, she became the highest ranking woman officer in the country, squashing all speculations of the existence of a glass ceiling.

meaning: attractive additional features or trimmings
meaning_uz: jozibador qo'shimcha xususiyatlari yoki trimmings
usage: Manufacturers still build luxury cars with all the bells and whistles.

meaning: somebody who has many skills or who does many different jobs successfully
meaning_uz: ko'p ko'nikmalarga ega bo'lgan yoki ko'plab turli ishlarni muvaffaqiyatli bajaradigan odam
usage: My big brother is an engineer by profession but can drive a big lorry, can repair the machines and runs many of his stores, he is really a jack of all trades.

meaning: something or someone that is unusual, rare, or abnormal in some way
meaning_uz: biror narsa yoki qandaydir yo'l bilan g'ayrioddiy, kam uchraydigan yoki g'ayritabiiy bo'lgan
usage: The goat they have at the circus sideshow is a real freak of nature, it was born with two heads!

meaning: to produce excellent results or be extremely effective, especially unexpectedly
meaning_uz: a'lo natijalar berishi yoki nihoyatda samarali bo'lishi, ayniqsa, kutilmaganda
usage: Getting the job did wonders for her self-confidence.

meaning: to help someone excessively, usually to the recipient's detriment
meaning_uz: kimgadir haddan tashqari yordam berish, odatda, oluvchining zarariga
usage: Her students are lazy because she always spoon feeds the answers to them.

idiom: in the heat of the moment
meaning: at a moment when one is overly angry, excited, or eager, without pausing to consider the consequences
meaning_uz: oqibatlarini ko'rib chiqishga to'xtamasdan, haddan tashqari g'azablangan, hayajonlangan yoki intilgan bir paytda
usage: The argument got pretty nasty, and, in the heat of the moment, we both said some things we really regret.

meaning: carefully consider the possible consequences before taking action
meaning_uz: chora ko'rishdan oldin mumkin bo'lgan oqibatlarni diqqat bilan ko'rib
usage: If you deceive your boss now, what do you think will happen if he finds out about it? I mean, look before you leap!

meaning: very close or friendly
meaning_uz: juda yaqin yoki do'stona
usage: I'm sure she tells Ruth everything we say - they're as thick as thieves, those two.

meaning: a show of intentional unfriendliness, rejection
meaning_uz: qasddan do'stsizlanish, raddiya ko'rsatuvi
usage: The new England manager gave him the cold shoulder.

meaning: a goal that is pursued in its own right to the exclusion of others
meaning_uz: o'zgalar chetga chiqishiga o'z ixtiyorida ta'qib qilinadigan maqsad
usage: My parents think that studying literature is an end in itself and will never lead to a career.

meaning: a work day that is shorter than that of most businesses, typically between 10 am and 3 pm on Monday through Friday, the hours when banks used to be open
meaning_uz: aksariyat korxonalarga qaraganda qisqa bo'lgan ish kuni, odatda, dushanbadan jumagacha soat 10:00 dan 15:00 gacha, banklar ilgari ochiq bo'lgan soatlar
usage: His business is doing so well he can just keep banker's hours and still earn enough.

meaning: be completely finished or ready
meaning_uz: butunlay tugallangan yoki tayyor bo'ling
usage: I'm exhausted, but at least the work is done and dusted.

meaning: always near or spending a lot of time with someone else, often a close friend
meaning_uz: doimo yaqin yoki boshqa birov bilan ko'p vaqt o'tkazadigan, ko'pincha yaqin do'st
usage: Every time I see Jenna, Kelli is right there with her. Those two are really joined at the hip these days.

idiom: the thin end of the wedge
meaning: the beginning of a harmful development; some minor change or development that instigates or foreshadows something much larger or more impactful
meaning_uz: zararli rivojlanishning boshlanishi; ancha katta yoki ta'sirli narsani qo'zg'atadigan yoki oldindan ko'rsatadigan ba'zi kichik o'zgarishlar yoki rivojlanish
usage: If we allow them to get a foothold in this territory, it could be the thin edge of the wedge that sees them stealing huge portions of our market share.

idiom: get blood out of a stone
meaning: to do something that is very hard to accomplish
meaning_uz: amalga oshirish juda qiyin bo'lgan ishni bajarishga
usage: Persuading Chris to buy a round of drinks is like getting blood from a stone.

meaning: a return of strength or energy that makes it possible to continue in an activity that needs a lot of effort
meaning_uz: ko'p harakatga muhtoj bo'lgan faoliyatni davom ettirish imkoniyatini beradigan kuch yoki energiyaning qaytarilishi
usage: We started to feel we couldn't walk any further but when we saw the town in the distance we got our second wind.

meaning: to meet someone by chance and not by choice
meaning_uz: tanlov bo'yicha emas, balki tasodif bilan birov bilan uchrashish uchun
usage: The last time I crossed paths with Fred, we ended up arguing about something inconsequential.

meaning: to have a large amount of respect or admiration for someone
meaning_uz: kimgadir katta hurmat yoki hayratga ega bo'lish
usage: I've always held my father in high regard for his hard work to provide for us.

meaning: to be polite and well behaved, to mind one's manners
meaning_uz: muloyim va yaxshi xulqli bo'lish, odob-axloqni esga
usage: Be sure to mind your p's and q's when you visit your aunt this weekend!

meaning: immediately obvious or clearly apparent
meaning_uz: darhol aniq yoki aniq ko'rinadi
usage: The solution was right in front of my nose, but I just couldn't grasp it.

meaning: a recognition or citation of merit given to a contestant, exhibition, entry, etc., in a competition despite that person or thing not being awarded a prize or top honor
meaning_uz: tanlov qatnashchisiga berilgan munosiblikni tan olish yoki iqtibos, ko'rgazma, kirish va h.k., ushbu shaxs yoki narsa mukofot yoki yuqori sharafga sazovor bo'lmasligiga qaramay
usage: My short story did not win a top place in the writing competition, but being given an honorable mention still gives me great pride.

meaning: to do the same thing as someone else, esp. someone in your family, previously did
meaning_uz: boshqa birov bilan bir xil ish qilish, esp. sizning oilangizda kimdir, ilgari qilgan
usage: She followed in her mother's footsteps and started her own business.

meaning: without limits or controls
meaning_uz: cheklovsiz va nazoratsiz
usage: This is comedy with no holds barred, I love it!

idiom: a chip off the old block
meaning: someone whose character or personality resembles that of their parent
meaning_uz: xarakteri yoki xulq-atvori ota-onasinikiga o'xshash bo'lgan odam
usage: Mike's automotive repair skills really rival those of his father. He's a real chip off the old block!

meaning: to become involved in something unfair or dishonest
meaning_uz: adolatsiz yoki nohaq ish bilan shug'ullanishga
usage: He refused to dirty his hands by lying about what had happened.

meaning: in a troublesome or difficult situation
meaning_uz: muammoli yoki qiyin vaziyatda
usage: John has gotten himself into a pickle. He has two dates for the party.

meaning: a single payment made at a particular time, as opposed to a number of smaller payments or instalments
meaning_uz: muayyan vaqtda amalga oshirilgan yagona to'lov, bir necha kichik to'lovlar yoki bo'laklaridan farqli o'laroq
usage: Your pension plan can provide a cash lump sum at retirement as well as a regular income.

meaning: avoid or wish to avoid dealings or being associated with
meaning_uz: munosabatlardan qochish yoki ular bilan bog'liq bo'lishdan qochish yoki
usage: We have no truck with that style of gutter journalism.

meaning: to continue to have your beliefs or continue with a plan of action, even if other people disagree with you
meaning_uz: e'tiqodingizga ega bo'lishda davom etish yoki harakat rejasini davom ettirish, hatto boshqa odamlar siz bilan ixtilof
usage: Despite harsh criticism, she's sticking to her guns on this issue.

meaning: subject to intense criticism or judgment
meaning_uz: qattiq tanqid yoki hukmga duchor bo'lgan
usage: The company came under fire after allegations surfaced that the CEO had misappropriated funds.

meaning: continuing as planned or expected, typically after a problem or distraction
meaning_uz: rejalashtirilgan yoki kutilganidek davom ettirish, odatda muammo yoki chalg'itishdan so'ng
usage: The train schedule seems to be back on track after all those delays this morning.

meaning: to talk or complain about something many times
meaning_uz: biror narsa haqida ko'p marta gapirish yoki shikoyat qilish
usage: He's always harping on about lack of discipline.

meaning: to no longer have the ability to control someone or something, to lose certain skills or abilities
meaning_uz: endi birovni yoki biror narsani boshqarish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lmaslik, ma'lum ko'nikma va qobiliyatlarni yo'qotish
usage: He must be losing his grip on his followers if they're beginning to rebel against him.

meaning: to try very hard to do something
meaning_uz: biror ishni bajarish uchun juda ko'p harakat qilish
usage: I've been bending over backwards trying to help you, and this is all the thanks I get!

meaning: a dilemma or difficult circumstance from which there is no escape because of mutually conflicting or dependent conditions
meaning_uz: o'zaro ziddiyatli yoki bog'liq sharoitlar tufayli qochib qutulish bo'lmagan qiyinchilik yoki qiyin vaziyat
usage: But it is a catch-22 situation - you can't get people without funding, but you can't get funding without the people there in the first place.

meaning: a noisy expression of public anger or disapproval
meaning_uz: xalqning g'azabi yoki noroziligining shovqinli ifodasi
usage: There has been a great hue and cry about the council's plans to close the school.

meaning: one who acts for or does the bidding of someone much more powerful
meaning_uz: uchun harakat qiladigan yoki birovning buyrug'ini bajaradigan kishi ancha qudratli
usage: Don't blame the companies' PR representatives; they're just the organ grinders' monkeys, after all.

meaning: having a physique or structure that is strong and physically imposing
meaning_uz: kuchli va jismonan ta'sirchan bo'lgan fizik yoki tuzilishga ega bo'lish
usage: If you're going out in this snow, take my car, it's built like a tank!

meaning: an instantaneous attraction to someone or something
meaning_uz: birovga yoki biror narsaga bir zumda jalb qilish
usage: With that house, it was just love at first sight - I immediately knew it was perfect for me.

meaning: to treat someone poorly, dishonestly, or with flippant disregard
meaning_uz: birovga nisbatan yomon, nohaq yoki beparda munosabatda bo'lish
usage: After the team took such a resounding lead, they started playing ducks and drakes with their opponents toward the end of the game.

meaning: not informed about things that might be useful to know
meaning_uz: bilish foydali bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsalar haqida xabardor bo'lmaslik
usage: Our boss tends to keep us in the dark most of the time.

meaning: to make a serious effort to defeat someone, usually by criticizing or harming them in a cruel way
meaning_uz: birovni yengishga jiddiy harakat qilish, odatda ularni shafqatsiz tarzda tanqid qilish yoki zararsizlantirish orqali
usage: His colleague went straight for the jugular, telling him that his work was a complete disaster in front of the boss.

meaning: be prepared to face unanticipated events or situations
meaning_uz: kutilmagan hodisalar yoki holatlarga duch kelishga tayyor bo'ling
usage: Climbing a mountain has many dangers, so no matter how much you prepare, expect the unexpected.

meaning: to leave any post or position, to quit or resign
meaning_uz: har qanday lavozim yoki lavozimni tark etish, ishdan bo'shatish yoki iste'foga
usage: None of the editors liked the new policies, so they all jumped ship as soon as other jobs opened up.

meaning: to make the wrong choice or to ask the wrong person or to follow the wrong course
meaning_uz: noto'g'ri tanlov qilish yoki noto'g'ri odamdan so'rash yoki noto'g'ri yo'l tutish
usage: If you think I ate your food, you're barking up the wrong tree.

meaning: to encourage one to do something, especially in a positive, cheerful manner
meaning_uz: bir ishni qilishga undash, ayniqsa ijobiy, quvnoq
usage: I was getting disheartened writing my first novel, but my husband jollied me along to finish it.

meaning: to travel very fast, often used to describe driving
meaning_uz: juda tez sayohat qilish uchun, ko'pincha haydashni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladigan
usage: Have you seen my new sports car? Man, I can't wait to take it out and burn up the road!

meaning: a possession that is useless or troublesome, especially one that is expensive to maintain or difficult to dispose of
meaning_uz: foydasiz yoki tashvishli bo'lgan, ayniqsa saqlash qimmat yoki tashish qiyin bo'lgan egalik
usage: The house was nothing but a white elephant that needed weekly maintenance.

meaning: showing or experiencing a noticeable or conspicuous increase, improvement, or expansion
meaning_uz: sezilarli yoki ko'zga ko'ringan o'sish, yaxshilash yoki kengaytirishni ko'rsatish yoki boshdan kechirish
usage: The small country has been one of the few economies in the region to be on the upswing since the recession.

meaning: used to describe something that is vague, ambiguous or unclear
meaning_uz: noto'g'ri, noaniq yoki aniq bo'lmagan narsani tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi
usage: The film presents a straightforward choice between good and evil, with no shades of grey.

meaning: wouldn't even consider doing something in particular
meaning_uz: ayniqsa biror ish qilishni ham o'ylab ko'rmasdi
usage: I'm sure Mom didn't read that letter you got - she wouldn't dream of opening someone else's mail.

meaning: to politely disagree with someone else
meaning_uz: muloyimlik bilan boshqa birov bilan ixtilof qilish
usage: He thinks that the evening was a disaster, but I beg to differ - I saw plenty of guests enjoying themselves!

meaning: the real and practical experiences of life, especially those involving hardship or adversity
meaning_uz: hayotning real va amaliy tajribalari, ayniqsa, qiyinchilik yoki musibat bilan bog'liq bo'lgan
usage: The problem with you is that you've been spoiled your whole life. You haven't had any hard knocks to teach you what the world is really like!

meaning: speaking or writing in an ironic or insincere way
meaning_uz: so'zlash yoki yozishni ironik yoki samimiy tarzda
usage: Because Larry was drunk, he responded to the police officer's questions with tongue in cheek answers, which landed him in further trouble.

meaning: be very happy
meaning_uz: juda baxtli bo'ling
usage: He was on cloud nine although he barely passed the exam!

meaning: be clumsy or awkward in one's actions
meaning_uz: Qoʻpol, undan soʻng uning taʼbiri shulki, u oʻzidan oʻta uydirmachi va oʻta gunohkor boʻladi.
usage: I'm all fingers and thumbs today. That's the second plate I've dropped this morning.

meaning: to think that one is very important in a way that annoys other people
meaning_uz: biri boshqa odamlarni g'azablantiradigan tarzda juda muhim deb hisoblash
usage: I doubt he even thought about what you might need, he's so full of himself.

meaning: from one place to a series of other places
meaning_uz: bir joydan boshqa bir qator joylarga
usage: My father was in the army, and we moved from pillar to post year after year.

meaning: to be regarded favorably by another person
meaning_uz: boshqa shaxs tomonidan yaxshi ko'rilishi
usage: If you want to be in the teacher's good books, try to participate more in class.

meaning: deceive someone playfully, tease someone
meaning_uz: birovni o'ychan aldab, kimgadir mazax
usage: I love pulling my sister's leg - it's almost too easy to annoy her.

meaning: refers to something that is already overdue and must be done immediately
meaning_uz: allaqachon o'tib ketgan va darhol amalga oshirilishi kerak bo'lgan narsani anglatadi
usage: It's high time you got that bad knee looked at by a doctor.

meaning: to learn how to do a job or activity
meaning_uz: ishni yoki faoliyatni o'rganishga
usage: The three new members of our project team will have to learn the ropes as soon as possible to deliver the project on time.

meaning: to feel a strong emotion and struggle to speak because of it
meaning_uz: tufayli kuchli hissiyotni his etish va gapirishga qiynalish
usage: I thought I would be able to give the eulogy, but I became so choked up that I couldn't do it.

idiom: your heart goes out to someone
meaning: to feel sympathy for someone
meaning_uz: birovga hamdardlik bildirish
usage: My heart goes out to Carla, with a sick husband and three kids to look after.

meaning: to entertain someone with food and drink, especially expensive food and drink
meaning_uz: oziq-ovqat va ichimlik bilan birovni ko'ngil ochish uchun, ayniqsa qimmat oziq-ovqat va ichimlik
usage: They wine and dine clients in festive tents, promoting their image of achievement and success.

meaning: look for or discover a meaning that is implied rather than explicitly stated
meaning_uz: aniq ko'rsatilgandan ko'ra ma'noni qidirish yoki kashf qilish
usage: The report does not criticize the research directly, but you can read between the lines that the review committee was not impressed.

idiom: in no way, shape, or form
meaning: in no possible manner; under no circumstances; not by any means
meaning_uz: mumkin bo'lmagan tarzda; hech qanday vaziyatda; hech qanday yo'l bilan emas
usage: In no way, shape, or form is this kind of behavior acceptable!

meaning: a phrase used to emphasize how easily or quickly something can be done
meaning_uz: biror ishni qanchalik oson yoki tez bajarish mumkinligini ta'kidlash uchun ishlatiladigan ibora
usage: All you have to do is combine all of the ingredients in one pot, let it cook, and then Bob's your uncle, dinner is ready!

meaning: to fall out of favor, typically due to having done something that tarnishes one's reputation
meaning_uz: favqulodda bo'lish uchun, odatda, obro'sini buzadigan biron bir ishni qilganligi sababli
usage: That actor had a catastrophic fall from grace after his very public racially - charged tirade.

meaning: without being included on official records
meaning_uz: rasmiy yozuvlarga kiritilmagan holda
usage: The government kept the operation off the books, which raised a lot of suspicion.

meaning: in close, often secretive or conspiratorial cooperation with someone
meaning_uz: yaqin, ko'pincha kim bilandir maxfiy yoki fitnachi hamkorlikda
usage: It turned out that the business tycoon was in cahoots with local law enforcement to have the investigation dropped.

meaning: to do the same thing
meaning_uz: aynan shu ishni qilish uchun
usage: When one airline reduces its ticket prices, the rest usually follow suit.

meaning: speak plainly without avoiding unpleasant or embarrassing issues
meaning_uz: yoqimsiz yoki uyatli masalalardan qochmasdan ochiq-oydin gapirish
usage: It is time to name the people involved and call a spade a spade.

meaning: someone who tries to help people in trouble or need
meaning_uz: qiyinchilikka duchor bo'lgan yoki muhtoj odamlarga yordam berishga harakat qiladigan odam
usage: The beggar was lying shivering on the road when a good Samaritan came along and gave him a blanket and some warm clothes.

meaning: no longer operating as a commercial business, typically because there is not enough commercial activity to cover costs and make a profit
meaning_uz: endi tijorat biznesi sifatida faoliyat yuritmaydi, odatda xarajatlarni qoplash va foyda olish uchun tijorat faoliyati etarli bo'lmagani uchun
usage: These massive retail chains have put a lot of smaller companies out of business.

meaning: because of luck and not because of skill or organization
meaning_uz: mahorat yoki tashkilot tufayli emas, balki omad tufayli
usage: I became an interpreter more by accident than design, since nobody else could speak the language of the refugees.

meaning: abandon a struggle, admit defeat
meaning_uz: kurashdan voz keching, mag'lubiyatni tan oling
usage: There are times when the difficulties appear too great and we just throw in the towel.

meaning: in chaos, here and there
meaning_uz: tartibsizlikda, bu erda va u erda
usage: People were screaming and running helter-skelter down the steps to escape the flames.

meaning: arrogantly or inconsiderately overbearing
meaning_uz: Kibr yoki bema'nilik bilan haddan tashqari
usage: The new boss is unbearably high-handed in dealing with employees.

meaning: to become difficult to control
meaning_uz: nazorat qilish qiyin bo'lib qolishi
usage: It was the end of term and the children were getting a little out of hand.

meaning: to end one's association with someone or something
meaning_uz: birovning birov yoki biror narsa bilan aloqasiga chek qo'yish uchun
usage: She couldn't wait to wash her hands of the whole project.

meaning: to annoy or anger one
meaning_uz: bir g'azab yoki g'azabga to'g'adir
usage: That guy just gets my goat every time he opens his mouth.

meaning: to voice one's anger
meaning_uz: o'z g'azabini ovoza qilish uchun
usage: Jack vented his spleen at his wife whenever things went badly at work.

meaning: from the original or most reliable source
meaning_uz: asl yoki eng ishonchli manbadan
usage: "Is our test really getting rescheduled?" "Yep, our teacher was ahead of me in the lunch line, so I heard it straight from the horse's mouth."

idiom: the other side of the coin
meaning: the opposing view or opposite aspect of something
meaning_uz: biror narsaning qarama-qarshi ko'rinishi yoki qarama-qarshi
usage: I definitely support that legislation. On the other side of the coin, I can understand why people are concerned about it.

meaning: to comprehend something that one considers challenging, confusing, or a foreign concept
meaning_uz: qiyin, chalkash yoki chet el tushunchasi deb hisoblaydigan narsani tushunish uchun
usage: Kate is willing to pay full price for an expensive handbag, but I just can't wrap my head around that.

meaning: to wait patiently for a good opportunity to do something
meaning_uz: biror ishni amalga oshirish uchun yaxshi imkoniyatni sabr bilan kutishga
usage: He's just biding his time until a permanent job opens up.

meaning: the third time you try to do something, it will work
meaning_uz: uchinchi marta biror ish qilishga harakat qilsangiz, u ishlaydi
usage: The fellow finally managed to pass his exam. As they say, third time's a charm.

idiom: have the world by the tail
meaning: to be very successful, contented, and happy in life
meaning_uz: hayotda juda muvaffaqiyatli, mazmunli va baxtli bo'lishi
usage: Samantha landed her dream job after finishing at the top of her class in college. She has the world by the tail!

idiom: have the ball in one's court
meaning: used to convey it is time for someone to deal with a problem or make a decision, because other people have already done as much as they can
meaning_uz: birovning muammoni hal qilish yoki qaror qabul qilish vaqti kelganini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi, chunki boshqa odamlar allaqachon qo'ldan kelgancha harakat qilishgan
usage: I have helped him in every way I can, the ball is in his court now.

meaning: to say nothing or stop talking
meaning_uz: hech narsa demaslik yoki gapirishni to'xtatish uchun
usage: He didn't want to get into a fight, so he decided to button his lip.

meaning: a nap or a brief sleep
meaning_uz: uxlash yoki qisqa uyqu
usage: I'm going to go grab a quick forty winks before everyone starts arriving for the dinner party.

meaning: to not show your feelings when upset, show courage in the face of pain or adversity
meaning_uz: g'amgin bo'lganda his-tuyg'ularingizni ko'rsatmaslik, og'riq yoki musibat qarshisida jasorat ko'rsatish
usage: Even though he was only three years old, Jonathan kept a stiff upper lip the whole time he was in the hospital recovering from his surgery.

idiom: separate the wheat from the chaff
meaning: to separate things or people that are of high quality or ability from those that are not
meaning_uz: bo'lmagan narsalar yoki qobiliyat yuqori bo'lgan narsalarni yoki odamlarni ajratishga
usage: The first round of interviews really separates the wheat from the chaff.

meaning: to be very brave and calm at all times
meaning_uz: har doim juda jasur va sokin bo'lish
usage: You need to have nerves of steel to be a fighter pilot.

meaning: to try to win an advantage from a difficult situation or from someone else's problems
meaning_uz: qiyin vaziyatdan yoki o'zganing muammolaridan ustunlikni qo'lga kiritishga harakat qilish
usage: No one really thought about the money lenders who were making cash hand over fist during the recession, fishing in the troubled waters many homeowners and small businesses found themselves in.

meaning: to do something foolish that causes you harm
meaning_uz: sizga zarar keltiradigan ahmoqona ish qilish
usage: She dug her own grave when she made fun of the boss.

idiom: strike while the iron is hot
meaning: to act on an opportunity promptly while favorable conditions exist
meaning_uz: qulay sharoitlar mavjud bo'lganda zudlik bilan imkoniyatga amal qilish
usage: He doesn't often make such offers - I'd strike while the iron is hot if I were you.

meaning: to suddenly have to deal with a difficult situation because others have decided that they do not want the responsibility
meaning_uz: to'satdan qiyin vaziyatni bartaraf etishga to'g'ri keladi, chunki boshqalar mas'uliyatni istamaslik to'g'risidagi qarorni
usage: The other investors pulled out of the project and we were left holding the bag.

meaning: an allotment of money that is set aside for the future
meaning_uz: kelajak uchun ajratiladigan pul mablag'larini ajratma
usage: With the cost of living these days, it is difficult for young couples to build a nest egg and save for retirement.

meaning: a rude way of telling someone to leave
meaning_uz: birovga ketishni aytishning xo'r usuli
usage: Take a hike, Jerry! I'm sick of your foolishness.

meaning: the particular state, arrangement, or condition of something or the way a situation exists or has developed
meaning_uz: biror narsaning muayyan holati, tartibi yoki ahvoli yoki vaziyatning mavjud bo'lish yoki rivojlanish yo'li
usage: Given the turbulent nature of this market, I think it would be prudent to understand the lay of the land before we agree to invest.

meaning: to do what someone else wants or has requested, to the point of servitude
