meaning_uz: boshqa birov istagan yoki so'ragan ishni qilish, qullik nuqtasigacha
usage: I hate how my mother always wants me to do her bidding - I refuse to do what she wants any longer!

meaning: to give permission for something to happen
meaning_uz: biror narsa sodir bo'lishiga ruxsat berish uchun
usage: If we can't do this movie for $5 million, the studio is not going to green-light it.

meaning: not traceable through any means of commerce or communication that could be linked to one's identity
meaning_uz: o'z shaxsi bilan bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan savdo yoki muloqot vositasi orqali izlanmaydi
usage: Fearing for his life, the whistle-blower from the intelligence agency was forced to live off the grid for a number of years, eschewing anything that might leave a digital footprint for someone to find.

idiom: square peg in a round hole
meaning: a person who does not fit in or is not comfortable with others or in a particular situation, someone who is unsuited to a certain task, position, situation, or group of people
meaning_uz: mos kelmaydigan yoki o'zgalar bilan yoki muayyan vaziyatda rohatlanmaydigan, ma'lum bir vazifaga, lavozimga, vaziyatga yoki odamlar guruhiga yaroqsiz bo'lgan shaxs
usage: John was a bit of a square peg in a round hole throughout high school, but when he went to college he found all sorts of people he could relate to.

meaning: in prison
meaning_uz: qamoqda
usage: He's spent most of his life behind bars.

idiom: make a song and dance about something
meaning: to make something seem more important than it really is so that everyone notices it
meaning_uz: biror narsani haqiqatdan ham muhimroq qilib ko'rsatish uchun, uni hamma sezib
usage: I only asked her to move her car but she made such a song and dance about it.

meaning: to talk endlessly and exhaustingly
meaning_uz: cheksiz va holdan toygan holda gaplashish uchun
usage: I love my Aunt Lily, but she talks her head off whenever I go to visit her.

meaning: saved or spared from difficulty or misfortune by some intervention at the very last moment
meaning_uz: qutqarilgan yoki qiyinchilik yoki baxtsizlikdan saqlanib qolgan bo'lib, so'nggi paytda ba'zi aralashuvlar natijasida
usage: The teacher was just getting ready to hand out the quizzes when the fire alarm went off - saved by the bell!

meaning: to enjoy yourself very much
meaning_uz: o'zingizdan juda zavq olishga
usage: The kids really had a ball at the birthday party - they won't stop talking about it!

meaning: to use your authority to stop something happening
meaning_uz: biron bir voqeani to'xtatish uchun o'z vakolatingizdan foydalanish
usage: When Monica wanted to spend all the savings on their wedding, Chandler had to put his foot down.

idiom: the grass is always greener on the other side
meaning: other people's circumstances or belongings always seem more desirable than one's own
meaning_uz: boshqa odamlarning vaziyati yoki buyumlari har doim o'zidan ko'ra arzigulik ko'rinadi
usage: The grass is always greener on the other side - the sooner you realize that and stop comparing your life to others', the happier you'll be!

meaning: extremely clean or clear, free of incriminating evidence
meaning_uz: nihoyatda toza yoki aniq, ayblovchi dalillardan xoli
usage: The cops raided the warehouse but the place was clean as a whistle.

meaning: to be extremely happy
meaning_uz: nihoyatda baxtli bo'lishi
usage: Since they got married, they've been in seventh heaven.

meaning: contrary to what one feels to be wise or sensible
meaning_uz: dono yoki aqlli deb bilgan narsaga zid
usage: He persuaded me against my better judgement to join him.

meaning: something that cannot be separated from a condition or activity
meaning_uz: shart yoki faoliyatdan ajralmas biror narsa
usage: Being recognized on the street is part and parcel of being a celebrity.

meaning: something that is very easy to accomplish
meaning_uz: amalga oshirish juda oson bo'lgan narsa
usage: It's clear that the role is a walk in the park for the veteran actor.

meaning: to tell a lie or only part of the truth in order to convince one of something or to avoid the consequences of something
meaning_uz: biror narsadan birini ishontirish yoki biror narsaning oqibatlaridan qochish maqsadida yolg'on yoki haqiqatning faqat bir qismini aytishga
usage: I suspect he's just spinning a story about where all that money came from.

meaning: someone or something that disappoints or does not meet expectations
meaning_uz: kimdir yoki umidlarni ranjitadigan yoki qondirmaydigan narsa
usage: The film got a lot of hype, but I thought it was a bit of a damp squib.

meaning: a person giving firm but benevolent advice
meaning_uz: Qat'iy, ammo xayrixoh maslahat beruvchi shaxs
usage: He acts more like a Dutch uncle than a husband, always telling her what to do in public.

meaning: to be in difficult situation in which you are in danger of being criticized or punished
meaning_uz: sizni tanqid qilish yoki jazolash xavfi ostida bo'lgan qiyin vaziyatda bo'lish
usage: He found himself in hot water over his comments about immigration.

meaning: to satisfy or fulfill everything that is necessary or desired
meaning_uz: zarur bo'lgan yoki istalgan barcha narsani qondirish yoki bajarish uchun
usage: His newest thriller ticks all the boxes the author's fans will be hoping for.

meaning: to engage in futile tasks
meaning_uz: behuda vazifalar bilan shug'ullanishga
usage: Oh, Ted's still boiling the ocean trying to find and reassemble that document from the shredded bin.

idiom: high man on the totem pole
meaning: the person (not necessarily a man) with the most experience, authority, and/or influence in a social or corporate hierarchy
meaning_uz: ijtimoiy yoki xo'jalik faoliyatida eng ko'p tajribaga, mansabga va/yoki ta'sirga ega bo'lgan shaxs (erkak ham emas)
usage: Oh, just boss those freshmen around - now that we're seniors, we're the high men on the totem pole!

meaning: to utilize a difficult situation in the best possible way
meaning_uz: qiyin vaziyatni eng yaxshi usulda utkazishga
usage: It was a long journey from Delhi to Australia, so he made a virtue of necessity and wrote down some articles.

meaning: to hide something damaging or unpleasant and try to keep it secret
meaning_uz: zarar yetkazuvchi yoki yoqimsiz narsani yashirib, sir tutishga harakat qilish
usage: This scandal can't be swept under the rug.

meaning: to have a good chance or high probability of doing or accomplishing something
meaning_uz: yaxshi imkoniyat yoki biror ishni amalga oshirish yoki amalga oshirish ehtimoli yuqori bo'lishi
usage: If the team maintains this level of success, they'll be in with a chance of winning the championship.

meaning: as full as it can be, to the very top
meaning_uz: boricha to'la, eng yuqori pog'onasiga
usage: You should have seen this old book store. There were books stacked to the gunwales!

meaning: a small problem or weakness in a person or system that can result in failure
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatsizlikka olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan odam yoki tizimdagi kichik muammo yoki zaiflik
usage: Maths has always been my Achilles heel.

idiom: Cross a bridge before one comes to it
meaning: worry about the future in advance
meaning_uz: kelajak haqida oldindan qayg'urish
usage: He was worried about his life after college, but then decided he will cross that bridge once he comes it.

meaning: everything you can possibly want, have, or do in a particular situation
meaning_uz: muayyan vaziyatda xohlashingiz, ega bo'lishingiz yoki qila oladigan hamma narsa
usage: The weather was terrible but I wanted to go the whole nine yards and get to the top of the mountain.

meaning: to ask for too much
meaning_uz: juda ko'p narsani so'rash uchun
usage: There's no point hoping for a permanent peace in the area. It's like asking for the moon.

meaning: extremely happy
meaning_uz: nihoyatda baxtli
usage: She was feeling on top of the world.

meaning: at, in, or amidst the central or focal point of something
meaning_uz: biror narsaning markaziy yoki markaz nuqtasida, ichida yoki orasida
usage: The social advocate found herself in the eye of the debate regarding abortion law.

meaning: to carefully think about everything you are going to say before you say it
meaning_uz: aytishdan oldin aytadigan har bir gapingizni diqqat bilan o'ylab
usage: He gave his statement to the court, weighing each word as he spoke.

meaning: an experience in which one almost dies
meaning_uz: biri deyarli o'ladigan tajriba
usage: I value my life a lot more since my brush with death in the accident.

meaning: to reduce or damage one's ego or pride, to humble or humiliate one
meaning_uz: o'z egosini yoki g'ururini kamaytirish yoki zararsizlantirish, kamtarona yoki kamsitish
usage: It's about time that someone took Sarah down a notch. Her arrogance is simply intolerable!

meaning: impractical and foolishly idealistic
meaning_uz: amaliy emas va ahmoqona idealistik
usage: She's talking about buying an old castle in Ireland. It all sounds a bit airy-fairy to me.

meaning: to start to use one's talents or abilities, or to start to experience new things for the first time
meaning_uz: o'z iste'dodini yoki qobiliyatlarini qo'llay boshlashi yoki birinchi marta yangi narsalarni boshdan kechira boshlashi
usage: Now that I'm finished school, I feel like I really want to spread my swings and see what's out there for me.

meaning: to provide someone with an excuse or a means of escaping from something
meaning_uz: birovga bahona yoki biror narsadan qochib qutulish vositasi bilan ta'minlash
usage: They left a clause in the contract that would give them an out in case the deal went sour.

meaning: an unnoticed observer of a particular situation
meaning_uz: muayyan vaziyatning e'tibordan chetda qolgan kuzatuvchisi
usage: I'd love to be a fly on the wall when those two get home and see each other after so long.

meaning: someone who ruins other people's fun
meaning_uz: boshqa odamlarning ko'ngilxushliklarini buzadigan odam
usage: David was tired of being called a wet blanket by his friends just because he doesn't drink alcohol.

meaning: under all circumstances, no matter how difficult
meaning_uz: qanchalik qiyin bo'lmasin, har qanday vaziyatda
usage: They promised to stick together through thick and thin.

meaning: an agreement, bargain, or deal in which a person sacrifices or abandons moral, ethical, or spiritual values in favor of wealth, power, or other benefits
meaning_uz: inson ma'naviy-axloqiy yoki ma'naviy qadriyatlarni boylik, hokimiyat yoki boshqa manfaatlar foydasiga qurbon qiladigan yoki undan voz kechadigan bitim, sarmoya yoki bitim
usage: She struck a Faustian bargain with the competitors, selling her own company's secrets for shares in each of their companies.

idiom: a penny saved is a penny earned
meaning: something you say that means it is wise to save money
meaning_uz: siz aytgan narsa, demak, pulni tejash oqilona
usage: I'd advise anyone to put aside a proportion of their earnings - a penny saved is a penny earned.

meaning: to think angry thoughts without verbalizing them
meaning_uz: g'azablangan fikrlarni og'zaki aytmasdan fikrlashga
usage: Bill knew he couldn't talk back to Mrs. Miller, so instead he yelled silently in his head as she reprimanded him.

meaning: sleeping very soundly, drunk
meaning_uz: juda to'g'ri uxlab, mast
usage: Do you remember last night at the bar at all? You were dead to the world!

meaning: have an interest in something
meaning_uz: biror narsaga qiziqish bildiring
usage: When they nominated me for the board, I'm sure Bill had a finger in the pie.

meaning: a final adjustment of something, some effort or action that completes something
meaning_uz: biror narsaning yakuniy o'zgartirilishi, biror narsani tugatuvchi qandaydir harakat yoki harakat
usage: Norm is in his workshop putting the finishing touches on his latest project.

meaning: spoken communication as a means of transmitting information
meaning_uz: axborotni uzatish vositasi sifatida so'zlangan muloqot
usage: We get most of our work through word of mouth recommendations from our existing clients.

meaning: either commit to doing something productive or step aside and stop wasting time
meaning_uz: ya'ni samarali ish qilishga ahd qiling yoki chetga chiqib, vaqtni behuda o'tkazishni to'xtating
usage: Are you going to go back to medical school or not? It's time to fish or cut bait.

meaning: to talk with others in a way that promotes or maintains conflict or opposition
meaning_uz: boshqalar bilan nizo yoki qarshilikni targ'ib qilish yoki saqlab qolish yo'li bilan suhbatlashish
usage: You will never find success if you continue to talk at cross purposes with your teammates.

meaning: vulnerable
meaning_uz: ojiz
usage: She's between wind and water, living in this terrible neighborhood. I hope she moves soon, for her own safety.

meaning: lose impetus or enthusiasm
meaning_uz: turtki yoki g'ayratni yo'qotish
usage: A rebellion that had run out of steam.

meaning: to suffer unpleasant results of an action, so you do not want to do the same thing again
meaning_uz: harakatning yoqimsiz natijalariga duchor bo'lish, shuning uchun siz yana bir xil ishni qilishni istamaysiz
usage: She'd invested extensively in stocks and got her fingers burned when the market collapsed.

meaning: to stop something before it has an opportunity to become established
meaning_uz: tashkil etish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lmasdan turib biror narsani to'xtatishga
usage: Many serious illnesses can be nipped in the bud if they are detected early enough.

meaning: an abundance or excessive amount of boisterous, youthful energy, enthusiasm, or vitality
meaning_uz: shovqinli, yoshlikdagi kuch-g'ayrat, jo'shqinlik yoki hayotiylikning ko'pligi yoki haddan tashqari ko'pligi
usage: Nothing like a swim in the brisk Atlantic ocean to fill you with vim and vigor first thing in the morning.

meaning: cowardly
meaning_uz: qo'rqoq
usage: I'm not surprised that Tom didn't come to the rally - he's too yellow-bellied to defend his beliefs in public.

meaning: an important, successful, or influential person
meaning_uz: muhim, muvaffaqiyatli yoki ta'sirchan shaxs
usage: Meeting a big fish like the company's CEO can be quite an intimidating experience for an intern.

meaning: a situation in which something increases in size or importance at a faster and faster rate
meaning_uz: biror narsaning hajmi yoki ahamiyatini tezroq va tez sur'atlarda oshiradigan holat
usage: The more successful you become, the more publicity you get and that publicity generates sales. It's a kind of snowball effect.

meaning: a modern story of obscure origin and with little or no supporting evidence
meaning_uz: g'ayrioddiy kelib chiqishi va qo'llab-quvvatlovchi dalillar kam yoki hech qanday bo'lmagan zamonaviy hikoya
usage: Are there alligators living in the New York City sewer system, or is that just an urban legend?

meaning: to become doubted, scrutinized, or a matter of serious discussion
meaning_uz: shubhalanish, tekshirish yoki jiddiy muhokama qilish masalasiga
usage: This reluctance to act has caused your leadership skills to come into question.

meaning: to die while still actively working or still of the age or physical condition to do so
meaning_uz: qilish uchun hali faol ishlayotganda yoki hali yosh yoki jismoniy holatda bo'lgan vaqtda o'limga
usage: With medicine and healthcare improving at such vast rates, far fewer people die in harness than ever before.

meaning: to become completely involved in something
meaning_uz: narsa bilan butunlay shug'ullanishga
usage: It was a story you could really sink your teeth into.

meaning: to be well-received, as by a group or audience
meaning_uz: guruh yoki auditoriya tomonidan bo'lgani kabi yaxshi qabul qilinishi
usage: Three standing ovations! Wow, your performance really went down well!

idiom: take the bull by the horns
meaning: to approach, confront, or deal with a problem or difficult situation directly and with clear, confident action
meaning_uz: muammo yoki qiyin vaziyatga bevosita va aniq, ishonchli harakat bilan yondashish, to'qnash kelish yoki bartaraf etish
usage: I took the bull by the horns and confronted my manager about the blatant sexism in the office.

meaning: a fundamental flaw or weakness in a person otherwise revered
meaning_uz: aks holda hurmatga sazovor bo'lgan odamda asosiy nuqson yoki zaiflik
usage: Some of the greatest geniuses in history had feet of clay.

meaning: to depend on someone or expect something
meaning_uz: birovga bog'liq bo'lish yoki biror narsani kutish
usage: You can always count on Michael in a crisis.

meaning: to be in the same situation, having the same problem
meaning_uz: bir xil vaziyatda bo'lishi, aynan shu muammoga duch
usage: She's always complaining that she doesn't have enough money. She has to realize that we are all in the same boat.

meaning: be in full agreement
meaning_uz: to'liq kelishuvda bo'ling
usage: The boss and I do not always see eye to eye, which often creates problems.

meaning: to seem interesting or pleasing to oneself
meaning_uz: qiziqarli yoki o'ziga ma'qul ko'rinishga
usage: She has enough money to buy anything that strikes her fancy.

meaning: the ordinary members of an organization as opposed to its leaders
meaning_uz: rahbarlariga qaraganda tashkilotning oddiy a'zolarini
usage: The party's rank and file are beginning to question the prime minister's choice of advisers.

idiom: every cloud has a silver lining
meaning: every negative occurrence has a positive aspect to it
meaning_uz: har bir nojo'ya hodisa unga salbiy
usage: Though he had failed his exam, he realized that every cloud has a silver lining, as now he could focus his attention on things he loved doing.

meaning: attracting special attention because of unusual and flamboyant appearance or behaviour
meaning_uz: g'ayritabiiy va olovli ko'rinish yoki xatti-harakatlar tufayli alohida e'tiborni jalb qilish
usage: He was a larger than life character on and off the pitch.

meaning: to be what someone likes or is interested in
meaning_uz: kimgadir yoqadigan yoki qiziqqan narsa bo'lishi
usage: Motor racing doesn't really float my boat.

meaning: the outcome or rewards of one's work or efforts
meaning_uz: birovning ishi yoki harakatlarining natijasi yoki mukofotlari
usage: You worked hard this semester, and straight A's are the fruits of your labor.

meaning: an unwelcome intruder in a place or situation
meaning_uz: joy yoki vaziyatda xush ko'rmaydigan bosqinchi
usage: For Peter, his new father was a cuckoo in the nest.

meaning: under another's authoritarian control, continually forced to submit to another's will
meaning_uz: boshqasining avtoritar nazorati ostida, doimo boshqasining irodasiga bo'ysunishga majbur
usage: Although the job paid well, I couldn't stand the way I was under the boss's thumb.

meaning: to try very hard not to upset someone or something
meaning_uz: birovni yoki biror narsani g'azablantirmaslik uchun juda ko'p harakat qilish
usage: When my mother is staying at our house, I feel like I am walking on eggshells.

idiom: take a leaf out of someone's book
meaning: to copy something that someone else does because it will bring you advantages
meaning_uz: boshqa birov qiladigan narsadan nusxa ko'chirish, chunki bu sizga afzalliklarni keltirib chiqaradi
usage: Maybe I should take a leaf out of Rick's book and start coming in early every morning.

meaning: unhappy
meaning_uz: baxtsiz
usage: She's down in the dumps because all her friends are out of town.

idiom: at the end of the day
meaning: when everything is taken into consideration
meaning_uz: hamma narsa e'tiborga olinganda
usage: At the end of the day I'm responsible for what happens in the school.

meaning: try to win favor through flattery
meaning_uz: xushomad orqali favqulodda g'alaba qozonishga harakat qiling
usage: It may help your standing with the boss if you polish the apple.

meaning: a person whose own words or actions negatively impacts an entire group of people
meaning_uz: o'z so'zlari yoki xatti-harakatlari butun bir guruh kishilarga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatuvchi shaxs
usage: Before you accuse the entire department of wrongdoing, you should try to find the rotten apple that initially caused the problem.

meaning: in control, in charge
meaning_uz: boshqaruvda, mas'ul
usage: She is the first woman to be at the helm of this corporation.

meaning: to have so much work that you have problems dealing with it all
meaning_uz: shunchalik ko'p ish bo'lishi kerakki, hammasi bilan shug'ullanishda muammolarga duch
usage: I'm absolutely snowed under with work at the moment, so I'll catch up with you later.

meaning: to prosper or otherwise live very well
meaning_uz: ravnaq topish yoki aksincha, juda yaxshi yashash uchun
usage: They've been living high on the hog ever since David won the lottery.

meaning: a decision has not been reached on someone or something
meaning_uz: birov yoki biror narsa bo'yicha qarorga kelinmagan
usage: The jury's still out on the safety of irradiated food.

meaning: someone or something that is very easy for an enemy to shoot or attack
meaning_uz: dushman uchun o'q otish yoki hujum qilish juda oson bo'lgan kimsa yoki biror narsa
usage: With their bullets all gone, the soldiers were sitting ducks for the enemy.

meaning: a time very early in the morning, daybreak
meaning_uz: bir vaqt juda erta tongda, tong otishi
usage: I've been up since the crack of dawn, working on the assignment.

meaning: to be directly involved in or affected by something, especially financially
meaning_uz: biror narsa bilan bevosita shug'ullanishi yoki ta'sir etishi, ayniqsa, moliyaviy
usage: A debate has been rumbling over how to ensure that lenders have more skin in the game.

meaning: in agreement, thinking in a similar way
meaning_uz: kelishilgan holda, shunga o'xshash tarzda fikrlash
usage: Let us discuss this internally first so that we are on the same page before we speak to the customer.

meaning: an achievement to be proud of
meaning_uz: faxrlanishga erishiladigan yutuq
usage: It's a real feather in our cap to be playing in the state championship.

idiom: don't give up the day job
meaning: used for telling someone that you do not think they are very good at something
meaning_uz: birovga biror narsada o'zlarini juda yaxshi deb o'ylamasligingizni aytish uchun ishlatiladi
usage: Whenever I see a singer who can't stay in tune, I just want to say, "Don't give up your day job!"

meaning: quiet people have interesting, profound, or complex thoughts
meaning_uz: sokin odamlar qiziqarli, chuqur yoki murakkab fikrlarga ega
usage: No, Sarah is actually one of the smartest people in the company. She may not talk or socialize much, but still waters run deep.

meaning: to be fully understood by or strongly affect or resonate with someone
meaning_uz: tomonidan to'liq tushunilishi yoki biror kishi bilan kuchli ta'sir ko'rsata olish yoki rezonans
usage: It wasn't until he was threatened with losing his job that the comments about John's work ethic really hit home.

meaning: to allow for an expanding number of typically negative consequences as the result of another related action
meaning_uz: bilan bog'liq boshqa harakat natijasida odatda nojo'ya oqibatlarning kengayib borayotgan soniga yo'l qo'yish
usage: The court's decision could open the floodgates for many similar cases.

meaning: a person's occupation or position within society
meaning_uz: shaxsning jamiyat ichidagi kasbi yoki mavqei
usage: As a social worker, I interact with all walks of life every day.

meaning: to be emptied or devoid of money, food, resources, etc
meaning_uz: bo'shatilishi yoki puldan mahrum bo'lishi, oziq-ovqat, resurslar va boshqalar
usage: I wish I could offer you some food to go with your tea, but I'm afraid we're cleaned out.

meaning: busy and frenetic activity or excitement
meaning_uz: band va g'azabli faoliyat yoki hayajon
usage: I avoid the hustle and bustle of malls and shopping centers whenever I can.

meaning: to be upset or overwhelmed, especially suddenly or unexpectedly
meaning_uz: g'amgin yoki g'amgin bo'lishi, ayniqsa, birdaniga yoki kutilmaganda
usage: It really hit me for six to find that my father had written about me in his book.

meaning: imposed or expected as an obligation, duty, or requirement on someone
meaning_uz: birovga majburiyat, burch yoki talab sifatida qo'yilgan yoki kutilayotgan
usage: As the wealthier citizens of the country, it's my firm belief that it is incumbent upon us to contribute toward the welfare of those who are less fortunate.

meaning: involving or characterized by mystery, intrigue, or espionage
meaning_uz: bilan bog'liq yoki sir, intriga yoki josuslik bilan xarakterlanadigan
usage: I'm tired of all these cloak and dagger meetings - let's discuss the issues openly.

meaning: in many different places or to many different people all at once
meaning_uz: ko'plab turli joylarda yoki ko'plab turli odamlarga birdaniga
usage: Ever since the company started, we've had financial issues left, right, and centre.

meaning: almost everything that one can think of
meaning_uz: deb o'ylash mumkin bo'lgan deyarli hamma narsa
usage: When he moved out of the house, he took along everything but the kitchen sink.

meaning: to have a dominant position or an unfair advantage
meaning_uz: hukmron mavqega yoki adolatsiz ustunlikka ega bo'lishi
usage: She wanted an upper hand in the business and hence went ahead to buy all the shares that she could find in the market.

meaning: in or into one's protective care
meaning_uz: o'z himoyasida yoki himoyaga kirishda
usage: Simon's uncle had taken him under his wing.

meaning: someone who insists on possessing something they do not want or need out of spite to prevent someone else from having it
meaning_uz: boshqa birovning ega bo'lishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik uchun g'azabdan o'zlari xohlamagan yoki kerak bo'lmagan narsaga ega bo'lishni ta'kidlaydigan odam
usage: The toddler, like a dog in the manger, refused to give her older sister the notebook she needed to complete her school assignment.

meaning: incidentally, on a side note
meaning_uz: tasodifiy, yon daftarda
usage: By the way, I remembered where I left my keys, in case you were wondering.

meaning: to get an advantage over someone/something by acting before they do
meaning_uz: qilishdan oldin harakat qilib, birovdan / narsadan ustunlik olish uchun
usage: Our rival company managed to steal a march on us by bringing out their software ahead of ours.

meaning: used to say that it is more effective to give a small amount of detail, information, etc. than a large amount
meaning_uz: ko'p miqdordan ko'ra ozroq detal, ma'lumot va h.k. berish samaraliroq, deb aytish uchun ishlatiladi
usage: When it comes to Web design, less is more.

idiom: a picture is worth a thousand words
meaning: a picture conveys information more effectively than words
meaning_uz: rasm axborotni so'zlardan ko'ra samaraliroq ifodalaydi
usage: It is easier to learn how a machine works from pictures rather than descriptions, since a picture is worth a thousand words.

meaning: to become very angry
meaning_uz: juda g'azablanish uchun
usage: When he told her how much it cost, she blew a gasket.

meaning: to reserve something, especially money, for use in a time or period of unforeseen difficulty, trouble, or need
meaning_uz: biror narsani, ayniqsa, pulni oldindan ko'zda tutilmagan qiyinchilik, qiyinchilik yoki ehtiyojlar davrida foydalanish uchun rezerv
usage: I know you want to buy a new TV with your bonus, but you should really save that money for a rainy day.

meaning: an expression indicating that one is skipping extraneous or unnecessary details and getting to the point
meaning_uz: birining ekstraneous yoki keraksiz tafsilotlarni chetlab o'tib, nuqtaga yetib borayotganini ko'rsatuvchi ifoda
usage: Anyway, long story short, I got expelled for writing graffiti on bathroom stalls.

meaning: a bad situation or habit that, after it has started, is likely to get very much worse
meaning_uz: boshlanganidan keyin juda yomonlashishi ehtimoli bo'lgan yomon holat yoki odat
usage: You're on a slippery slope once you start lying about your age!

meaning: in a state of senility or mental decline due to old age
meaning_uz: keksalik tufayli sezuvchanlik yoki aqliy pasayish holatida
usage: My grandfather in his dotage has lately had trouble remembering our names.

meaning: to bother or irritate someone
meaning_uz: birovni bezovta qilish yoki g'azablantirish uchun
usage: I know he is bothersome, but don't let him get under your skin.

meaning: a state of sweating induced by fear, anxiety, or illness
meaning_uz: qo'rquv, tashvish yoki kasallikdan kelib chiqqan terlash holati
usage: The very thought of exams brought her out in a cold sweat.

idiom: keep an ear to the ground
meaning: to listen for any indication of what is happening or will happen
meaning_uz: sodir bo'layotgan yoki bo'ladigan voqealarning har qanday ko'rsatkichini tinglashga
usage: I know Kim is keeping her ear to the ground in case word gets out about the promotion.

meaning: very straight, rigid, or inflexible
meaning_uz: juda to'g'ri, qattiq yoki moslashuvchan
usage: The whole class sat in their chairs as stiff as pokers during the principal's lecture.

meaning: to decide not to do something because you are too frightened
meaning_uz: juda qo'rqib ketganingiz uchun biror ish qilmaslik to'g'risida qaror qabul qilish
usage: I was going to go bungee jumping, but I chickened out.

meaning: very concerned or anxious about a person or situation
meaning_uz: inson yoki vaziyat haqida juda tashvishli yoki tashvishli
usage: The next time you're going to be this late getting home, please call me, because I was worried sick!

idiom: wrap one up in cotton wool
meaning: to be overprotective of one, to coddle one
meaning_uz: birining haddan tashqari himoyali bo'lishi, bitta kodlash uchun
usage: You need to let the little lad play in the dirt once in a while. If you keep wrapping him up in cotton wool, he'll grow up too soft.

meaning: a short distance
meaning_uz: qisqa masofa
usage: The lodge is within a stone's throw of the ski slopes.

meaning: to try to act as an ideal version of oneself, typically to try to impress others
meaning_uz: o'z-o'zidan ideal versiya vazifasini bajarishga harakat qilish, odatda, boshqalarni hayratga solishga harakat qilish
usage: You really need to put your best foot forward in the interview if you want to get this job.

idiom: Between the devil and the deep blue sea
meaning: to choose between two undesirable situations
meaning_uz: ikki yoqimsiz holat o'rtasida tanlov o'tkazish
usage: Trying to please both his boss and his wife puts him between the devil and the deep blue sea.

meaning: something that is too easy
meaning_uz: juda oson bo'lgan narsa
usage: Jane's a good mechanic. Changing a tire is like shooting fish in a barrel for her.

meaning: the person or people with the most authority, power, or influence in a group or organization
meaning_uz: guruh yoki tashkilotda eng ko'p vakolatga, kuchga yoki ta'sirga ega bo'lgan shaxs yoki
usage: You'll only get a truthful answer if you manage to talk to the top brass.

meaning: put in maximum effort to do something
meaning_uz: biror ishni bajarish uchun maksimal harakatga qo'ying
usage: We hardly have time left for the event. We have to put pedal to the metal and make sure all the arrangements are in place.

meaning: a strong, determined person who is not easily intimidated, discouraged, or defeated
meaning_uz: oson qo'rqmaydigan, tushkunlikka tushmaydigan va mag'lubiyatga uchramaydigan kuchli, qat'iy
usage: She had a difficult childhood, but it made her into a tough customer later in life.

meaning: to begin being serious about something, to begin attending to business or work at hand
meaning_uz: biror narsaga jiddiy yondasha boshlash, biznesga qatnashishni boshlash yoki qo'lda ishlash
usage: I believe that everyone is present for the board meeting, so let's get down to work, shall we?

meaning: to keep someone or something away or prevent something from happening or harming you
meaning_uz: birovni yoki biror narsani uzoqlashtirish yoki biror narsaning sodir bo'lishiga yoki sizga zarar yetkazishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik uchun
usage: He used his umbrella to ward off the fierce sun.

meaning: to look dismal and unhappy
meaning_uz: g'amgin va baxtsiz ko'rinishga
usage: She pulled a long face on being scolded by the teacher.

meaning: to become less guarded or vigilant; to stop being cautious about potential trouble or danger
meaning_uz: kam qo'riqlanadigan yoki hushyor bo'lish; mumkin bo'lgan qiyinchilik yoki xavf-xatardan ehtiyot bo'lishni to'xtatish uchun
usage: We'll wait long enough for them to let their guard down before we launch our invasion.

meaning: to be easy and without problems
meaning_uz: oson va muammosiz bo'lishi
usage: The roads were busy as we drove out of town, but after that it was plain sailing.

meaning: to do a lot of difficult things before you are allowed to have or do something you want
meaning_uz: ega bo'lish yoki o'zingiz xohlagan ishni bajarishga ruxsat berishdan oldin juda ko'p qiyin ishlarni amalga
usage: I had to jump through hoops to get you that job.

meaning: to be in a troublesome situation
meaning_uz: muammoli vaziyatda bo'lishi
usage: We're in a jam now because the hotel gave our room away!

meaning: rapid, by large movements forward
meaning_uz: tez, oldinga katta harakatlar bo'yicha
usage: The profits of my company are increasing by leaps and bounds.

meaning: at the beginning
meaning_uz: boshida
usage: I told him at the outset I wasn't interested, still he keeps pestering me.

meaning: things are or appear to be improving or becoming more hopeful
meaning_uz: narsalar yaxshilanayotgan yoki umidvorroq bo'lib borayotgandek ko'rinadi
usage: Things are looking up for families across the country as the economy continues to rebound.

meaning: to feel sad
meaning_uz: xafa bo'lish uchun
usage: I have been feeling blue lately, but I think it's just because of this gloomy weather we've been having.

meaning: an apparent misfortune that eventually has good results
meaning_uz: oxir-oqibat yaxshi natijalarga erishgan ko'zga ko'ringan baxtsizlik
usage: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise for him, for he found a better one.

meaning: noticeably superior to others within the same category
meaning_uz: bir xil toifadagi boshqalardan sezilarli darajada ustun
usage: With his vast experience and charming personality, it was clear to see that Gary was a cut above the rest of the candidates who interviewed for the sales position.

meaning: too close of a competition to identify a clear winner
meaning_uz: aniq g'olibni aniqlash uchun musobaqaga juda yaqin
usage: Right now the election is still too close to call.

meaning: rain very heavily
meaning_uz: yomg'ir juda kuchli
usage: It was raining cats and dogs, so all flights were cancelled.

meaning: be noticed by someone
meaning_uz: birov e'tiboriga
usage: I was looking around the store for a present for my mom, and this book caught my eye.

meaning: to compromise with someone, often in an argument or disagreement
meaning_uz: kim bilandir xulosa chiqarishga, ko'pincha tortishuv yoki kelishmovchilikda
usage: I'll agree to some of your requests if you'll meet me halfway and allow me to implement some of my ideas.

meaning: something that takes a lot of time and energy
meaning_uz: ko'p vaqt va kuch talab qiladigan narsa
usage: When given the choice, Peter told his boss that he wouldn't quit so soon. He's in it for the long haul.

idiom: Kill two birds with one stone
meaning: achieve two things with one action
meaning_uz: bir amal bilan ikki narsaga erishish
usage: He decided to return the books to the library while going to the bank, thus killing two birds with one stone.

meaning: one drink of liquor too many, implying drunkenness
meaning_uz: bir ichimlik ichimlik juda ko'p, bu mastlikni anglatadi
usage: Don't drive if you've had one too many.

meaning: to exceed what is required of one
meaning_uz: biridan talab qilinadigan narsadan oshib ketishini
usage: The fire-fighter received a medal for his action which went above and beyond duty.

meaning: a situation comprised of both crude or unpleasant things as well as those which are pleasing or beneficial, usually with the former in greater proportion to the latter
meaning_uz: qo'pol yoki yoqimsiz narsalardan, shuningdek, yoqimli yoki foydali bo'lgan narsalardan iborat bo'lgan vaziyat, odatda ikkinchisiga ko'proq mos ravishda birinchisi bilan
usage: The company's growth plan is little more than horse and rabbit stew, with a few good measures greatly outweighed by the planned expenditure.

meaning: not free/allowed to do something that one wants to
meaning_uz: bepul emas/yo'l qo'yilmaydi
usage: He wanted to raise their salaries, but his hands were tied by the upper management.

idiom: wash one's mouth out with soap
meaning: to punish one for using rude, vulgar, or obscene language by cleaning their mouth with soap, usually used merely as a threat
meaning_uz: odatda faqat tahdid sifatida ishlatiladigan sovun bilan og'zini tozalash orqali qo'pol, qo'pol yoki behayo tildan foydalanganlik uchun jazolash
usage: If you kids don't stop cussing in this house, I'm going to wash your mouths out with soap!

idiom: a wild goose never laid a tame egg
meaning: something will not be spontaneously different from that which came before, often used to describe things that are determined by nature and the environment, or else inherited from the generation before
meaning_uz: biror narsa o'z-o'zidan oldingidan farq qilmaydi, ko'pincha tabiat va atrof-muhit bilan belgilanadigan narsalarni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi yoki oldingi avloddan meros bo'lgan
usage: We must never presume that humanity will be without violence, after all, a wild goose never laid a tame egg.

meaning: feeling angry and upset
meaning_uz: g'azablangan va g'amgin his
usage: When Julia criticized his art, Geraldo left in a huff.

meaning: a person, group, or thing that is known for or limited to only one unique or noteworthy skill, talent, ability, quality, area of success, etc.
meaning_uz: faqat bitta o'ziga xos yoki diqqatga sazovor mahorat, iste'dod, qobiliyat, sifat, muvaffaqiyat sohasi va boshqalar bilan tanilgan yoki cheklangan shaxs, guruh yoki narsa
usage: The app developers took the world by storm with an incredibly addictive game for smartphones, but they've really been seen as just a one-trick pony ever since that breakthrough success.

meaning: make or lose a lot of money very quickly
meaning_uz: juda tez pul topish yoki yo'qotish
usage: Business was good and we were making money hand over fist.

meaning: go from poverty to wealth
meaning_uz: qashshoqlikdan boylikka o'tish
usage: She started by selling fast food on the street, but her recipe was so good that she quickly went from rags to riches and now she has her own restaurant.

meaning: to understand the central, essential, or general matter of something, such as an argument, speech, concept, process, etc., without being proficient in the more specific details
meaning_uz: biror narsaning markaziy, zaruriy yoki umumiy masalasini, masalan, argument, nutq, tushuncha, jarayon va boshqalarni aniqroq tafsilotlarga ega bo'lmasdan tushunish uchun
usage: A: "Did you understand what she was saying?" B: "My Japanese isn't great anymore, but I think I got the gist of it."

meaning: vigorously join in to help with a task or activity
meaning_uz: vazifa yoki faoliyatga yordam berish uchun jon kuydirish
usage: We must all pitch in and do our part.

meaning: the last in a series of unpleasant events that finally makes you feel that you cannot continue to accept a bad situation
meaning_uz: nihoyat yomon vaziyatni qabul qilishda davom eta olmasligingizni his qiladigan bir qator yoqimsiz voqealarning oxirgi
usage: Losing my job was bad enough, but being evicted was the final straw.

meaning: extremely thin
meaning_uz: juda nozik
usage: Your brother is just skin and bones - has he been sick?

meaning: to explain something in a very clear way with details
meaning_uz: biror narsani tafsilotlar bilan juda aniq tarzda tushuntirishga
usage: The government has so far refused to spell out its plans.

meaning: relating to policies or approaches that are standard and not tailored to individual needs
meaning_uz: standart bo'lgan va alohida ehtiyojlarga moslashmagan siyosat yoki yo'nalishlar bilan bog'liq
usage: One cannot apply one-size-fits-all approach to improve education.

meaning: of or in a position of high standing, rank, regard, or repute
meaning_uz: yoki yuqori mavqega ega bo'lgan, martaba, hurmat yoki obro'-e'tiborga ega bo'lgan
usage: Even though my boss is above the salt, he still makes a point of mingling with everyone in the company.

meaning: from the start of something
meaning_uz: biror narsaning boshidanoq
usage: The bridge-building project had problems with funding right from the word go.

meaning: to cease business operations for any length of time, often permanently
meaning_uz: har qanday uzoq vaqt davomida, ko'pincha doimiy ravishda biznes-operatsiyalarni to'xtatish uchun
usage: I loved that restaurant, so I'm very disappointed that they put up the shutters.

idiom: hold your cards close to your chest
meaning: to keep your intended actions secret
meaning_uz: ko'zlangan amallaringizni sir tutishga
usage: You never quite know what Barry's going to do next - he keeps his cards very close to his chest.

meaning: in the countryside, especially in a rustic or particularly unsophisticated area
meaning_uz: qishloqda, ayniqsa, rustik yoki ayniqsa, zo'r bo'lmagan hududda
usage: Jane was sick of living in the sticks and dreamt of spending her life in the City.

meaning: to have one's confidence, courage, or happiness bolstered
meaning_uz: o'z ishonchi, mardligi yoki baxt-saodati yanada mustahkamlanib
usage: We may have lost the election, but we take heart in the fact that so many young people are now engaged and excited about politics.

meaning: to frown (move your eyebrows down and together) because you are thinking carefully, or because you are angry or worried
meaning_uz: ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'ylayotganingiz yoki g'azablanganingiz yoki xavotirga tushganingiz uchun yuz o'girishga (qoshlaringizni pastga va birga harakatga keltiring)
usage: He knitted his brow in concentration.

meaning: to tremble violently with fear or nervousness
meaning_uz: qo'rquv yoki asabiylik bilan qattiq titrash uchun
usage: I was shaking like a leaf when I went up to deliver my speech in front of all those people.

meaning: to prove particularly useful or beneficial to one in the future
meaning_uz: kelajakda bittasiga ayniqsa foydali yoki foydali ekanligini isbotlash uchun
usage: Janet is hoping her internship working in IT will stand her in good stead when she looks for a job after college.

meaning: very pleased with someone or something, perhaps to the point of giddiness
meaning_uz: kimdandir yoki biror narsadan juda mamnun, ehtimol giddiness nuqtasigacha
usage: Your mother is really tickled pink that you've decided to go to her alma mater.

meaning: extremely pale, as if frightened
meaning_uz: nihoyatda rang-barang, xuddi qo'rqqanday
usage: Marilyn turned as white as a ghost when the policeman told her that her son had been in a car wreck.

meaning: the present situation
meaning_uz: hozirgi holat
usage: Certain people always want to maintain the status quo and hamper progress.

idiom: count your chickens before they hatch
meaning: make plans that depend on something good happening before you know that it has actually happened
meaning_uz: aslida sodir bo'lganligini bilishdan oldin yaxshi narsaga bog'liq rejalar tuzish
usage: She wanted to buy a dress in case someone asked her to the dance, but I told her not to count her chickens before they hatched.

meaning: a phrase used to end a conversation or topic of discussion, especially when one wants to discourage debate
meaning_uz: suhbat yoki muhokama mavzusini tugatish uchun ishlatiladigan ibora, ayniqsa, bahs-munozaralarni to'xtatmoqchi bo'lganda
usage: Don't try to defend him. He's just a loudmouth, end of story.

meaning: someone who is uncomfortable in a specific situation
meaning_uz: aniq bir vaziyatda xafa bo'lgan odam
usage: I felt like a fish out of water at my new school.

meaning: prepare for an event or course of action by dealing with anything that might hinder progress
meaning_uz: taraqqiyotga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday narsa bilan shug'ullanish orqali tadbir yoki harakat yo'nalishiga tayyorgarlik ko'rish
usage: The company's sale of Australian investments cleared the decks for expansion in the UK.

meaning: a very happy or successful period in the past
meaning_uz: o'tmishda juda baxtli yoki muvaffaqiyatli davr
usage: She recalled the halcyon days of her youth.

meaning: begin badly
meaning_uz: yomon boshlash
usage: He started off on the wrong foot in his new job when he had a bit of an argument with his manager.

meaning: to be impractical, aloof, or fanciful, often to the point of being very unhelpful or counterproductive
meaning_uz: amalda bo'lmagan, beparvo yoki xayoliy bo'lishi, ko'pincha juda foydasiz yoki samarasiz bo'lishgacha
usage: He has his head in the clouds while the rest of us are trying to figure out how to fix this!

meaning: to calmly deal with something unpleasant and not let it have an effect on you
meaning_uz: yoqimsiz narsa bilan xotirjam munosabatda bo'lish va bu sizga ta'sir qilishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik
usage: You have to learn how to take criticism in your stride if you want to be successful in this business.

meaning: sensationalist journalism with the main goal of attracting attention and readers, rather than presenting an unbiased account of the news
meaning_uz: sensatsion jurnalistika yangiliklar haqida beg'ubor ma'lumot taqdim etishdan ko'ra, diqqat va o'quvchilarni jalb qilishning asosiy maqsadi bilan
usage: It may have begun at the turn of the century, but yellow journalism is alive and well, from the supermarket tabloids to all the talking heads on cable news.

meaning: a clever and intelligent person
meaning_uz: aqlli va aqlli inson
usage: Don't underestimate Cindy's intelligence - she's one smart cookie!

meaning: pass the critical point and start to improve
meaning_uz: kritik nuqtadan o'tib, takomillashtirishga kirishish
usage: After nine months of poor sales we've finally turned the corner.

meaning: an opportunity to do, try, or achieve something
meaning_uz: qilish, sinab ko'rish yoki biror narsaga erishish imkoniyati
usage: He might not have been elected to office this term, but he'll likely look for another kick at the can in November.

meaning: to use force and threats to make people do what you want
meaning_uz: insonlarni o'zingiz xohlagan ishni bajarish uchun kuch ishlatish va tahdidlar
usage: We never strong-armed anybody. I told people about the website and they could take it or leave it.

meaning: to work very late into the night
meaning_uz: kechgacha ishlash uchun
usage: I have an important exam tomorrow so I'll be burning the midnight oil tonight.

meaning: all at once, with a single decisive or powerful action
meaning_uz: barchasi birdaniga, yagona hal qiluvchi yoki kuchli harakat bilan
usage: When the economy crashed, thousands lost their jobs, their homes, and their pensions in one blow.

meaning: to start your own business
meaning_uz: o'z biznesini boshlash uchun
usage: She set up shop back in 1965 with a very small restaurant in the Kings Road.

meaning: to stay close to someone, watching everything that they do
meaning_uz: birovga yaqin bo'lib qolish, hamma ishlarini kuzatish
usage: It's awful having a boss who breathes down your neck all the time.

meaning: something done to achieve something else
meaning_uz: boshqa narsaga erishish uchun qilingan biror narsa
usage: I didn't particularly like the job - it was just a means to an end.

meaning: a humorous action that one will allegedly take if something very unlikely happens
meaning_uz: ehtimoldan xoli bo'lmagan narsa sodir bo'lsa, kimdir olib boradigan hazil-mutoyiba
usage: Kevin is always late, so if he actually shows up on time, I'll eat my hat.

meaning: very closely with someone or something, especially by design
meaning_uz: birov yoki biror narsa bilan juda yaqin, ayniqsa dizayn bo'yicha
usage: Our art department works hand in glove with our marketing division to make sure all the campaigns are consistently designed.

meaning: to make more effort than is expected of you
meaning_uz: sizdan kutilganidan ko'ra ko'proq harakat qilish uchun
usage: He is a nice guy, always ready to go the extra mile for his friends.

meaning: to encounter an especially difficult, troubled, or low point, as in a relationship or some pursuit
meaning_uz: munosabatlarda yoki qandaydir ta'qibda bo'lgani kabi, ayniqsa qiyin, tashvishli yoki past nuqtaga duch kelish
usage: We'd been great friends for nearly 10 years, but our friendship has hit the rocks lately.

meaning: to want to talk to someone about something annoying they have done
meaning_uz: qilgan zerikarli ishi haqida birov bilan gaplashmoqchi bo'lish
usage: I've got a bone to pick with you - you've been using my shaver again.

meaning: a very easy task
meaning_uz: juda oson ish
usage: Finding the right street was child's play with a map.

meaning: said in order to tell someone that an event is not likely to happen
meaning_uz: voqea sodir bo'lishi ehtimoli yo'qligini birovga aytish maqsadida
usage: I know you hope Monica comes to the meeting, but don't hold your breath - she hasn't been to one all year.

meaning: to have more than one set of responsibilities, to hold more than one office
meaning_uz: birdan ortiq vakolatlar to'plamiga ega bo'lishi, birdan ortiq vakolatlarni egallashi
usage: The mayor is also the police chief. She wears more than one hat.

idiom: bite off more than you can chew
meaning: to try to do something that is too difficult for you
meaning_uz: o'zingiz uchun juda qiyin bo'lgan ishni qilishga harakat qilish
usage: I think he's bitten off more than he can chew taking all those classes.

idiom: like water off a duck's back
meaning: referring to a potentially hurtful remark which has no apparent effect on the person involved
meaning_uz: bu bilan shug'ullanuvchi shaxsga aniq ta'sir ko'rsatmaydigan zararli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan gapni nazarda
usage: The criticism was like water off a duck's back to Nick, but I'm sure it upset Paul.

meaning: completely transparent and unclouded, very easy to understand
meaning_uz: butunlay shaffof va o'ralmagan, tushunish juda oson
usage: She made it crystal clear that she was in charge.

meaning: to think about one particular thing and nothing else
meaning_uz: bir muayyan narsa va boshqa hech narsa haqida o'ylash
usage: My sister has a one-track mind, only thinking about how something can further her career.

meaning: impress someone greatly
meaning_uz: birovni juda hayratga soladi
usage: I'm blown away by his new poem.

idiom: have your head in the sand
meaning: to refuse to think about unpleasant facts, although they will have an influence on your situation
meaning_uz: yoqimsiz faktlar haqida o'ylashni rad etish, garchi ular sizning holatingizga ta'sir ko'rsatishi
usage: Parents said bullying was being ignored, and accused the headmaster of burying his head in the sand.

meaning: be too late
meaning_uz: juda kech bo'ling
usage: He started studying at the eleventh hour and naturally failed his exam.

meaning: to do something that is unnecessary and likely to cause problems later
meaning_uz: keraksiz bo'lgan va keyinchalik muammo tug'dirishi ehtimoli bo'lgan ishni qilish
usage: Do not get involved with politics. That's borrowing trouble.

meaning: to do whatever is necessary to get something
meaning_uz: biror narsa olish uchun zarur bo'lgan har qanday ishni qilish
usage: I'm going to get a dress for the prom, whether I have to beg, borrow, or steal one.

meaning: without success or a result
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatsiz yoki natijasiz
usage: They waited in vain for a response.

meaning: a secret enemy
meaning_uz: yashirin dushman
usage: Ben secretly applied for the same job as his best friend; no one knew he was such a snake in the grass.

meaning: at the highest or maximum level of function, operation, or performance
meaning_uz: funksiyasi, ishlashi yoki bajarilishining eng yuqori yoki maksimal darajada
usage: The project is in full gear now that we have Sally on board.

meaning: to be prepared to verbally or physically fight another person or group
meaning_uz: boshqa shaxs yoki guruhga qarshi og'zaki yoki jismonan kurashishga tayyor bo'lishi
usage: The police have had to intervene because those rival gangs have been at daggers drawn lately.

meaning: too extreme and not suitable, or demanding too much attention or effort, especially in an uncontrolled way
meaning_uz: juda haddan tashqari ko'p va mos emas, yoki juda ko'p e'tibor yoki kuch talab qilish, ayniqsa, nazoratsiz tarzda
usage: I thought the decorations were way over the top.

meaning: under suspicion or discredited
meaning_uz: shubha ostida yoki noshukr
usage: Ever since that leak of private emails, everything the CEO has done has been under a cloud.

idiom: get the show on the road
meaning: to begin an activity that has been planned
meaning_uz: rejalashtirilgan faoliyatni boshlash uchun
usage: The boat's ready, so let's get this show on the road.

meaning: to tear down something, usually a building, to ground level
meaning_uz: biror narsani, odatda binoni yer sathiga buzib tashlash uchun
usage: The council decided to raze the old city hall to the ground.

idiom: be a far cry from something
meaning: to be completely different from something
meaning_uz: biror narsadan butunlay farq qilishi
usage: This flat is a far cry from the house they had before.

meaning: after death
meaning_uz: o'limdan keyin
usage: Do you think there's life beyond the grave?

meaning: in or into a predicament
meaning_uz: bir ahvolga tushib yoki
usage: Offers of devolution will lead ministers straight up a gum tree.

meaning: a final effort or attempt to solve a problem or avoid failure or defeat, especially after a series of failures or setbacks
meaning_uz: muammoni hal qilish yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlik yoki mag'lubiyatdan qochish uchun yakuniy harakat yoki urinish, ayniqsa, bir qator muvaffaqiyatsizliklar yoki muvaffaqiyatsizliklardan so'ng
usage: The home team is mounting one last-ditch effort in the final seconds of the game to try to force an overtime showdown.

meaning: to escape with someone or something that has been stolen, snatched, etc
meaning_uz: kim bilandir yoki o'g'irlangan, tortib olingan va hokazo narsalar bilan qochib qutulish uchun
usage: The thieves busted the ATM and made away with the cash inside.

meaning: to show what one is really like or what one is really thinking
meaning_uz: aslida qanday ekanligini yoki aslida qanday fikrda ekanligini ko'rsatish uchun
usage: It's only in times of crisis that your friends will really show their colors.

meaning: the person or group who has true control or a great influence on one in control, but is not officially or publicly in charge
meaning_uz: haqiqiy boshqaruvga ega bo'lgan yoki boshqaruvdagi shaxsga katta ta'sir ko'rsatgan, ammo rasmiy yoki ommaviy ravishda mas'ul bo'lmagan shaxs yoki guruh
usage: The president's charisma and likability got him elected, but his team of advisors is the real power behind the throne.

meaning: dangerously or uncomfortably near
meaning_uz: xavfli yoki noqulay yaqin
usage: He sat on the edge of the bed, far too close for comfort.

idiom: sell one's soul to the devil
meaning: to abandon one's values or morals in return for some highly desired benefit, typically success, power, wealth, etc
meaning_uz: ba'zi bir yuksak orzu-umidlar, odatda muvaffaqiyat, kuch, boylik va boshqalar evaziga o'z qadr-qimmati yoki axloqidan voz kechish
usage: I am afraid we have sold our soul to the devil by agreeing to this partnership.

meaning: troubles and events that cause suffering
meaning_uz: azob-uqubatlarga sabab bo'ladigan muammo va hodisalar
usage: The trials and tribulations of marriage.

meaning: the information, or the version of that information, that is currently spreading from person to person, often in a particular setting, like school or work
meaning_uz: ma'lumotlarini, ya'ni o'sha ma'lumotlarning ayni paytda odamdan odamga tarqalayotgan versiyasini, ko'pincha muayyan sharoitda, masalan, maktab yoki ish
usage: There are so many people stopping by Shelly's office because word on the wire is that she's leaving the company.

meaning: to do something harmful to someone else in order to gain an advantage for yourself
meaning_uz: o'zingiz uchun ustunlikka erishish maqsadida boshqa birovga zararli ish qilish
usage: I'm not going to throw my friend under the bus for something he did 25 years ago.

idiom: bite the hand that feeds you
meaning: to act badly towards the person who is helping or has helped you
meaning_uz: sizga yordam berayotgan yoki yordam bergan shaxsga nisbatan yomon harakat qilish
usage: Leaving the company after they've spent three years training you is a bit like biting the hand that feeds you.

meaning: to improve or decorate something that is already perfect and therefore spoil it
meaning_uz: allaqachon mukammal bo'lgan narsani yaxshilash yoki bezash va shuning uchun uni talon-taroj qilish uchun
usage: Should I add a scarf to this jacket or would it be gilding the lily?

meaning: to not do something one said one would do, to renege on something
meaning_uz: bir kishi qiladigan ishni qilmaslik, biror narsadan voz kechish uchun
usage: You made a commitment to support our project, and now you've gone back on your word!

meaning: to destroy someone's illusion or delusion, to destroy someone's fantasy
meaning_uz: birovning illatini yoki aldovini yo'q qilish, birovning xayolini yo'q qilish uchun
usage: I hate to burst your bubble, but Columbus did not discover Canada.

meaning: disappointing or anticlimactic
meaning_uz: ko'ngilsiz yoki antiklimaktik
usage: The film had a lot of hype before its release, but after seeing it, I think it's all sizzle and no steak.

meaning: honestly and straightforwardly, with absolute accuracy
meaning_uz: xolisona va to'g'riso'zlik bilan, mutlaq aniqlik bilan
usage: They won the match fair and square.

meaning: very likely to have unpleasant consequences or lead to failure
meaning_uz: yoqimsiz oqibatlarga olib kelishi yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlikka olib kelishi ehtimoli juda
usage: All those children unsupervised sounds to me like a recipe for disaster.

meaning: bad or unfair treatment
meaning_uz: yomon yoki adolatsiz muomala
usage: He said that many children in the city's schools were being given a raw deal by being taught in classes that were too large.

meaning: said when a situation is certain to develop in a particular way because decisions have been taken that cannot be changed
meaning_uz: vaziyat muayyan tarzda rivojlanishi aniq bo'lganda, chunki o'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan qarorlar qabul qilinganida
usage: From the moment the negotiations failed, the die was cast and war was inevitable.

meaning: something that fails completely or goes extremely badly
meaning_uz: butunlay muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragan yoki nihoyatda yomon ketadigan narsa
usage: The movie was a train wreck.

meaning: to stay calm in a difficult situation
meaning_uz: qiyin vaziyatda sokin bo'lish uchun
usage: I don't know how you manage to keep such a cool head in such a hectic, stressful office!

meaning: to back up one's boastful talk with meaningful actions
meaning_uz: ma'noli amallar bilan maqtanchoq gapni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun
usage: This consultant has sold us on some pretty radical ideas, but it remains to be seen whether he can walk the talk.

idiom: throw a spanner in the works
meaning: to do something that prevents a plan or activity from succeeding
meaning_uz: reja yoki faoliyatning muvaffaqiyatga erishishiga to'sqinlik qiladigan ishni bajarishga
usage: The funding for the project was withdrawn so that really threw a spanner in the works.

meaning: to get a sense of enjoyment, amusement, or excitement from someone or something
meaning_uz: kimdandir yoki biror narsadan zavqlanish, o'yin-kulgi yoki hayajon olish uchun
usage: Even as an adult, I still get a kick out of building sandcastles at the beach.

meaning: to irritate or annoy one
meaning_uz: birini g'azablantirish yoki g'azablantirish uchun
usage: The kids are really getting on my wick today with their constant fighting.

meaning: a person's last piece of work, achievement, or performance
meaning_uz: insonning oxirgi ish, yutuq yoki ijro
usage: This weekend's game was his swan song as the team's captain.

meaning: to suffer the negative consequences of one's actions
meaning_uz: o'z qilmishining nojo'ya oqibatlariga duchor bo'lish uchun
usage: If you don't do your homework now, you'll reap the whirlwind when you have to take your final exam.

meaning: to discuss something honestly and directly
meaning_uz: biror narsani xolis va bevosita muhokama qilish
usage: Ok, let's talk turkey - you are broke and you don't have work. What are you going to do?

meaning: people who are squeamish, someone who is sickened or disturbed by unpleasantness or challenge
meaning_uz: siqilgan odamlar, yoqimsiz yoki qiyinchilikdan kasal bo'lgan yoki bezovta bo'lgan odam
usage: The pathway around the top of the volcano, near the crater, is not for the faint of heart.

idiom: a lone voice in the wilderness
meaning: someone who expresses an idea or opinion that is not popular
meaning_uz: mashhur bo'lmagan fikr yoki fikr bildiradigan kishi
usage: For many years, she was a lone voice in the wilderness who wrote about the need for better urban planning.

meaning: without being noticed, detected, or addressed
meaning_uz: sezilmasdan, aniqlanmasdan yoki bartaraf etilmasdan
usage: Every year, the government promises to do something about the homelessness problem, yet every year it seems to slip under the radar again.

meaning: a fist
meaning_uz: musht
usage: That kid is in the nurse's office with a bloody nose because the bully gave him a bunch of fives in the face.

meaning: leave a place quickly in order to avoid an embarrassing or dangerous situation
meaning_uz: uyatli yoki xavfli vaziyatdan saqlanish maqsadida joyni tez tark
usage: I can still beat a retreat to my own hotel, and pretend that none of this ever happened.

meaning: to be beyond one's prime, to be no longer useful, effective, or functional
meaning_uz: birining asosiy vazifasidan tashqarida bo'lish, endi foydali, samarali va funktsional bo'lmasligi
usage: The one-time champion seems to have seen his day, having been knocked out of the qualifying round for the fifth year in a row.

meaning: travelling in a boat or ship with sails
meaning_uz: kemada yoki kemada sayr qilish
usage: After ten hours under sail, they reached dry land.

meaning: rare or seldom-seen
meaning_uz: kamdan-kam ko'rilgan yoki kamdan-kam ko'rilgan
usage: Warm days have been few and far between this winter.

meaning: to make the decisions, to decide what is to be done
meaning_uz: qarorlar qabul qilish, nima qilinishini hal qilish
usage: Mom calls the shots for Thanksgiving dinner, so you better get her approval for any dish you want to bring.

meaning: to have an opportunity to speak
meaning_uz: gapirish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishi
usage: Brad talked so much that nobody could get a word in edgewise.

meaning: to get into bed and go to sleep
meaning_uz: yotish va uyquga ketish uchun
usage: I have to get up early for work tomorrow, so I think I'd better hit the hay.

meaning: not to try to hide your feelings
meaning_uz: his-tuyg'ularingizni yashirishga harakat qilmaslik
usage: He made no bones about his dissatisfaction with the service.

meaning: an elected official serving their last term in office, usually so-called after a successor has been elected
meaning_uz: lavozimida oxirgi muddatini o'tayotgan saylangan mansabdor shaxs, odatda, voris saylanganidan so'ng shunday deb
usage: Lame-duck Congresses tend to do things they wouldn't dare do otherwise.

idiom: have a soft spot for someone
meaning: have special feelings for someone
meaning_uz: kimgadir o'zgacha his-tuyg'ular
usage: She had a soft spot for her youngest brother and was always fighting for him, even if it was his fault.

meaning: to listen attentively to someone
meaning_uz: birovni diqqat bilan tinglashga
usage: Even if you disagree with someone, you should still lend them your ear and try to understand their point of view.

meaning: very insulting and unfair
meaning_uz: juda haqoratli va adolatsiz
usage: I know she really wants the promotion, but telling the boss about my personal problems was below the belt.

meaning: to spend time getting back your strength or happiness after a defeat or bad experience
meaning_uz: mag'lubiyat yoki yomon tajribadan so'ng kuch yoki baxtingizni qaytarib olishga vaqt sarflash
usage: The sports team returned home yesterday to lick its wounds after the terrible defeat.

meaning: the act of punishing all criminal or unacceptable behaviour severely, even if it is not very serious
meaning_uz: juda jiddiy bo'lmasa ham, barcha jinoiy yoki nomaqbul xatti-harakatlarni qattiq jazolash amali
usage: The police are exercising a new policy of zero tolerance against motoring offenders.

meaning: a group of wealthy individuals who travel globally, especially by private jet, to frequent fashionable resorts, social events, and the like
meaning_uz: dunyo bo'ylab, ayniqsa xususiy samolyot orqali tez-tez moda kurortlarga, ijtimoiy tadbirlarga va shunga o'xshashlarga sayohat qiladigan bir guruh badavlat shaxslar
usage: Mark's dream of joining the jet set finally came to fruition after he won the lottery.

meaning: to escape punishment or blame for a crime or misdeed
meaning_uz: jinoyat yoki qilmishiga yarasha jazodan yoki aybdan qutulish uchun
usage: Celebrities always seem to be able to beat the rap after they get arrested.

meaning: the focal, central, or most important element of a topic, problem, or issue
meaning_uz: mavzu, muammo yoki masalaning fokal, markaziy yoki eng muhim elementini
usage: Over the course of this trial, the prosecution intends to get to the crux of the matter regarding the company's shady financial dealings.

meaning: cause a particular situation to happen or a particular decision to be made, when other situations or decisions are possible
meaning_uz: muayyan vaziyat sodir bo'lishiga yoki muayyan qaror qabul qilinishiga sabab bo'ladi, boshqa holatlar yoki qarorlar imkoni bo'lganda
usage: The teams were evenly matched until two quick goals from Rooney tipped the scales in favour of England.

meaning: to accept the responsibility or blame for a problem or mistake
meaning_uz: muammo yoki xato uchun javobgarlik yoki aybni qabul qilish uchun
usage: The CEO fell on his sword when widespread corruption in the company was exposed.

idiom: go back to the drawing board
meaning: to start planning something again because the first plan failed
meaning_uz: birinchi reja muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragani uchun yana nimanidir rejalashtirishni boshlash uchun
usage: Our proposal might not be accepted, in which case we'll have to go back to the drawing board.

meaning: to force or be forced into a difficult or unpleasant situation that one cannot easily resolve or escape
meaning_uz: osonlikcha hal qila olmaydigan yoki qochib qutula olmaydigan qiyin yoki yoqimsiz vaziyatga majburlash yoki majburlash
usage: My boss really drove me into a corner when he asked me to fire the CEO's daughter.

meaning: tension and disdain between two or more people due to past disagreement or transgressions
meaning_uz: o'tmishdagi kelishmovchilik yoki tajovuzlar tufayli ikki yoki undan ortiq kishi o'rtasidagi tanglik va nafrat
usage: Last year's brutal playoff series created some bad blood between these two teams.

meaning: a phrase that can be used to refer to anything given away for free
meaning_uz: bepul berilgan har qanday narsani nazarda tutish uchun qo'llaniladigan ibora
usage: Of course, once you're signed up to the free program, you have to pay for all sorts of extra services to make it even worth using. There's no such thing as a free lunch, after all.

idiom: Like turkeys voting for an early Christmas
meaning: choose to accept a situation which will have very bad results
meaning_uz: juda yomon natijalarga olib keladigan vaziyatni qabul qilishni tanlang
usage: Teachers agreeing to even larger class sizes would be like turkeys voting for an early Christmas.

meaning: to make a display of obsequious reverence, devotion, or respect
meaning_uz: beg'ubor ehtirom, ixlos yoki hurmat namoyon bo'lishi
usage: You should see these sycophants kiss the ground when the boss walks in.

idiom: born on the wrong side of the blanket
meaning: born to parents who were not married, illegitimate
meaning_uz: turmushga chiqmagan, noqonuniy bo'lgan ota-onalardan tug'ilgan
usage: All his life, Edward felt that people looked down on him because he was born on the wrong side of the blanket.

meaning: an attempt to blame and punish people who hold unpopular views and opinions, often under the guise of some other investigation
meaning_uz: mashhur bo'lmagan qarashlar va fikrlarni ushlab turgan odamlarni ayblash va jazolashga urinish, ko'pincha boshqa biron bir tergov niqobi ostida
usage: The ruling party's witch hunt against its detractors sparked a civil war.

meaning: the person responsible for a certain plan or idea
meaning_uz: ma'lum bir reja yoki g'oya uchun javobgar shaxs
usage: I wonder which of my enemies is the brains behind this latest rumor about me.

meaning: to finish in first place in an auto racing competition
meaning_uz: avto musobaqa musobaqasida birinchi o'rinda yakunlashga
usage: Neck and neck right up until the final moments of the race, photo analysis revealed that it was Steinman who took the chequered flag.

meaning: to be in a strong position, have all the advantages
meaning_uz: mustahkam mavqega ega bo'lish, barcha afzalliklarga ega bo'lish
usage: Given the high unemployment figures in some countries, employers hold all the aces.

meaning: extremely ill or very close to death or total destruction
meaning_uz: nihoyatda kasal yoki o'limga juda yaqin yoki butunlay yo'q qilish
usage: Many parts of the environment are now at death's door due to the effects of pollution.

meaning: to return to the original or a similar position, situation, or circumstance where one or something started
meaning_uz: bir yoki bir narsa boshlangan dastlabki yoki shunga o'xshash mavqega, vaziyatga yoki vaziyatga qaytish uchun
usage: After the banking sector brought on the economic collapse through lack of federal oversight, things seem to be coming full circle as politicians are beginning to call for deregulation of the industry once again.

meaning: exceedingly wearied by, bored of, or exasperated with something
meaning_uz: Haddan tashqari charchagan, zerikib ketgan yoki biror narsadan g'azablangan
usage: I'm sick and tired of doing my boss's errands. If something doesn't change soon, I'm going to quit!

meaning: to see, and perhaps apprehend, someone as they are doing something
meaning_uz: birovni ko'rish va ehtimol qo'lga olish, ular biror ish qilayotganda
usage: Timmy tried to get into the cookie jar again, but I caught him red-handed.

meaning: lacking unusual or special aspects, ordinary
meaning_uz: g'ayrioddiy yoki o'ziga xos tomonlari yo'qligi, oddiy
usage: He wasn't too happy with his run of the mill job.

meaning: used in reference to an opportunity that has passed or a situation that can no longer be changed
meaning_uz: o'tgan imkoniyat yoki endi o'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan vaziyatga ishora qilib qo'llaniladi
usage: We're good friends but I don't think we'll ever be anything more to each other - that ship has sailed.

meaning: to accept that something is true without making sure that it is
meaning_uz: ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilmasdan biror narsaning haqiqat ekanligini qabul qilish
usage: It's a shame that a lot of people take it as read that video games are no more than idle entertainment.

meaning: very different, as different as possible
meaning_uz: juda boshqacha, iloji boricha boshqacha
usage: They might be identical twins, but Jim and Greg are different as night and day in personality.

meaning: someone who has no real place or purpose in a situation
meaning_uz: vaziyatda haqiqiy o'rni va maqsadi bo'lmagan odam
usage: I didn't realize that the party was for couples only, so when I showed up alone, I felt like a fifth wheel.

meaning: to remain a contender for success despite setbacks or difficulties
meaning_uz: muvaffaqiyatsizliklar yoki qiyinchiliklarga qaramay muvaffaqiyat uchun da'vogar bo'lib qolish
usage: Our competitors may have carved away a lot of our market, but we're still in the game!

meaning: a situation in which you can enjoy the advantages of two very different things at the same time
meaning_uz: bir vaqtning o'zida ikki juda xilma-xil narsaning afzalliklaridan bahramand bo'lishingiz mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat
usage: She works in the city and lives in the country, so she gets the best of both worlds.

meaning: to have a very fun or exciting time doing something
meaning_uz: biror ishni bajarish uchun juda qiziqarli yoki hayajonli vaqt o'tkazish
usage: The kids are having a blast running around the beach all day.

meaning: to take control of something, especially an organization or a country
meaning_uz: biror narsa, xususan, tashkilot yoki mamlakat boshqaruvini o'z qo'ldan
usage: He took up the reins of government immediately after the coup.

idiom: knock someone over with a feather
meaning: to shock, confuse, or astonish someone to a point of complete bewilderment; throw someone for a loop
meaning_uz: odamni hayratga solish, chalg'itish yoki hayratda qoldiradigan narsa; birovni to'siqqa tashlash
usage: It really knocked me over with a feather to hear that my ex-wife had already remarried.

meaning: recover control of one's emotions
meaning_uz: o'z hissiyotlarini boshqarishni tiklash
usage: You've got to pull yourself together and find a job, instead of thinking about your failures.

meaning: in a position of vulnerability, weakness, or powerlessness
meaning_uz: ojizlik, kuchsizlik yoki kuchsizlik holatida
usage: He's had me over a barrel ever since he found out about my drinking problem.

meaning: to not be worried at all by something
meaning_uz: biror narsadan umuman xavotirlanmaslik uchun
usage: Do whatever you want, I don't give a toss.

meaning: a powerful sense of ambition or determination
meaning_uz: intilish yoki qat'iyatlilik tuyg'usini kuchli
usage: He lacks the fire in his belly necessary to seek the candidature.

meaning: to have or not have the special knowledge or power that belongs to a particular group of people
meaning_uz: muayyan toifaga mansub bo'lgan maxsus bilim yoki kuchga ega bo'lishi yoki bo'lmasligi
usage: I've been out of the loop since I changed jobs. I didn't realize Wendy and Bob had got engaged.

idiom: like a bat out of hell
meaning: very quickly or abruptly
meaning_uz: juda tez yoki to'satdan
usage: His tires squealed as he drove out of the parking lot like a bat out of hell.

meaning: to accept a difficult situation and deal with it in a determined way, be angry
meaning_uz: qiyin vaziyatni qabul qilib, uni qat'iy tarzda bartaraf etish, g'azablanish
usage: We had to grit our teeth and agree with their conditions because we wanted the contract.

meaning: to be bought quickly and in large numbers
meaning_uz: tez va ko'p sonli sotib olinishi
usage: The new game is apparently selling like hot cakes.

meaning: excessively, completely
meaning_uz: haddan tashqari, butunlay
usage: They were over head and ears in debt.

meaning: quickly and informally, without thought or preparation
meaning_uz: tez va norasmiy, o'ylamasdan va tayyorgarliksiz
usage: I ran into my boss in town, so I had to think up an excuse on the fly as to why I wasn't at work.

meaning: to barely avoid being consumed by a stressful or unpleasant situation
meaning_uz: stressli yoki yoqimsiz vaziyatdan oz-ozdan iste'mol qilmaslik uchun
usage: If credit cards are the only thing keeping your head above water, then your situation is more dire than I thought.

meaning: to do everything you can to make something successful
meaning_uz: biror ishni muvaffaqiyatli amalga oshirish uchun qo'lingizdan kelganicha harakat qilish
usage: They pulled out all the stops for their daughter's wedding.

meaning: strictly according to the rules
meaning_uz: qoidalarga ko'ra qat'iy
usage: A cop who doesn't exactly play it by the book.

meaning: make a determined effort to overcome an obstacle or deal with a difficult situation
meaning_uz: to'siqni yengib o'tish yoki qiyin vaziyatni bartaraf etish uchun qat'iy harakat qilish
usage: Come on, dude, cowboy up! We can totally make that jump on our bikes!

meaning: prevent someone or something from approaching or having an effect
meaning_uz: birovga yoki biror narsaga yaqinlashmaslik yoki ta'sir ko'rsatishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik
usage: She fought to keep her unhappiness at bay.

meaning: in, related to, or matching someone's general interests, abilities, or area of familiarity; in someone's comfort zone
meaning_uz: birovning umumiy qiziqishlari, qobiliyatlari yoki tanish-bilganlik sohasiga oid yoki mos kelishi; kimningdir komfort zonasida
usage: I thought you'd like this article about computer programming - computers are in your wheelhouse, aren't they?

idiom: has the cat got your tongue?
meaning: something you say to someone when you are annoyed because they will not speak
meaning_uz: agar gapirmasalar, g'azablanganingizda birovga aytadigan gapingiz
usage: What's the matter? You were saying a lot of things behind my back. Has the cat got your tongue now?

meaning: not enough of something that should have been provided earlier
meaning_uz: oldinroq berilishi kerak bo'lgan narsaning yetarli emasligi
usage: A spokeswoman described the aid for the refugees as too little, too late.

meaning: to accept an unpleasant fact or situation after dealing with it for a while
meaning_uz: bilan bir muddat shug'ullangandan so'ng yoqimsiz fakt yoki holatni qabul qilish
usage: They're upset that you didn't call, but they'll get over it.

meaning: to receive the worst/largest part of something unpleasant or harmful
meaning_uz: yoqimsiz yoki zararli narsaning eng yomon/eng katta qismini olish uchun
usage: When things go wrong, his assistant always has to bear the brunt of his anger.

meaning: adjusting quickly to changes and making fast decisions
meaning_uz: o'zgarishlarga tez moslashish va tezkor qarorlar qabul qilish
usage: A good sales man must be able to think on his feet to close the deal.

meaning: to bring about or signal the end of something
meaning_uz: biror narsaning tugashini keltirib chiqarish yoki signal berish uchun
usage: The government is bringing down the curtain on the controversial program next month.

meaning: to alternatingly increase and decrease
meaning_uz: o'zgaruvchan ravishda ko'paytirish va kamaytirishga
usage: My fortune has waxed and waned over the years, but I live simply anyway, and it has never affected me much.

meaning: to firmly uphold a certain position
meaning_uz: ma'lum bir mavqeni qat'iy qo'llab-quvvatlashga
usage: You can try to sway me all you want, but I'm holding the line - curfew is 10 PM.

meaning: out of nowhere, out of nothing
meaning_uz: hech qaerdan, hech narsadan
usage: Pascal's discoveries did not come from thin air - they're based on the work of earlier mathematicians.

meaning: to replace one in some role, to take over for one in some position
meaning_uz: qandaydir rolda birini almashtirish, qandaydir lavozimda bittasini egallash uchun
usage: You do so much for the company that I don't see how anyone could fill your shoes.
