meaning: to steal everything someone owns, especially through deceitful or fraudulent means, sometimes also used to insinuate that someone is charging too much money for something
meaning_uz: kimgadir tegishli bo'lgan hamma narsani o'g'irlash uchun, ayniqsa, aldov yoki firibgarlik yo'li bilan, ba'zan kimdir biror narsa uchun juda ko'p pul to'layotganini ta'kidlashga odatlangan
usage: The CEO was sent to prison for robbing his clients blind through a complex Ponzi scheme.

meaning: extremely busy, deeply involved or engrossed in or with something
meaning_uz: nihoyatda band, chuqur ishtirok etgan yoki biror narsaga to'lib-toshgan yoki bilan
usage: John has been up to his eyes with the kids lately.

idiom: let the grass grow under your feet
meaning: to do nothing, delay
meaning_uz: hech narsa qilmaslik, kechiktirish
usage: We can't let the grass grow under our feet, we have got to get going with this project.

meaning: to change or reverse something dramatically
meaning_uz: biror narsani keskin o'zgartirish yoki teskari o'zgartirishga
usage: Wow, they really turned the tide on their opponents by scoring 20 unanswered points!

idiom: have an ace up your sleeve
meaning: secret knowledge or a secret skill that will give you an advantage
meaning_uz: maxfiy bilim yoki sizga ustunlik beradigan maxfiy mahorat
usage: I am well prepared for the negotiations. I have got an ace up my sleeve.

meaning: the ability to speak easily and confidently in a way that makes people want to listen to you and believe you
meaning_uz: odamlarni sizni tinglashga va sizga ishonishni xohlaydigan tarzda oson va ishonch bilan gapirish qobiliyati
usage: She's got the gift of the gab - she should work in sales and marketing.

meaning: something that is even more attractive because it is not allowed
meaning_uz: yo'l qo'yilmagani uchun yanada jozibali bo'lgan narsa
usage: Since forbidden fruit is the sweetest, I couldn't stop myself from taking a piece of the cake my mom had specifically made for work.

meaning: to ostracize, to ignore or refuse to communicate with one, typically as a form of punishment
meaning_uz: chetlashtirish, e'tibordan chetda qolish yoki bir kishi bilan muloqot qilishdan bosh tortish, odatda jazoning bir turi sifatida
usage: When I refused to help them cheat, the other students sent me to Coventry.

meaning: at a point when a choice must be made, at a point of change
meaning_uz: tanlov o'tkazilishi lozim bo'lgan nuqtada, o'zgarish nuqtasida
usage: After earning my degree, I'm at a crossroads. I need to figure out which direction my life should take.

meaning: to begin to understand how to do something well
meaning_uz: biror ishni yaxshi bajarishni tushuna boshlashi
usage: I practiced for a few hours before I really got a feel for the best way to do it.

meaning: annoyed, unhappy, or bored, especially with a situation that has existed for a long time
meaning_uz: g'azablangan, baxtsiz yoki zerikkan, ayniqsa uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan vaziyat bilan
usage: Residents are fed up with the disturbance caused by the nightclub.

meaning: as good as it could be, perfect
meaning_uz: bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan darajada, mukammal
usage: His answer to the question was on point, much to the disappointment of his opponent.

meaning: used to say that a distance is measured in a straight line between two points or places
meaning_uz: masofa ikki nuqta yoki joy orasidagi to'g'ri chiziqda o'lchanadi, deb aytish uchun ishlatiladi
usage: From here to the office, it's about 20 miles as the crow flies, but it's more like 30 miles by car since you have to wind around the mountain.

meaning: an extremely fun, exciting, or enjoyable time
meaning_uz: nihoyatda qiziqarli, hayajonli yoki qiziqarli vaqt
usage: I traveled to France for the first time last summer, and I had the time of my life!

meaning: to make an effort to control your emotions and behave more calmly
meaning_uz: his-tuyg'ularingizni boshqarishga harakat qilish va o'zingizni sokinroq tutish
usage: I just think he ought to get a grip on himself - he's behaving like a child.

meaning: a very large number or collection of people or things
meaning_uz: juda ko'p sonli yoki odamlar yoki narsalar to'plami
usage: We had a whole raft of problems on opening night, but I think most of the issues have been resolved.

meaning: the rate of someone's progress in learning a new skill
meaning_uz: yangi mahoratni o'rganishda birovning rivoji ko'rsatkichlari
usage: It's a steep learning curve when you're thrown into a job.

meaning: to survive or exist, especially in difficult circumstances
meaning_uz: omon qolish yoki mavjud bo'lish, ayniqsa qiyin vaziyatlarda
usage: With rising costs and dwindling income, she had to take up two jobs to keep her body and soul together.

meaning: choose to decrease involvement
meaning_uz: ishtirokini kamaytirishni tanlang
usage: After being severely criticized for his choices, he chose to take the back seat in the project.

meaning: no matter what happens
meaning_uz: nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar
usage: I am tired of working late.I will be leaving the office tonight at five o'clock, come hell or high water.

idiom: not have a hope in hell
meaning: to have no possibility of doing or achieving something
meaning_uz: biror ishni amalga oshirish yoki erishish imkoniyati bo'lmasligi
usage: We were so outclassed - we didn't have a hope in hell of winning.

meaning: to be in between two states or situations, or are about to be in a particular state or situation
meaning_uz: ikki davlat yoki holatlar o'rtasida bo'lishi, yoki muayyan holat yoki vaziyatda bo'lish arafasida
usage: I am sitting on the cusp of middle age.

meaning: when you complain about a loss from the past
meaning_uz: o'tmishdan yo'qotishdan shikoyat qilganingizda
usage: I know you didn't mean to break my phone, so there's no use in crying over spilt milk now.

meaning: to make someone understand something much more clearly than they did before, especially something unpleasant
meaning_uz: birovga avvalgidan ancha aniqroq, ayniqsa yoqimsiz narsani tushunishi uchun
usage: When I saw for myself the damage that had been caused, that really brought home to me the scale of the disaster.

meaning: information that proves who committed a crime
meaning_uz: jinoyatni kim sodir etganligini isbotlovchi ma'lumotlar
usage: The tape recordings provided prosecutors with the smoking gun they needed to prove he'd been involved in the conspiracy.

meaning: to maintain strict or tight control over someone
meaning_uz: birov ustidan qat'iy yoki qattiq nazoratni saqlab qolish uchun
usage: The boss has kept her assistant on a short leash ever since she hired her.

meaning: to do something in the easiest, cheapest, or fastest way
meaning_uz: biror ishni eng oson, arzon yoki eng tez usulda bajarishga
usage: There is always a temptation to cut corners when time is short.

meaning: to feel extremely excited or happy
meaning_uz: o'zini nihoyatda hayajonli yoki baxtli his qilish
usage: After the delivery of her baby, she was walking on air.

idiom: have a whale of a time
meaning: to enjoy yourself very much
meaning_uz: o'zingizdan juda zavq olishga
usage: We had a whale of a time on holiday.

meaning: to not judge someone as severely as you usually would because they are having problems at the present time
